verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach kamaavai soiee kaajee ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Qazi, who practices the Truth.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਿਲੁ ਸੋਧੈ ਸੋਈ ਹਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhil sodhai soiee haajee ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Haji, a pilgrim to Mecca, who purifies his heart.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਲਊਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਧਰਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: so mulaa maluoon nivaarai so dharaves jis sifat dharaa ||6||
verses.translation: He alone is a Mullah, who banishes evil; he alone is a saintly dervish, who takes the Support of the Lord's Praise. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਵਖਤ ਸਭੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਯਾਦਿ ਦਿਲੈ ਮਹਿ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe vakhat sabhe kar velaa || khaalak yaadh dhilai meh maulaa ||
verses.translation: Always, at every moment, remember God, the Creator within your heart.

verses.original: ਤਸਬੀ ਯਾਦਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਬੰਧਾਨਿ ਬਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tasabee yaadh karahu dhas maradhan su(n)nat seel ba(n)dhaan baraa ||7||
verses.translation: Let your meditation beads be the subjugation of the ten senses. Let good conduct and self-restraint be your circumcision. ||7||

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਭ ਫਿਲਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhil meh jaanahu sabh filahaalaa ||
verses.translation: You must know in your heart that everything is temporary.

verses.original: ਖਿਲਖਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਾਦਰ ਹਮੂ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: khilakhaanaa biraadhar hamoo ja(n)jaalaa ||
verses.translation: Family, household and siblings are all entanglements.

verses.original: ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਫਾਨਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦਰਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: meer malak umare faanaiaa ek mukaam khudhai dharaa ||8||
verses.translation: Kings, rulers and nobles are mortal and transitory; only God's Gate is the permanent place. ||8||

verses.original: ਅਵਲਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਸਾਬੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aval sifat dhoojee saabooree ||
verses.translation: First, is the Lord's Praise; second, contentment;

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਖੈਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: teejai halemee chauthai khairee ||
verses.translation: third, humility, and fourth, giving to charities.

verses.original: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਪੰਜੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਾਮੈ ਏਹਿ ਪੰਜਿ ਵਖਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: pa(n)javai pa(n)je ikat mukaamai eh pa(n)j vakhat tere aparaparaa ||9||
verses.translation: Fifth is to hold one's desires in restraint. These are the five most sublime daily prayers. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਉਦੀਫਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee jaan karahu maudheefaa ||
verses.translation: Let your daily worship be the knowledge that God is everywhere.

verses.original: ਬਦ ਅਮਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਕੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: badh amal chhodd karahu hath koojaa ||
verses.translation: Let renunciation of evil actions be the water-jug you carry.

verses.original: ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਬਾਂਗਾਂ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਬਰਖੁਰਦਾਰ ਖਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: khudhai ek bujh dhevahu baa(n)gaa(n) buragoo barakhuradhaar kharaa ||10||
verses.translation: Let realization of the One Lord God be your call to prayer; be a good child of God - let this be your trumpet. ||10||

verses.original: ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਬਖੋਰਹੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hak halaal bakhorahu khaanaa ||
verses.translation: Let what is earned righteously be your blessed food.

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਮੈਲਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhil dhareeaau dhovahu mailaanaa ||
verses.translation: Wash away pollution with the river of your heart.

verses.original: ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਭਿਸਤੀ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਨ ਦੋਜ ਠਰਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: peer pachhaanai bhisatee soiee ajaraieel na dhoj Tharaa ||11||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Prophet attains heaven. Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, does not cast him into hell. ||11||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਦਾਰ ਅਉਰਤ ਯਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kiradhaar aaurat yakeenaa ||
verses.translation: Let good deeds be your body, and faith your bride.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਮਾਣਿ ਹਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g tamaase maan hakeenaa ||
verses.translation: Play and enjoy the Lord's love and delight.

verses.original: ਨਾਪਾਕ ਪਾਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹਦੀਸਾ ਸਾਬਤ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਦਸਤਾਰ ਸਿਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naapaak paak kar hadhoor hadheesaa saabat soorat dhasataar siraa ||12||
verses.translation: Purify what is impure, and let the Lord's Presence be your religious tradition. Let your total awareness be the turban on your head. ||12||

verses.original: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਮੋਮ ਦਿਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: musalamaan mom dhil hovai ||
verses.translation: To be Muslim is to be kind-hearted,

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee mal dhil te dhovai ||
verses.translation: and wash away pollution from within the heart.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਾਟੁ ਘਿਉ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa ra(n)g na aavai neRai jiau kusam paaT ghiau paak haraa ||13||
verses.translation: He does not even approach worldly pleasures; he is pure, like flowers, silk, ghee and the deer-skin. ||13||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਹਰ ਮਿਹਰ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau mihar mihar miharavaanaa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the mercy and compassion of the Merciful Lord,

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਮਰਦੁ ਮਰਦੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee maradh maradh maradhaanaa ||
verses.translation: is the manliest man among men.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਬੰਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਜਰਿ ਨਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: soiee sekh masaik haajee so ba(n)dhaa jis najar naraa ||14||
verses.translation: He alone is a Shaykh, a preacher, a Haji, and he alone is God's slave, who is blessed with God's Grace. ||14||

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat kaadhar karan kareemaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has Creative Power; the Merciful Lord has Mercy.

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਰਹੀਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: sifat muhabat athaeh raheemaa ||
verses.translation: The Praises and the Love of the Merciful Lord are unfathomable.

verses.original: ਹਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸ ਤਰਾ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: hak hukam sach khudhaiaa bujh naanak ba(n)dh khalaas taraa ||15||3||12||
verses.translation: Realize the True Hukam, the Command of the Lord, O Nanak; you shall be released from bondage, and carried across. ||15||3||12||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਭ ਊਚ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham sabh uooch biraaje ||
verses.translation: The Abode of the Supreme Lord God is above all.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape thaap uthaape saaje ||
verses.translation: He Himself establishes, establishes and creates.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਬਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh kee saran gahat sukh paieeaai kichh bhau na viaapai baal kaa ||1||
verses.translation: Holding tight to the Sanctuary of God, peace is found, and one is not afflicted by the fear of Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: garabh agan meh jineh ubaariaa ||
verses.translation: He saved you from the fire of the womb,

verses.original: ਰਕਤ ਕਿਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: rakat kiram meh nahee sa(n)ghaariaa ||
verses.translation: and did not destroy you, when you were an egg in your mother's ovary.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: apanaa simaran dhe pratipaaliaa oh sagal ghaTaa kaa maalakaa ||2||
verses.translation: Blessing you with meditative remembrance upon Himself, He nurtured you and cherished you; He is the Master of all hearts. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saranaiee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g hai har jas gaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam maran sabh dhookh nivaare jap har har bhau nahee kaal kaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have erased all the pains of birth and death; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have no fear of death. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: samarath akath agochar dhevaa ||
verses.translation: God is all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable and divine.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh taa kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures serve Him.

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਾਲਕਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj bahu parakaaree paalakaa ||4||
verses.translation: In so many ways, He cherishes those born from eggs, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat hoi nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains this wealth,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ras a(n)tar maanaa ||
verses.translation: who savors and enjoys, deep within his mind, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਸਾਲਕਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene a(n)dh koop te virale keiee saalakaa ||5||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of his arm, God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit. Such a devotee of the Lord is very rare. ||5||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t madh prabh soiee ||
verses.translation: God exists in the beginning, in the middle and in the end.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kare su hoiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator Lord Himself does, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਘਾਲਕਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhram bhau miTiaa saadhasa(n)g te dhaalidh na koiee ghaalakaa ||6||
verses.translation: Doubt and fear are erased, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and then one is not afflicted by deadly pain. ||6||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: uootam baanee gaau guopaalaa ||
verses.translation: I sing the most Sublime Bani, the Word of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਮੰਗਹੁ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kee ma(n)gahu ravaalaa ||
verses.translation: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat.

verses.original: ਬਾਸਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਬਾਸਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਲਕਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: baasan meT nibaasan hoieeaai kalamal sagale jaalakaa ||7||
verses.translation: Eradicating desire, I have become free of desire; I have burnt away all my sins. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa kee ieh reet niraalee ||
verses.translation: This is the unique way of the Saints;

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kar dhekheh naalee ||
verses.translation: they behold the Supreme Lord God with them.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਲਕਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: saas saas aaraadhan har har kiau simarat keejai aalakaa ||8||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, they worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. How could anyone be too lazy to meditate on Him? ||8||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh na visarahu prabh mere suaamee ||
verses.translation: I never forget God, my Lord and Master, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ਬਨਿ ਜਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਾਲਕਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: simar simar jeeveh tere dhaasaa ban jal pooran thaalakaa ||9||
verses.translation: Your slaves live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord; You are permeating the woods, the water and the land. ||9||

verses.original: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: tatee vaau na taa kau laagai ||
verses.translation: Even the hot wind does not touch one

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam anadhin jaagai ||
verses.translation: who remains awake in meditative remembrance, night and day.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh kare har simaran tis maiaa sa(n)g na taalakaa ||10||
verses.translation: He delights and enjoys meditative remembrance on the Lord; he has no attachment to Maya. ||10||

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog dhookh tis naahee ||
verses.translation: Disease, sorrow and pain do not affect him;

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaahee ||
verses.translation: he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਖਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aapanaa naam dheh prabh preetam sun bena(n)tee khaalakaa ||11||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, O my Beloved Lord God; please listen to my prayer, O Creator. ||11||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan teraa hai piaare ||
verses.translation: Your Name is a jewel, O my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rate terai dhaas apaare ||
verses.translation: Your slaves are imbued with Your Infinite Love.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਭਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: terai ra(n)g rate tudh jehe virale keiee bhaalakaa ||12||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Your Love, become like You; it is so rare that they are found. ||12||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhooR maa(n)gai man meraa ||
verses.translation: My mind longs for the dust of the feet of those

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin visareh naahee kaahoo beraa ||
verses.translation: who never forget the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: tin kai sa(n)g param padh paiee sadhaa sa(n)gee har naalakaa ||13||
verses.translation: Associating with them, I obtain the supreme status; the Lord, my Companion, is always with me. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet piaaraa soiee ||
verses.translation: He alone is my beloved friend and companion,

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek dhiraRaae dhuramat khoiee ||
verses.translation: who implants the Name of the One Lord within, and eradicates evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar tajaae tis jan kau upadhes niramaalakaa ||14||
verses.translation: Immaculate are the teachings of that humble servant of the Lord, who casts out sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||14||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh vin naahee koiee meraa ||
verses.translation: Other than You, O Lord, no one is mine.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਕੜਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪੈਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur pakaRaae prabh ke pairaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has led me to grasp the feet of God.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੰਡਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur poore jin kha(n)ddiaa bharam anaalakaa ||15||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru, who has destroyed the illusion of duality. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas prabh bisarai naahee ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I never forget God.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har har kau dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t terai ra(n)g raate too samarath vaddaalakaa ||16||4||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Saints are imbued with Your Love; You are the great and all-powerful Lord. ||16||4||13||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal hiradhai nit dhaaree ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the Lord's lotus feet continually within my heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa khin khin namasakaaree ||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tan man arap dharee sabh aagai jag meh naam suhaavanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I dedicate my body, mind and everything, and place it in offering before the Lord. His Name is the most beautiful in this world. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: so Thaakur kiau manahu visaare ||
verses.translation: Why forget the Lord and Master from your mind?

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhe saaj savaare ||
verses.translation: He blessed you with body and soul, creating and embellishing you.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਰਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saas garaas samaale karataa keetaa apanaa paavanaa ||2||
verses.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, the Creator takes care of His beings, who receive according to what they have done. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te birathaa kouoo naahee ||
verses.translation: No one returns empty-handed from Him;

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har rakh man maahee ||
verses.translation: twenty-four hours a day, keep the Lord in your mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਅਚੁਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhaj achut suaamee dharageh sobhaa paavanaa ||3||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate and vibrate upon your imperishable Lord and Master, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath asaT dhasaa sidh ||
verses.translation: The four great blessings, and the eighteen miraculous spiritual powers,

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan sahaj sukh nau nidh ||
verses.translation: are found in the treasure of the Naam, which brings celestial peace and poise, and the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਜੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਵਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan je man meh chaaheh mil saadhoo suaamee raavanaa ||4||
verses.translation: If you yearn in your mind for all joys, then join the Saadh Sangat, and dwell upon your Lord and Master. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saasat si(n)mirat bedh vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: The Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas proclaim

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jeet paraanee ||
verses.translation: that the mortal must be victorious in this priceless human life.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh ni(n)dhaa parahareeaai har rasanaa naanak gaavanaa ||5||
verses.translation: Forsaking sexual desire, anger and slander, sing of the Lord with your tongue, O Nanak. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis roop na rekhiaa kul nahee jaatee ||
verses.translation: He has no form or shape, no ancestry or social class.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahiaa dhin raatee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading day and night.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jo jo japai soiee vaddabhaagee bahuR na jonee paavanaa ||6||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on Him is very fortunate; he is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bisarai purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Primal Lord, the Architect of karma,

verses.original: ਜਲਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jalataa firai rahai nit taataa ||
verses.translation: wanders around burning, and remains tormented.

verses.original: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣੈ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: akirataghanai kau rakhai na koiee narak ghor meh paavanaa ||7||
verses.translation: No one can save such an ungrateful person; he is thrown into the most horrible hell. ||7||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan tan dhan jin saajiaa ||
verses.translation: He blessed you with your soul, the breath of life, your body and wealth;

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh meh raakh nivaajiaa ||
verses.translation: He preserved and nurtured you in your mother's womb.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਰੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: tis siau preet chhaadd an raataa kaahoo sirai na laavanaa ||8||
verses.translation: Forsaking His Love, you are imbued with another; you shall never achieve your goals like this. ||8||

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere ||
verses.translation: Please shower me with Your Merciful Grace, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT vaseh sabhan kai nere ||
verses.translation: You dwell in each and every heart, and are near everyone.

verses.original: ਹਾਥਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਣਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਜਣਾਵਣਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: haath hamaarai kachhooaai naahee jis janaieh tisai janaavanaa ||9||
verses.translation: Nothing is in my hands; he alone knows, whom You inspire to know. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai masatak dhur likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis hee purakh na viaapai maiaa ||
verses.translation: that person is not afflicted by Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੂਸਰ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sadhaa saranaiee dhoosar lavai na laavanaa ||10||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary forever; there is no other equal to You. ||10||

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaa dhookh sookh sabh keene ||
verses.translation: In His Will, He made all pain and pleasure.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਹੀ ਚੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam biralai hee cheene ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who remember the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee jat kat ohee samaavanaa ||11||
verses.translation: His value cannot be described. He is prevailing everywhere. ||11||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee bhagat soiee vadd dhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the devotee; He is the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee pooran purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of karma.

verses.original: ਬਾਲ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: baal sahaiee soiee teraa jo terai man bhaavanaa ||12||
verses.translation: He is your help and support, since infancy; He fulfills your mind's desires. ||12||

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mrit dhookh sookh likh paae ||
verses.translation: Death, pain and pleasure are ordained by the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਧਹਿ ਘਟਹਿ ਨ ਘਟਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: til nahee badheh ghaTeh na ghaTaae ||
verses.translation: They do not increase or decrease by anyone's efforts.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਇ ਜਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: soiee hoi j karate bhaavai keh kai aap van(j)aavanaa ||13||
verses.translation: That alone happens, which is pleasing to the Creator; speaking of himself, the mortal ruins himself. ||13||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te seiee kaadde ||
verses.translation: He lifts us up and pulls us out of the deep dark pit;

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਂਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke TooTe gaa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: He unites with Himself, those who were separated for so many incarnations.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kirapaa dhaar rakhe kar apune mil saadhoo gobi(n)dh dhiaavanaa ||14||
verses.translation: Showering them with His Mercy, He protects them with His own hands. Meeting with the Holy Saints, they meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||14||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teree keemat kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Your worth cannot be described.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: acharaj roop vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Wondrous is Your form, and Your glorious greatness.

verses.translit: bhagat dhaan ma(n)gai jan teraa naanak bal bal jaavanaa ||15||1||14||22||24||2||14||62||
verses.translation: Your humble servant begs for the gift of devotional worship. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||15||1||14||22||24||2||14||62||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩
verses.translit: maaroo vaar mahalaa teejaa
verses.translation: Vaar Of Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗਾਹਕ ਗੁਣੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਹਘੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin gaahak gun vecheeaai tau gun sahagho jai ||
verses.translation: If virtue is sold when there is no buyer, then it is sold very cheap.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਲਾਖ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun kaa gaahak je milai tau gun laakh vikai ||
verses.translation: But if one meets a buyer of virtue, then virtue sells for hundreds of thousands.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun te gun mil paieeaai je satigur maeh samai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with a virtuous person, virtue is obtained, and one is immersed in the True Guru.

verses.original: ਮੋੁਲਿ ਅਮੋੁਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਿ ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: muol amuol na paieeaai vanaj na leejai haaT ||
verses.translation: Priceless virtues are not obtained for any price; they cannot be purchased in a store.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pooraa tol hai kabahu na hovai ghaaT ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, their weight is full and perfect; it never decreases at all. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਭਰਮਸਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: naam vihoone bharamaseh aaveh jaaveh neet ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they wander around, continually coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਇਕਿ ਢੀਲਿਆ ਇਕਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik baa(n)dhe ik ddeeliaa ik sukhe'ee har preet ||
verses.translation: Some are in bondage, and some are set free; some are happy in the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa ma(n)n lai sach karanee sach reet ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, believe in the True Lord, and practice Truth, through the lifestyle of Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur te giaan paiaa at khaRag karaaraa ||
verses.translation: From the Guru, I have obtained the supremely powerful sword of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗੜੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa bhram gaR kaTiaa moh lobh aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: I have cut down the fortress of duality and doubt, attachment, greed and egotism.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam man vasiaa gur sabadh veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord abides within my mind; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam mat uootamaa har lagaa piaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through Truth, self-discipline and sublime understanding, the Lord has become very dear to me.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh sacho sach varatadhaa sach sirajanahaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Truly, truly, the True Creator Lord is all-pervading. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa raagaa vich jaaneeaai bhaiee sabadhe kare piaar ||
verses.translation: Among the ragas, Kaydaaraa Raga is known as good, O Siblings of Destiny, if through it, one comes to love the Word of the Shabad,

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat siau miladho rahai sache dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: and if one remains in the Soceity of the Saints, and enshrines love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਲਾ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu mal kaTe aapanee kulaa kaa kare udhaar ||
verses.translation: Such a person washes away the pollution from within, and saves his generations as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਵਿਡਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gunaa kee raas sa(n)grahai avagan kaddai viddaar ||
verses.translation: He gathes in the capital of virtue, and destroys and drives out unvirtuous sins.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak miliaa so jaaneeaai guroo na chhoddai aapanaa dhoojai na dhare piaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is known as united, who does not forsake his Guru, and who does not love duality. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਉ ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: saagar dhekhau ddar marau bhai terai ddar naeh ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the world-ocean, I am afraid of death; but if I live in the Fear of You, God, then I am not afraid.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sa(n)tokheeaa naanak bigasaa nai ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am content; O Nanak, I blossom forth in the Name. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਚਾਲਸਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaR bohithai chaalasau saagar laharee dhei ||
verses.translation: I get on board the boat and set out, but the ocean is churning with waves.

verses.original: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਸਚੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaak na sachai bohithai je gur dheerak dhei ||
verses.translation: The boat of Truth encounters no obstruction, if the Guru gives encouragement.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਉਤਾਰੀਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tit dhar jai utaareeaa gur dhisai saavadhaan ||
verses.translation: He takes us across to the door on the other side, as the Guru keeps watch.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai dharageh chalai maan ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if I am blessed with His Grace, I shall go to His Court with honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਿਹਕੰਟਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nihaka(n)Tak raaj bhu(n)ch too gurmukh sach kamaiee ||
verses.translation: Enjoy your kingdom of bliss; as Gurmukh, practice Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachai takhat baiThaa niaau kar satasa(n)gat mel milaiee ||
verses.translation: Sitting upon the throne of Truth, the Lord administers justice; He unites us in Union with the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa upadhes har jaapanaa har siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, through the True Teachings, we become just like the Lord.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai sukhadhaataa man vasai a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: If the Lord, the Giver of peace, abides in the mind, in this world, then in the end, He becomes our help and support.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har siau preet uoopajee gur sojhee paiee ||2||
verses.translation: Love for the Lord wells up, when the Guru imparts understanding. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolee bhoolee mai firee paadhar kahai na koi ||
verses.translation: Confused and deluded, I wander around, but no one shows me the way.

verses.original: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: poochhahu jai siaaniaa dhukh kaaTai meraa koi ||
verses.translation: I go and ask the clever people, if there is there anyone who can rid me of my pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saachaa man vasai saajan ut hee Thai ||
verses.translation: If the True Guru abides within my mind, then I see the Lord, my best friend, there.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀਐ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak man tirapataaseeaai sifatee saachai nai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my mind is satisfied and fulfilled, contemplating the Praises of the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape karanee kaar aap aape kare rajai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Doer, and He is the deed; He Himself issues the Command.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape kis hee bakhas le aape kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives some, and He Himself does the deed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak chaanan gur mile dhukh bikh jaalee nai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, receiving the Divine Light from the Guru, suffering and corruption are burnt away, through the Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੂ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa vekh na bhul too manmukh moorakhaa ||
verses.translation: Don't be fooled by gazing at the riches of Maya, you foolish self-willed manmukh.

verses.original: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਲਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaladhiaa naal na chaliee sabh jhooTh dharab lakhaa ||
verses.translation: It shall not go along with you when you must depart; all the wealth you see is false.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਲਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: agiaanee a(n)dh na boojhiee sir uoopar jam khaRag kalakhaa ||
verses.translation: The blind and ignorant do not understand, that the sword of death is hanging over their heads.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ubare jin har ras chakhaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are saved.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap karaae kare aap aape har rakhaa ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause; the Lord Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa gur nahee bheTiaa bhai kee naahee bi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Those who do not meet with the Guru, who have no Fear of God at all,

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaavan dhukh ghanaa kadhe na chookai chi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: continue coming and going in reincarnation, and suffer terrible pain; their anxiety is never relieved.

verses.original: ਕਾਪੜ ਜਿਵੈ ਪਛੋੜੀਐ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaapaR jivai pachhoReeaai ghaRee muhat ghaReeaal ||
verses.translation: They are beaten like clothes being washed on the rocks, and struck every hour like chimes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin sirahu na chukai ja(n)jaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, these entanglements are not removed from hanging over one's head. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਢੂਢੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੁਰੀ ਜਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan ddooddee sajanaa haumai buree jagat ||
verses.translation: I have searched throughout the three worlds, O my friend; egotism is bad for the world.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਝੁਰੁ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naa jhur heeaRe sach chau naanak sacho sach ||2||
verses.translation: Don't worry, O my soul; speak the Truth, O Nanak, the Truth, and only the Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aape bakhasion har naam samaane ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself forgives the Gurmukhs; they are absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhagatee laion gur sabadh neesaane ||
verses.translation: He Himself links them to devotional worship; they bear the Insignia of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: sanamukh sadhaa sohane sachai dhar jaane ||
verses.translation: Those who turn towards the Guru, as sunmukh, are beautiful. They are famous in the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai mukat hai jin raam pachhaane ||
verses.translation: In this world, and in the world hereafter, they are liberated; they realize the Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n se jan jin har seviaa tin hau kurabaane ||4||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who serve the Lord. I am a sacrifice to them. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਹਲ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਮੜਵੜੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਮਨਹੁ ਕਸੁਧ ॥
verses.translit: mahal kuchajee maRavaRee kaalee manahu kasudh ||
verses.translation: The rude, ill-mannered bride is encased in the body-tomb; she is blackened, and her mind is impure.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੁੰਧ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: je gun hovan taa pir ravai naanak avagun mu(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: She can enjoy her Husband Lord, only if she is virtuous. O Nanak, the soul-bride is unworthy, and without virtue. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saach seel sach sa(n)jamee saa pooree paravaar ||
verses.translation: She has good conduct, true self-discipline, and a perfect family.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ahinis sadhaa bhalee pir kai het piaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, day and night, she is always good; she loves her Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa naam nidhaan paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who realizes his own self, is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kar kai aapanee gur sabadh milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Granting His Mercy, the Guru merges him in the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee niramalee har ras peeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani is immaculate and pure; through it, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ras jinee chaakhiaa an ras Thaak rahaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, forsake other flavors.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har ras pee sadhaa tirapat bhe fir tirasanaa bhukh gavaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, they remain satisfied forever; their hunger and thirst are quenched. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਖੁਸੀਏ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਏ ਧਨ ਉਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pir khuse'ee dhan raave'ee dhan ur naam seegaar ||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord is pleased, and He enjoys His bride; the soul-bride adorns her heart with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨ ਆਗੈ ਖੜੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhan aagai khaRee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that bride who stands before Him, is the most noble and respected woman. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sasurai peieeaai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||
verses.translation: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is inaccessible and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dha(n)n suohaaganee jo bhaaveh veparavaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her carefree, independent Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੋ ਬਹੈ ਜਿ ਤਖਤੈ ਲਾਇਕ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: takhat raajaa so bahai j takhatai laik hoiee ||
verses.translation: That king sits upon the throne, who is worthy of that throne.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach raaje seiee ||
verses.translation: Those who realize the True Lord, they alone are the true kings.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eh bhoopat raaje na aakhe'eeh dhoojai bhai dhukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: These mere earthly rulers are not called kings; in the love of duality, they suffer.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai jis jaadhe bilam na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Why should someone praise someone else who is also created? They depart in no time at all.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: nihachal sachaa ek hai gurmukh boojhai su nihachal hoiee ||6||
verses.translation: The One True Lord is eternal and imperishable. One who, as Gurmukh, understands becomes eternal as well. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa pir ek hai pir bin khaalee naeh ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Husband of all. No one is without the Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak se sohaaganee j satigur maeh samaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are the pure soul-brides, who merge in the True Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: man ke adhik tara(n)g kiau dhar saahib chhuTeeaai ||
verses.translation: The mind is churning with so many waves of desire. How can one be emancipated in the Court of the Lord?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: je raachai sach ra(n)g gooRai ra(n)g apaar kai ||
verses.translation: Be absorbed in the Lord's True Love, and imbued with the deep color of the Lord's Infinite Love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur parasaadhee chhuTeeaai je chit lagai sach ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one is emancipated, if the consciousness is attached to the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam amol hai kiau keemat keejai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is priceless. How can its value be estimated?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT sabh saajeean aape varateejai ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the entire universe, and He Himself is pervading it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa salaaheeaai sach keemat keejai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord forever, and through the Truth, they assess Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee kamal bigaasiaa iv har ras peejai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and in this way, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa Thaakiaa sukh sahaj saveejai ||7||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, and one sleeps in peace and poise. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਧੁੰਧਲਾ ਨਾ ਭਗਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa mailaa naa dhu(n)dhalaa naa bhagavaa naa kach ||
verses.translation: Neither dirty, nor dull, nor saffron, nor any color that fades.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak laalo laal hai sachai rataa sach ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, crimson - deep crimson is the color of one who is imbued with the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਖੰਡਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj vanasapat ful fal bhavar vasai bhai kha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: The bumble bee intuitively and fearlessly dwells among the vegetation, flowers and fruits.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਫੁਲੁ ਭਿਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak taravar ek hai eko ful bhira(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is only one tree, one flower, and one bumble bee. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan loojheh manai siau se soore paradhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who struggle with their minds are brave and distinguished heroes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har setee sadhaa mil rahe jinee aap pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who realize their own selves, remain forever united with the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: giaaneeaa kaa ih mahat hai man maeh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: This is the glory of the spiritual teachers, that they remain absorbed in their mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kaa mahal paiaa sach lai dhiaanaa ||
verses.translation: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and focus their meditation on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਜਿਤਾਨਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jin gur parasaadhee man jeetiaa jag tineh jitaanaa ||8||
verses.translation: Those who conquer their own minds, by Guru's Grace, conquer the world. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਗਿ ਭਵਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: jogee hovaa jag bhavaa ghar ghar bheekhiaa leau ||
verses.translation: If I were to become a Yogi, and wander around the world, begging from door to door,

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh lekhaa ma(n)geeaai kis kis utar dheau ||
verses.translation: then, when I am summoned to the Court of the Lord, what answer could I give?

verses.original: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhikhiaa naam sa(n)tokh maRee sadhaa sach hai naal ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I beg for; contentment is my temple. The True Lord is always with me.

verses.original: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhee haath na ladheeaa sabh badhee jamakaal ||
verses.translation: Nothing is obtained by wearing religious robes; all will be seized by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak galaa jhooTheeaa sachaa naam samaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, talk is false; contemplate the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhar lekhaa ma(n)geeaai so dhar sevih na koi ||
verses.translation: Through that door, you will be called to account; do not serve at that door.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satigur loR lahu jis jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Seek and find such a True Guru, who has no equal in His greatness.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis saranaiee chhooTeeaai lekhaa ma(n)gai na koi ||
verses.translation: In His Sanctuary, one is released, and no one calls him to account.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach dhiraRaae sach dhiraR sachaa oh sabadh dhei ||
verses.translation: Truth is implanted within Him, and He implants Truth within others. He bestows the blessing of the True Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai jis dhai sach hai tan man bhee sachaa hoi ||
verses.translation: One who has Truth within his heart - his body and mind are also true.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sachai hukam ma(n)niaai sachee vaddiaaiee dhei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one submits to the Hukam, the Command of the True Lord God, he is blessed with true glory and greatness.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਸੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sache maeh samaavasee jis no nadhar karei ||2||
verses.translation: He is immersed and merged in the True Lord, who blesses him with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੂਰੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: soore eh na aakhe'eeh aha(n)kaar mareh dhukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: They are not called heroes, who die of egotism, suffering in pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe aap na pachhaananee dhoojai pach jaaveh ||
verses.translation: The blind ones do not realize their own selves; in the love of duality, they rot.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਕਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਦੇ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: at karodh siau loojhadhe agai pichhai dhukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: They struggle with great anger; here and hereafter, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਵੇਦ ਕੂਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aha(n)kaar na bhaaviee vedh kook sunaaveh ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is not pleased by egotism; the Vedas proclaim this clearly.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਸੇ ਵਿਗਤੀ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaar mue se vigatee ge mar janameh fir aaveh ||9||
verses.translation: Those who die of egotism, shall not find salvation. They die, and are reborn in reincarnation. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਊਜਲਾ ਲੋਹੇ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaagau hoi na uoojalaa lohe naav na paar ||
verses.translation: The crow does not become white, and an iron boat does not float across.

verses.original: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: piram padhaarath ma(n)n lai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: One who puts his faith in the treasure of his Beloved Lord is blessed; he exalts and embellishes others as well.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਊਜਲਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaanai uoojalaa sir kaasaT lohaa paar ||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command - his face is radiant and bright; he floats across, like iron upon wood.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਭੈ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa chhoddai bhai vasai naanak karanee saar ||1||
verses.translation: Forsake thirst and desire, and abide in the Fear of God; O Nanak, these are the most excellent actions. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਾਰਣ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo maaran jo ge maar na sakeh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The ignorant people who go to the desert to conquer their minds, are not able to conquer them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak je ih maareeaai gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if this mind is to be conquered, one must contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh man maariaa naa marai je lochai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: This mind is not conquered by conquering it, even though everyone longs to do so.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak man hee kau man maarasee je satigur bheTai soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mind itself conquers the mind, if one meets with the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਈਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhovai tarafaa upaieeon vich sakat siv vaasaa ||
verses.translation: He created both sides; Shiva dwells within Shakti (the soul dwells within the material universe).

verses.original: ਸਕਤੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sakatee kinai na paio fir janam binaasaa ||
verses.translation: Through the material universe of Shakti, no one has ever found the Lord; they continue to be born and die in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਾਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur seviaai saat paieeaai jap saas giraasaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Lord with every breath and morsel of food.

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasat sodh dhekh uootam har dhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Searching and looking through the Simritees and the Shaastras, I have found that the most sublime person is the slave of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam binaa ko thir nahee naame bal jaasaa ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, nothing is permanent and stable; I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hovaa pa(n)ddit jotakee vedh paRaa mukh chaar ||
verses.translation: I might become a Pandit, a religious scholar, or an astrologer, and recite the four Vedas with my mouth;

verses.original: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਧੇ ਪੂਜੀਆ ਅਪਣੈ ਚਜਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: nav kha(n)dd madhe poojeeaa apanai chaj veechaar ||
verses.translation: I might be worshipped throughout the nine regions of the earth for my wisdom and thought;

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਚਉਕੈ ਭਿਟੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mat sachaa akhar bhul jai chaukai bhiTai na koi ||
verses.translation: let me not forget the Word of Truth, that no one can touch my sacred cooking square.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਚਉਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThe chauke naanakaa sachaa eko soi ||1||
verses.translation: Such cooking squares are false, O Nanak; only the One Lord is True. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae kare aap aape nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates and He Himself acts; He bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape dhe vaddiaaieeaa kahu naanak sachaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself grants glorious greatness; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Tak kaal ek hai hor ka(n)Tak na soojhai ||
verses.translation: Only death is painful; I cannot conceive of anything else as painful.

verses.original: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: afario jag meh varatadhaa paapee siau loojhai ||
verses.translation: It is unstoppable; it stalks and pervades the world, and fights with the sinners.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee har bhedheeaai har jap har boojhai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is immersed in the Lord. Meditating on the Lord, one comes to realize the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: so har saranaiee chhuTeeaai jo man siau joojhai ||
verses.translation: He alone is emancipated in the Sanctuary of the Lord, who struggles with his own mind.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: man veechaar har jap kare har dharageh seejhai ||11||
verses.translation: One who contemplates and meditates on the Lord in his mind, succeeds in the Court of the Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: hukam rajaiee saakhatee dharageh sach kabool ||
verses.translation: Submit to the Will of the Lord Commander; in His Court, only Truth is accepted.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahib lekhaa ma(n)gasee dhuneeaa dhekh na bhool ||
verses.translation: Your Lord and Master shall call you to account; do not go astray on beholding the world.

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhil dharavaanee jo kare dharavesee dhil raas ||
verses.translation: One who keeps watch over his heart, and keeps his heart pure, is a dervish, a saintly devotee.

verses.original: ਇਸਕ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eisak muhabat naanakaa lekhaa karate paas ||1||
verses.translation: Love and affection, O Nanak, are in the accounts placed before the Creator. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਲਗਉ ਜੋਇ ਮਧੂਕੜਉ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣਿ ਸਬਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: alagau joi madhookaRau saara(n)gapaan sabai ||
verses.translation: One who is unattached like the bumble bee, sees the Lord of the world everywhere.

verses.original: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: heerai heeraa bedhiaa naanak ka(n)Th subhai ||2||
verses.translation: The diamond of his mind is pierced through with the Diamond of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, his neck is embellished with it. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kaal viaapadhaa moh maiaa laage ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted by death; they cling to Maya in emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾੜਸੀ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਠਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh maar pachhaaRasee bhai dhoojai Thaage ||
verses.translation: In an instant, they are thrown to the ground and killed; in the love of duality, they are deluded.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: fir velaa hath na aaviee jam kaa dda(n)dd laage ||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; they are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his stick.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin jam dda(n)dd na lagiee jo har liv jaage ||
verses.translation: But Death's stick does not even strike those who remain awake and aware in the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਛਡਾਵਣੀ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sabh teree tudh chhaddaavanee sabh tudhai laage ||12||
verses.translation: All are Yours, and cling to You; only You can save them. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਜੋਇ ਅਗਛਮੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੇਰੋ ਆਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarabe joi agachhamee dhookh ghanero aath ||
verses.translation: See the imperishable Lord everywhere; attachment to wealth brings only great pain.

verses.original: ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਸਿ ਸਰੁ ਲਾਘਣਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਨ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaalar laadhas sar laaghanau laabh na poo(n)jee saath ||1||
verses.translation: Loaded with dust, you have to cross over the world-ocean; you are not carrying the profit and capital of the Name with you. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੂ ਅਖੁਟਉ ਦਰਬੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee saachau naam too akhuTau dharab apaar ||
verses.translation: My capital is Your True Name, O Lord; this wealth is inexhaustible and infinite.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਉ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhar niramalau dha(n)n saahu vaapaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this merchandise is immaculate; blessed is the banker who trades in it. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਮੋਟਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: poorab preet piraan lai moTau Thaakur maan ||
verses.translation: Know and enjoy the primal, eternal Love of the Great Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਮਾਥੈ ਊਭੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਣੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maathai uoobhai jam maarasee naanak melan naam ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed with the Naam, O Nanak, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death, and push his face to the ground. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape pi(n)dd savaarion vich nav nidh naam ||
verses.translation: He Himself has embellished the body, and placed the nine treasures of the Naam within it.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape bharam bhulaian tin nihafal kaam ||
verses.translation: He confuses some in doubt; fruitless are their actions.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikanee gurmukh bujhiaa har aatam raam ||
verses.translation: Some, as Gurmukh, realize their Lord, the Supreme Soul.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikanee sun kai ma(n)niaa har uootam kaam ||
verses.translation: Some listen to the Lord, and obey Him; sublime and exalted are their actions.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar har ra(n)g upajiaa gaiaa har gun naam ||13||
verses.translation: Love for the Lord wells up deep within, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੋਲਤਣਿ ਭੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੇਕੈ ਪਾਧਰ ਹੀਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: bholatan bhai man vasai hekai paadhar heedd ||
verses.translation: The Fear of God abides in the mind of the innocent; this is the straight path to the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਤੀਨੇ ਥਾਵ ਭਰੀਡੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: at ddaahapan dhukh ghano teene thaav bhareedd ||1||
verses.translation: Jealousy and envy bring terrible pain, and one is cursed throughout the three worlds. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਸਿ ਬਾਜਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਧੜੀਐ ਜੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maa(n)dhal bedh s baajano ghano dhaReeaai joi ||
verses.translation: The drum of the Vedas vibrates, bringing dispute and divisiveness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal too beejau avar na koi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there is none except Him. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਹਾਥਾਲਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: saagar gunee athaahu kin haathaalaa dhekheeaai ||
verses.translation: The world-ocean of the three qualities is unfathomably deep; how can its bottom be seen?

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa veparavaahu satigur milai ta paar pavaa ||
verses.translation: If I meet with the great, self-sufficient True Guru, then I am carried across.

verses.original: ਮਝ ਭਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਬਦੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: majh bhar dhukh badhukh ||
verses.translation: This ocean is filled up with pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's hunger is appeased. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jinee a(n)dhar bhaaliaa gur sabadh suhaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who search their inner beings, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are exalted and adorned.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਨਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichhan so paidhe har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: They obtain what they wish for, meditating on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare tis gur milai so har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by God's Grace, meets with the Guru; he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai tin kaa mit hai jam mag na paavai ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is his friend; he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaaveh dhinas raat har naam samaavai ||14||
verses.translation: He meditates on the Lord's Name, day and night; he is absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: suneeaai ek vakhaaneeaai surag mirat piaal ||
verses.translation: Listen to and speak the Name of the One Lord, who permeates the heavens, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukam na jaiee meTiaa jo likhiaa so naal ||
verses.translation: The Hukam of His Command cannot be erased; whatever He has written, shall go with the mortal.

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaun mooaa kaun maarasee kaun aavai kaun jai ||
verses.translation: Who has died, and who kills? Who comes and who goes?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਰਹਸੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaun rahasee naanakaa kis kee surat samai ||1||
verses.translation: Who is enraptured, O Nanak, and whose consciousness merges in the Lord? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੁਆ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau muaa mai maariaa paun vahai dhareeaau ||
verses.translation: In egotism, he dies; possessiveness kills him, and the breath flows out like a river.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਥਕੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa thakee naanakaa jaa man rataa nai ||
verses.translation: Desire is exhausted, O Nanak, only when the mind is imbued with the Name.

verses.original: ਲੋਇਣ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: loin rate loinee ka(n)nee surat samai ||
verses.translation: His eyes are imbued with the eyes of the Lord, and his ears ring with celestial consciousness.

verses.original: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਚੂਨੜੀ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਲਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeebh rasain choonaRee ratee laal lavai ||
verses.translation: His tongue drinks in the sweet nectar, dyed crimson by chanting the Name of the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਮੁਸਕਿ ਝਕੋਲਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar musak jhakoliaa keemat kahee na jai ||2||
verses.translation: His inner being is drenched with the Lord's fragrance; his worth cannot be described. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh naam nidhaan hai naamo naal chalai ||
verses.translation: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure. Only the Naam goes along in the end.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eh akhuT kadhe na nikhuTiee khai kharachiau palai ||
verses.translation: It is inexhaustible; it is never empty, no matter how much one may eat, consume or spend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਜਮਕਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jan neR na aaviee jamaka(n)kar jamakalai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: se saeh sache vanajaariaa jin har dhan palai ||
verses.translation: They alone are the true bankers and traders, who have the wealth of the Lord in their laps.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਘਲੈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te har paieeaai jaa aap har ghalai ||15||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Mercy, one finds the Lord, only when the Lord Himself sends for him. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਾਪਾਰੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਖ ਸਿਉ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh vaapaarai saar na jaananee bikh vihaajheh bikh sa(n)graheh bikh siau dhareh piaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the excellence of trading in Truth. He deals in poison, collects poison, and is in love with poison.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baaharahu pa(n)ddit sadhaidhe manahu moorakh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: Outwardly, they call themselves Pandits, religious scholars, but in their minds they are foolish and ignorant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਨੀ ਵਾਦੀ ਧਰਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har siau chit na lainee vaadhee dharan piaar ||
verses.translation: They do not focus their consciousness on the Lord; they love to engage in arguments.

verses.original: ਵਾਦਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨਿ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaadhaa keeaa karan kahaaneeaa kooR bol kareh aahaar ||
verses.translation: They speak to cause arguments, and earn their living by telling lies.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jag meh raam naam har niramalaa hor mailaa sabh aakaar ||
verses.translation: In this world, only the Lord's Name is immaculate and pure. All other objects of creation are polluted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na chetanee hoi maile mareh gavaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are polluted; they die in ignorance. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh lagaa bin seviaai hukam ma(n)ne dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the Lord, he suffers in pain; accepting the Hukam of God's Command, pain is gone.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੁਖੈ ਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaataa sukhai dhaa aape dhei sajai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver of peace; He Himself awards punishment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh kichh tisai rajai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know this well; all that happens is according to His Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har naam binaa jagat hai niradhan bin naavai tirapat naahee ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, the world is poor. Without the Name, no one is satisfied.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bharam bhulaiaa haumai dhukh paahee ||
verses.translation: He is deluded by duality and doubt. In egotism, he suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin karamaa kichhoo na paieeaai je bahut lochaahee ||
verses.translation: Without good karma, he does not obtain anything, no matter how much he may wish for it.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਛੁਟਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavai jai ja(n)mai marai gur sabadh chhuTaahee ||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation, and birth and death are ended, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: aap karai kis aakheeaai dhoojaa ko naahee ||16||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, so unto whom should we complain? There is no other at all. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh sa(n)tee dhan khaTiaa jinaa satigur miliaa prabh aai ||
verses.translation: In this world, the Saints earn the wealth; they come to meet God through the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sach dhiraRaiaa is dhan kee keemat kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru implants the Truth within; the value of this wealth cannot be described.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਧਨਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਭੁਖ ਲਥੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: eit dhan paiaai bhukh lathee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: Obtaining this wealth, hunger is relieved, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: ji(n)n(h)aa kau dhur likhiaa tinee paiaa aai ||
verses.translation: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to receive this.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh jagat niradhan hai maiaa no bilalai ||
verses.translation: The world of the self-willed manmukh is poor, crying out for Maya.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin firadhaa sadhaa rahai bhukh na kadhe jai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, it wanders continually, and its hunger is never relieved.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t na kadhe aaviee neh sukh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: It never finds calm tranquility, and peace never comes to dwell in its mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿਤਵਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa chi(n)t chitavadhaa rahai sahasaa kadhe na jai ||
verses.translation: It is always plagued by anxiety, and its cynicism never departs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਭਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak vin satigur mat bhavee satigur no milai taa sabadh kamai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the intellect is perverted; if one meets the True Guru, then one practices the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa sukh meh rahai sache maeh samai ||1||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, he dwells in peace, and merges in the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin upaiee medhanee soiee saar karei ||
verses.translation: The One who created the world, takes care of it.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko simarahu bhairahu tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; there is none other than Him.

verses.original: ਖਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: khaanaa sabadh cha(n)giaaieeaa jit khaadhai sadhaa tirapat hoi ||
verses.translation: So eat the food of the Shabad and goodness; eating it, you shall remain satisfied forever.

verses.original: ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: painan sifat sanai hai sadhaa sadhaa oh uoojalaa mailaa kadhe na hoi ||
verses.translation: Dress yourself in the Praise of the Lord. Forever and ever, it is radiant and bright; it is never polluted.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje sach dhan khaTiaa thoRaa kadhe na hoi ||
verses.translation: I have intuitively earned the true wealth, which never decreases.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee no sabadh seegaar hai jit sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: The body is adorned with the Shabad, and is at peace forever and ever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh bujheeaai jis no aap vikhaale soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Lord, who reveals Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jap tap sa(n)jamo gur sabadhee jaapai ||
verses.translation: Deep within the self are meditation and austere self-discipline, when one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaaieeaai haumai agiaan gavaapai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, egotism and ignorance are eliminated.
