verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar a(n)mirat bharapoor hai chaakhiaa saadh jaapai ||
verses.translation: One's inner being is overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar; tasting it, the flavor is known.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin chaakhiaa se nirabhau bhe se har ras dhraapai ||
verses.translation: Those who taste it become fearless; they are satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa dhaar peeaaiaa fir kaal na viaapai ||17||
verses.translation: Those who drink it in, by the Grace of the Lord, are never again afflicted by death. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋਕੁ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਕੀ ਬੰਨੑੈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: lok avaganaa kee ba(n)n(h)ai ga(n)ThaRee gun na vihaajhai koi ||
verses.translation: People tie up bundles of demerits; no one deals in virtue.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun kaa gaahak naanakaa viralaa koiee hoi ||
verses.translation: Rare is that person, O Nanak, who purchases virtue.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee gun paieeani(h) jis no nadhar karei ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with virtue, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gun avagun samaan heh j aap keete karataar ||
verses.translation: Merits and demerits are the same; they are both created by the Creator.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam ma(n)niaai sukh paieeaai gur sabadhee veechaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, finds peace, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar raajaa takhat hai aape kare niaau ||
verses.translation: The King sits on the throne within the self; He Himself administers justice.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee dhar jaaneeaai a(n)dhar mahal asaraau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord's Court is known; within the self is the Sanctuary, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਖੋਟਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khare parakh khajaanai paieean khoTiaa naahee thaau ||
verses.translation: The coins are assayed, and the genuine coins are placed in His treasury, while the counterfeit ones find no place.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sacho sach varatadhaa sadhaa sach niaau ||
verses.translation: The Truest of the True is all-pervading; His justice is forever True.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kaa ras aaiaa man vasiaa naau ||18||
verses.translation: One comes to enjoy the Ambrosial essence, when the Name is enshrined in the mind. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੈ ਕਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau mai karee taa(n) too naahee too hoveh hau naeh ||
verses.translation: When one acts in egotism, then You are not there, Lord. Wherever You are, there is no ego.

verses.original: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਾ ਏਹ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: boojhahu giaanee boojhanaa eh akath kathaa man maeh ||
verses.translation: O spiritual teachers, understand this: the Unspoken Speech is in the mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਲਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur tat na paieeaai alakh vasai sabh maeh ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the essence of reality is not found; the Invisible Lord dwells everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta jaaneeaai jaa(n) sabadh vasai man maeh ||
verses.translation: One meets the True Guru, and then the Lord is known, when the Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap giaa bhram bhau giaa janam maran dhukh jaeh ||
verses.translation: When self-conceit departs, doubt and fear also depart, and the pain of birth and death is removed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈਐ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਤਰਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat alakh lakhaieeaai uootam mat taraeh ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Unseen Lord is seen; the intellect is exalted, and one is carried across.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak soha(n) ha(n)saa jap jaapahu tirabhavan tisai samaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant the chant of 'Sohang hansaa' - 'He is me, and I am Him.' The three worlds are absorbed in Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਰਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man maanak jin parakhiaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Some assay their mind-jewel, and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: se jan virale jaane'eeh kalajug vich sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Only a few of those humble beings are known in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapai no aap mil rahiaa haumai dhubidhaa maar ||
verses.translation: One's self remains blended with the Lord's Self, when egotism and duality are conquered.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate dhutar tare bhaujal bikham sa(n)saar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam cross over the difficult, treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਨੀ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhar na bhaalanee muThe aha(n)mate ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not search within their own selves; they are deluded by their egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਿਖ ਤਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa(n) bhav thake a(n)dhar tikh tate ||
verses.translation: Wandering in the four directions, they grow weary, tormented by burning desire within.

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਨ ਸੋਧਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasat na sodhanee manmukh vigute ||
verses.translation: They do not study the Simritees and the Shaastras; the manmukhs waste away and are lost.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur kinai na paio har naam har sate ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one finds the Naam, the Name of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤੇ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: tat giaan veechaariaa har jap har gate ||19||
verses.translation: One who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom and meditates on the Lord is saved. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਣੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai kare aap aape aanai raas ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows, He Himself acts, and He Himself does it right.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਲਿਇ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tisai agai naanakaa khali keechai aradhaas ||1||
verses.translation: So stand before Him, O Nanak, and offer your prayers. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa aape jaanai soi ||
verses.translation: He who created the creation, watches over it; He Himself knows.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kis no kaheeaai naanakaa jaa ghar varatai sabh koi ||2||
verses.translation: Unto whom should I speak, O Nanak, when everything is contained within the home of the heart? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe thok visaar iko mit kar ||
verses.translation: Forget everything, and be friends with the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪਾਪਾ ਦਹੈ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan hoi nihaal paapaa dhahai har ||
verses.translation: Your mind and body shall be enraptured, and the Lord shall burn away your sins.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa chukai janam na jaeh mar ||
verses.translation: Your comings and goings in reincarnation shall cease; you shall not be reborn and die again.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਸੋਗਿ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam aadhaar sog na moh jar ||
verses.translation: The True Name shall be your Support, and you shall not burn in sorrow and attachment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਜਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nidhaan man meh sa(n)j dhar ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, gather in the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੰਮਾ ਦੰਮ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa manahu na veesarai maa(n)gai dha(n)maa dha(n)m ||
verses.translation: You do not forget Maya from your mind; you beg for it with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕਰੰਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so prabh chit na aaviee naanak nahee kara(n)m ||1||
verses.translation: You do not even think of that God; O Nanak, it is not in your karma. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਕਿਆ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa saath na chaliee kiaa lapaTaaveh a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Maya and its wealth shall not go along with you, so why do you cling to it - are you blind?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan dhiaai too tooTeh maiaa ba(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Guru's Feet, and the bonds of Maya shall be cut away from you. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai hukam manaion bhaanai sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, the Lord inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command; by the Pleasure of His Will, we find peace.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai satigur melion bhaanai sach dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, He leads us to meet the True Guru; by the Pleasure of His Will, we meditate on the Truth.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੇ ਜੇਵਡ ਹੋਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaane jevadd hor dhaat naahee sach aakh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: There is no other gift as great as the Pleasure of His Will; this Truth is spoken and proclaimed.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin sach kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, practice and live the Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis saranaagatee jin jagat upaiaa ||21||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; He created the world. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau a(n)dhar giaan nahee bhai kee naahee bi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have spiritual wisdom within, do not have even an iota of the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਇਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਰਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak muiaa kaa kiaa maaranaa j aap maare govi(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, why kill those who are already dead? The Lord of the Universe Himself has killed them. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਤ੍ਰੀ ਵਾਚਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man kee patree vaachanee sukhee hoo sukh saar ||
verses.translation: To read the horoscope of the mind, is the most sublime joyful peace.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਭਲਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: so braahaman bhalaa aakheeaai j boojhai braham beechaar ||
verses.translation: He alone is called a good Brahmin, who understands God in contemplative meditation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har saalaahe har paRai gur kai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: He praises the Lord, and reads of the Lord, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਓਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa oh paravaan hai j kul kaa kare udhaar ||
verses.translation: Celebrated and approved is the coming into the world of such a person, who saves all his generations as well.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: agai jaat na puchheeaai karanee sabadh hai saar ||
verses.translation: Hereafter, no one is questioned about social status; excellent and sublime is the practice of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hor kooR paRanaa kooR kamaavanaa bikhiaa naal piaar ||
verses.translation: Other study is false, and other actions are false; such people are in love with poison.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar sukh na hoviee manmukh janam khuaar ||
verses.translation: They do not find any peace within themselves; the self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate se ubare gur kai het apaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are saved; they have infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape kar kar vekhadhaa aape sabh sachaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates the creation, and gazes upon it; He Himself is totally True.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo hukam na boojhai khasam kaa soiee nar kachaa ||
verses.translation: One who does not understand the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, is false.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit bhaavai tit laidhaa gurmukh har sachaa ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, the True Lord joins the Gurmukh to Himself.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa saahib ek hai gur sabadhee rachaa ||
verses.translation: He is the One Lord and Master of all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are blended with Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa salaaheeaai sabh tis dhe jachaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs praise Him forever; all are beggars of Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਨਚਾਇਦਾ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਨਚਾ ॥੨੨॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau naanak aap nachaidhaa tiv hee ko nachaa ||22||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as He Himself makes us dance, we dance. ||22||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫
verses.translit: maaroo vaar mahalaa panjavaa ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Vaar Of Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਚਉ ਸਜਣ ਮੈਡਿਆ ਡੇਈ ਸਿਸੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: too chau sajan maiddiaa ddeiee sis utaar ||
verses.translation: If You tell me to, O my Friend, I will cut off my head and give it to You.

verses.original: ਨੈਣ ਮਹਿੰਜੇ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਕਦਿ ਪਸੀ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nain mahi(n)je tarasadhe kadh pasee dheedhaar ||1||
verses.translation: My eyes long for You; when will I see Your Vision? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੀਹੁ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਤਊ ਨਾਲਿ ਬਿਆ ਨੇਹ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਡੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: neeh mahi(n)jaa tuoo naal biaa neh kooRaave ddekh ||
verses.translation: I am in love with You; I have seen that other love is false.

verses.original: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪਿਰੀ ਨ ਡੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kapaR bhog ddaraavane jichar piree na ddekh ||2||
verses.translation: Even clothes and food are frightening to me, as long as I do not see my Beloved. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਠੀ ਝਾਲੂ ਕੰਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਪਸੀ ਤਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: auThee jhaaloo ka(n)taRe hau pasee tau dheedhaar ||
verses.translation: I rise early, O my Husband Lord, to behold Your Vision.

verses.original: ਕਾਜਲੁ ਹਾਰ ਤਮੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਸੇ ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaajal haar tamol ras bin pase habh ras chhaar ||3||
verses.translation: Eye make-up, garlands of flowers, and the flavor of betel leaf, are all nothing but dust, without seeing You. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa saahib sach sach sabh dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: You are True, O my True Lord and Master; You uphold all that is true.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤੋ ਥਾਟੁ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh keeto thaaT siraj sa(n)saariaa ||
verses.translation: You created the world, making a place for the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har aagiaa hoe bedh paap pu(n)n veechaariaa ||
verses.translation: By the Will of the Lord, the Vedas came into being; they discriminate between sin and virtue.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes trai gun bisathaariaa ||
verses.translation: You created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and the expanse of the three qualities.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nav kha(n)dd pirathamee saaj har ra(n)g savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Creating the world of the nine regions, O Lord, You have embellished it with beauty.

verses.original: ਵੇਕੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: vekee ja(n)t upai a(n)tar kal dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: Creating the beings of various kinds, You infused Your power into them.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na jaanai koi sach sirajanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: No one knows Your limit, O True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too jaaneh sabh bidh aap gurmukh nisataariaa ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself know all ways and means; You Yourself save the Gurmukhs. ||1||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਾਡੜਾ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: je too mitr asaaddaRaa hik bhoree naa vechhoR ||
verses.translation: If You are my friend, then don't separate Yourself from me, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਤਉ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਦਿ ਪਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau mahi(n)jaa tau mohiaa kadh pasee jaanee toh ||1||
verses.translation: My soul is fascinated and enticed by You; when will I see You, O my Love? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੂ ਜਲੁ ਭਾਹੜੀ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhurajan too jal bhaahaRee vichhoRe mar jaeh ||
verses.translation: Burn in the fire, you evil person; O separation, be dead.

verses.original: ਕੰਤਾ ਤੂ ਸਉ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ka(n)taa too sau sejaRee maiddaa habho dhukh ulaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O my Husband Lord, please sleep upon my bed, that all my sufferings may be gone. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhurajan dhoojaa bhaau hai vechhoRaa haumai rog ||
verses.translation: The evil person is engrossed in the love of duality; through the disease of egotism, he suffers separation.

verses.original: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sajan sachaa paatisaahu jis mil keechai bhog ||3||
verses.translation: The True Lord King is my friend; meeting with Him, I am so happy. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: too agam dhiaal bea(n)t teree keemat kahai kaun ||
verses.translation: You are inaccessible, merciful and infinite; who can estimate Your worth?

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤੂ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਭਉਣ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sirajiaa sabh sa(n)saar too naik sagal bhaun ||
verses.translation: You created the entire universe; You are the Master of all the worlds.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਰਉਣ ॥
verses.translit: teree kudharat koi na jaanai mere Thaakur sagal raun ||
verses.translation: No one knows Your creative power, O my all-pervading Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜਗ ਉਧਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: tudh apaR koi na sakai too abinaasee jag udharan ||
verses.translation: No one can equal You; You are imperishable and eternal, the Savior of the world.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਥਾਪੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਧਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: tudh thaape chaare jug too karataa sagal dharan ||
verses.translation: You established the four ages; You are the Creator of all worlds.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aavan jaanaa keeaa tudh lep na lagai tiran ||
verses.translation: You created the comings and goings of reincarnation; not even a particle of filth sticks to You.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: jis hoveh aap dhiaal tis laaveh satigur charan ||
verses.translation: As you are merciful, You attach us to the Feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਲਭਹੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਣ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too horat upai na labhahee abinaasee sirasaT karan ||2||
verses.translation: You cannot be found by any other efforts; You are the eternal, imperishable Creator of the Universe. ||2||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਵਤਹਿ ਅੰਙਣੇ ਹਭ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je too vateh a(n)n(g)ne habh dharat suhaavee hoi ||
verses.translation: If You come into my courtyard, all the earth becomes beautiful.

verses.original: ਹਿਕਸੁ ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਮੈਡੀ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hikas ka(n)tai baaharee maiddee vaat na puchhai koi ||1||
verses.translation: Other than the One Lord, my Husband, no one else cares for me. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਸਹੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਅੰਙਣੁ ਮਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: habhe Tol suhaavane sahu baiThaa a(n)n(g)n mal ||
verses.translation: All my adornments become beautiful, when You, O Lord, sit in my courtyard and make it Yours.

verses.original: ਪਹੀ ਨ ਵੰਞੈ ਬਿਰਥੜਾ ਜੋ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pahee na va(n)n(j)ai birathaRaa jo ghar aavai chal ||2||
verses.translation: Then no traveller who comes to my home shall leave empty-handed. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਕੰਤ ਕੂ ਕੀਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sej vichhaiee ka(n)t koo keeaa habh seegaar ||
verses.translation: I have spread out my bed for You, O my Husband Lord, and applied all my decorations.

verses.original: ਇਤੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ਜੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eitee ma(n)jh na samaaviee je gal pahiraa haar ||3||
verses.translation: But even this is not pleasing to me, to wear a garland around my neck. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too paarabraham paramesar jon na aavahee ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, O Transcendent Lord, You do not take birth.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too hukamee saajeh sirasaT saaj samaavahee ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of Your Command, You formed the Universe; forming it, You merge into it.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: teraa roop na jaiee lakhiaa kiau tujheh dhiaavahee ||
verses.translation: Your Form cannot be known; how can one meditate on You?

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too sabh meh varateh aap kudharat dhekhaavahee ||
verses.translation: You are pervading and permeating all; You Yourself reveal Your creative potency.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaar toT na aavahee ||
verses.translation: Your treasures of devotional worship are overflowing; they never decrease.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eh ratan javehar laal keem na paavahee ||
verses.translation: These gems, jewels and diamonds - their value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis hoveh aap dhiaal tis satigur sevaa laavahee ||
verses.translation: As You Yourself become merciful, Lord, You link us to the service of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis kadhe na aavai toT jo har gun gaavahee ||3||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, never suffers any deficiency. ||3||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮੂ ਪਸੀ ਹਠ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿਜੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa moo pasee haTh mai piree mahijai naal ||
verses.translation: When I look within my being, I find that my Beloved is with me.

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖ ਉਲਾਹਿਅਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: habhe ddukh ulaahiam naanak nadhar nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: All pains are relieved, O Nanak, when He bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੈਠਾ ਭਖੇ ਵਾਉ ਲੰਮੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak baiThaa bhakhe vaau la(n)me seveh dhar khaRaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak sits, waiting for news of the Lord, and stands at the Lord's Door; serving Him for so long.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੀਏ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਸਾਉ ਜੋਈ ਸਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਖੜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pire'e too jaan mahijaa saau joiee saiee muh khaRaa ||2||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, only You know my objective; I stand, waiting to see the Lord's face. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗਾਲਾਇਓ ਭੂਛ ਪਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੇ ਕੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gaalaio bhoochh par vel na johe ka(n)t too ||
verses.translation: What should I say to you, you fool? Don't look at the vines of others - be a true husband.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਦੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak fulaa sa(n)dhee vaaR khiRiaa habh sa(n)saar jiau ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the entire world is blooming, like a garden of flowers. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sughaR sujaan saroop too sabh meh varata(n)taa ||
verses.translation: You are Wise, all-knowing and beautiful; You are pervading and permeating all.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too aape Thaakur sevako aape pooja(n)taa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Lord and Master, and the servant; You worship and adore Yourself.

verses.original: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhaanaa beenaa aap too aape satava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You Yourself are true and pure.

verses.original: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jatee satee prabh niramalaa mere har bhagava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord, my Lord God, is celibate and True.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh braham pasaar pasaario aape khela(n)taa ||
verses.translation: God spreads out the expanse of the entire universe, and He Himself plays in it.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਦੇਖੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih aavaa gavan rachaio kar choj dhekha(n)taa ||
verses.translation: He created this coming and going of reincarnation; creating the wondrous play, He gazes upon it.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis baahuR garabh na paavahee jis dheveh gur ma(n)taa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the Guru's Teachings, is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation, ever again.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਦੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jiau aap chalaaveh tiau chaladhe kichh vas na ja(n)taa ||4||
verses.translation: All walk as He makes them walk; nothing is under the control of the created beings. ||4||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਰੀਏ ਕੁਰੀਏ ਵੈਦਿਆ ਤਲਿ ਗਾੜਾ ਮਹਰੇਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kure'e kure'e vaidhiaa tal gaaRaa maharer ||
verses.translation: You are walking along the river-bank, but the land is giving way beneath you.

verses.original: ਵੇਖੇ ਛਿਟੜਿ ਥੀਵਦੋ ਜਾਮਿ ਖਿਸੰਦੋ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vekhe chhiTaR theevadho jaam khisa(n)dho per ||1||
verses.translation: Watch out! Your foot might slip, and you'll fall in and die. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਚੁ ਵੈਦਿਓ ਤੂ ਆਘੂ ਆਘੇ ਸਲਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach jaanai kach vaidhio too aaghoo aaghe salave ||
verses.translation: You believe what is false and temporary to be true, and so you run on and on.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਸੜੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਨੈਣੂ ਬਿਆ ਢਲਿ ਪਬਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਜੁੰਮਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aatasaRee ma(n)jh nainoo biaa ddal paban jiau ju(n)mio ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, like butter in the fire, it shall melt away; it shall fade away like the water-lily. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੋਰੇ ਭੋਰੇ ਰੂਹੜੇ ਸੇਵੇਦੇ ਆਲਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhore bhore roohaRe sevedhe aalak ||
verses.translation: O my foolish and silly soul, why are you too lazy to serve?

verses.original: ਮੁਦਤਿ ਪਈ ਚਿਰਾਣੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਡੂ ਆਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mudhat piee chiraaneeaa fir kaddoo aavai rut ||3||
verses.translation: Such a long time has passed. When will this opportunity come again? ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh roop na rekhiaa jaat too varanaa baaharaa ||
verses.translation: You have no form or shape, no social class or race.

verses.original: ਏ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: e maanas jaaneh dhoor too varateh jaaharaa ||
verses.translation: These humans believe that You are far away; but You are quite obviously apparent.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too sabh ghaT bhogeh aap tudh lep na laaharaa ||
verses.translation: You enjoy Yourself in every heart, and no filth sticks to You.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too purakh ana(n)dhee ana(n)t sabh jot samaaharaa ||
verses.translation: You are the blissful and infinite Primal Lord God; Your Light is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too sabh dhevaa meh dhev bidhaate naraharaa ||
verses.translation: Among all divine beings, You are the most divine, O Creator-architect, Rejuvenator of all.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਕ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa aaraadhe jihavaa ik too abinaasee aparaparaa ||
verses.translation: How can my single tongue worship and adore You? You are the eternal, imperishable, infinite Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis meleh satigur aap tis ke sabh kul taraa ||
verses.translation: One whom You Yourself unite with the True Guru - all his generations are saved.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sevak sabh karadhe sev dhar naanak jan teraa ||5||
verses.translation: All Your servants serve You; Nanak is a humble servant at Your Door. ||5||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਹਡੜੜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਛਾਇਆ ਗਾਫਲ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gahaddaRaRaa tiran chhaiaa gaafal jalioh bhaeh ||
verses.translation: He builds a hut of straw, and the fool lights a fire in it.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਉਸਤਾਦ ਪਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jinaa bhaag mathaahaRai tin usataadh panaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads, find Shelter with the Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਠਾ ਪਕਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak peeThaa pakaa saajiaa dhariaa aan maujoodh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he grinds the corn, cooks it and places it before himself.

verses.original: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੈਠਾ ਝਾਕੁ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baajhahu satigur aapane baiThaa jhaak dharoodh ||2||
verses.translation: But without his True Guru, he sits and waits for his food to be blessed. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਸਰੀਆ ਪਕਾਈਆ ਪਾਈਆ ਥਾਲੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhusareeaa pakaieeaa paieeaa thaalai maeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the loaves of bread are baked and placed on the plate.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਸੇਈ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jinee guroo manaiaa raj raj seiee khaeh ||3||
verses.translation: Those who obey their Guru, eat and are totally satisfied. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jag meh khel rachaiaa vich haumai paieeaa ||
verses.translation: You have staged this play in the world, and infused egotism into all beings.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek ma(n)dhar pa(n)ch chor heh nit kareh buriaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: In the one temple of the body are the five thieves, who continually misbehave.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhas naaree ik purakh kar dhase saadh luobhaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The ten brides, the sensory organs were created, and the one husband, the self; the ten are engrossed in flavors and tastes.

verses.original: ਏਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: en maiaa mohanee moheeaa nit fireh bharamaieeaa ||
verses.translation: This Maya fascinates and entices them; they wander continually in doubt.

verses.original: ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੀਤੀਓ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਵਰਤਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: haaThaa dhovai keeteeo siv sakat varataieeaa ||
verses.translation: You created both sides, spirit and matter, Shiva and Shakti.

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਅਗੈ ਸਕਤੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਏਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: siv agai sakatee haariaa evai har bhaieeaa ||
verses.translation: Matter loses out to spirit; this is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਜੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik vichahu hee tudh rakhiaa jo satasa(n)g milaieeaa ||
verses.translation: You enshrined spirit within, which leads to merger with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਉਠਾਲਿਓ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jal vichahu bi(n)b uThaalio jal maeh samaieeaa ||6||
verses.translation: Within the bubble, You formed the bubble, which shall once again merge into the water. ||6||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਗਾਹਾ ਕੂ ਤ੍ਰਾਘਿ ਪਿਛਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਮੁਹਡੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: aagaahaa koo traagh pichhaa fer na muhaddaRaa ||
verses.translation: Look ahead; don't turn your face backwards.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਝਿ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਵਾਰ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਨਮੜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sijh ivehaa vaar bahuR na hovee janamaRaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, be successful this time, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਚਾਈਆ ਹਭ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: sajan maiddaa chaieeaa habh kahee dhaa mit ||
verses.translation: My joyful friend is called the friend of all.

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: habhe jaanan aapanaa kahee na Thaahe chit ||2||
verses.translation: All think of Him as their own; He never breaks anyone's heart. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਝੜਾ ਲਧਮੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gujhaRaa ladham laal mathai hee paragaT thiaa ||
verses.translation: The hidden jewel has been found; it has appeared on my forehead.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਪਿਰੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: soiee suhaavaa thaan jithai pire'e naanak jee too vuThiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Beautiful and exalted is that place, O Nanak, where You dwell, O my Dear Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too merai val hai taa kiaa muhachha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: When You are on my side, Lord, what do I need to worry about?

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਨੋ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sabh kichh maino saupiaa jaa teraa ba(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: You entrusted everything to me, when I became Your slave.

verses.original: ਲਖਮੀ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: lakhamee toT na aaviee khai kharach raha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: My wealth is inexhaustible, no matter how much I spend and consume.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee sabh sev kara(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings all work to serve me.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh vairee mitr sabh keetiaa neh ma(n)geh ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: All these enemies have become my friends, and no one wishes me ill.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa koi na puchhiee jaa har bakhasa(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: No one calls me to account, since God is my forgiver.

verses.original: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: ana(n)dh bhiaa sukh paiaa mil gur govi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: I have become blissful, and I have found peace, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਐ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabhe kaaj savaariaai jaa tudh bhaava(n)dhaa ||7||
verses.translation: All my affairs have been resolved, since You are pleased with me. ||7||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡੇਖਣ ਕੂ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਿਜੇਹਾ ਤਉ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ddekhan koo musataak mukh kijehaa tau dhanee ||
verses.translation: I am so eager to see You, O Lord; what does Your face look like?

verses.original: ਫਿਰਦਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਹਾਲਿ ਜਾ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: firadhaa kitai haal jaa ddiTham taa man dhraapiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I wandered around in such a miserable state, but when I saw You, my mind was comforted and consoled. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦ ਘਣੇ ਵੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhukheeaa dharadh ghane vedhan jaane too dhanee ||
verses.translation: The miserable endure so much suffering and pain; You alone know their pain, Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾਣਾ ਲਖ ਭਵੇ ਪਿਰੀ ਡਿਖੰਦੋ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaanaa lakh bhave piree ddikha(n)dho taa jeevasaa ||2||
verses.translation: I may know hundreds of thousands of remedies, but I shall live only if I see my Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਢਹਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਰਾਰਿ ਵਹਣਿ ਵਹੰਦੇ ਮੈ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddahadhee jai karaar vahan vaha(n)dhe mai ddiThiaa ||
verses.translation: I have seen the river-bank washed away by the raging waters of the river.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਰਹੇ ਅਮਾਣ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: seiee rahe amaan jinaa satigur bheTiaa ||3||
verses.translation: They alone remain intact, who meet with the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis jan teree bhukh hai tis dhukh na viaapai ||
verses.translation: No pain afflicts that humble being who hungers for You, Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin jan gurmukh bujhiaa su chahu ku(n)ddee jaapai ||
verses.translation: That humble Gurmukh who understands, is celebrated in the four directions.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਬਹਿ ਪਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo nar us kee saranee parai tis ka(n)beh paapai ||
verses.translation: Sins run away from that man, who seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee mal utarai gur dhooRee naapai ||
verses.translation: The filth of countless incarnations is washed away, bathing in the dust of the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin har bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tis sog na sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: Whoever submits to the Lord's Will does not suffer in sorrow.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau too sabhanaa kaa mit hai sabh jaaneh aapai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the friend of all; all believe that You are theirs.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਨੈ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee sobhaa janai kee jevadd har parataapai ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Lord's humble servant is as great as the Glorious Radiance of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sabh a(n)tar jan varataiaa har jan te jaapai ||8||
verses.translation: Among all, His humble servant is pre-eminent; through His humble servant, the Lord is known. ||8||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਭੀ ਰਵਿਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa pichhai hau giee se mai pichhai bhee raviaas ||
verses.translation: Those whom I followed, now follow me.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਆਸੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਹਿਜੀ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jinaa kee mai aasaRee tinaa mahijee aas ||1||
verses.translation: Those in whom I placed my hopes, now place their hopes in me. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਿਲੀ ਗਿਲੀ ਰੋਡੜੀ ਭਉਦੀ ਭਵਿ ਭਵਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gilee gilee roddaRee bhaudhee bhav bhav aai ||
verses.translation: The fly flies around, and comes to the wet lump of molasses.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੇ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo baiThe se faathiaa ubare bhaag mathai ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever sits on it, is caught; they alone are saved, who have good destiny on their foreheads. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡਿਠਾ ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹਿ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ddiThaa habh majhaeh khaalee koi na jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: I see Him within all. No one is without Him.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਖੀ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tai sakhee bhaag mathaeh jinee meraa sajan raaviaa ||3||
verses.translation: Good destiny is inscribed on the forehead of that companion, who who enjoys the Lord, my Friend. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddaaddee dhar gun gaavadhaa je har prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: I am a minstrel at His Door, singing His Glorious Praises, to please to my Lord God.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਥਿਰ ਥਾਵਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa thir thaavaree hor aavai jaavai ||
verses.translation: My God is permanent and stable; others continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so ma(n)gaa dhaan guosaieeaa jit bhukh leh jaavai ||
verses.translation: I beg for that gift from the Lord of the World, which will satisfy my hunger.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jeeau dhevahu dharasan aapanaa jit ddaaddee tirapataavai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord God, please bless Your minstrel with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, that I might be satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aradhaas sunee dhaataar prabh ddaaddee kau mahal bulaavai ||
verses.translation: God, the Great Giver, hears the prayer, and summons the minstrel to the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਉ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhekhadhiaa dhukh bhukh giee ddaaddee kau ma(n)gan chit na aavai ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon God, the minstrel is rid of pain and hunger; he does not think to ask for anything else.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa lag prabh kai paavai ||
verses.translation: All desires are fulfilled, touching the feet of God.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵੇਦਾਵੈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: hau niragun ddaaddee bakhasion prabh purakh vedhaavai ||9||
verses.translation: I am His humble, unworthy minstrel; the Primal Lord God has forgiven me. ||9||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਛੁਟੇ ਤਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਤੂ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa chhuTe taa khaak too su(n)n(j)ee ka(n)t na jaanahee ||
verses.translation: When the soul leaves, you shall become dust, O vacant body; why do you not realize your Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਤੂ ਕੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhurajan setee neh too kai gun har ra(n)g maanahee ||1||
verses.translation: You are in love with evil people; by what virtues will you enjoy the Lord's Love? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jis bin ghaRee na jeevanaa visare sarai na bi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without Him, you cannot survive, even for an instant; you cannot afford to forget Him, even for a moment.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨ ਰੂਸੀਐ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis siau kiau man rooseeaai jiseh hamaaree chi(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: Why are you alienated from Him, O my mind? He takes care of you. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: rate ra(n)g paarabraham kai man tan at gulaal ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God, their minds and bodies are colored deep crimson.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਲੂਦਿਆ ਜਿਤੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak vin naavai aaloodhiaa jitee hor khiaal ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, other thoughts are polluted and corrupt. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pavaRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau jaa too meraa mitr hai taa kiaa mai kaaRaa ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, when You are my friend, what sorrow can afflict me?

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਠਗੀ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jinee Thagee jag Thagiaa se tudh maar nivaaRaa ||
verses.translation: You have beaten off and destroyed the cheats that cheat the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ਜਿਤਾ ਪਾਵਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bhaujal paar la(n)ghaiaa jitaa paavaaRaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean, and I have won the battle.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਵਡਾ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sabh ras bhogadhaa vaddaa aakhaaRaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy all the pleasures in the great world-arena.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀਆ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਤੀਓ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਸਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh i(n)dhreeaa vas kar dhiteeo satava(n)taa saaRaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has brought all my senses and organs under my control.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੈ ਲਗਦੀਆ ਨਹ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit laieean titai lagadheeaa neh khi(n)jotaaRaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I join them, there they are joined; they do not struggle against me.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichhee so fal paidhaa gur a(n)dhar vaaRaa ||
verses.translation: I obtain the fruits of my desires; the Guru has directed me within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਦਾ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gur naanak tuThaa bhairahu har vasadhaa neRaa ||10||
verses.translation: When Guru Nanak is pleased, O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord is seen to be dwelling near at hand. ||10||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮੂੰ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa moo(n) aaveh chit too taa habhe sukh lahaau ||
verses.translation: When You come into my consciousness, then I obtain all peace and comfort.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਤਹਿਜਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak man hee ma(n)jh ra(n)gaavalaa piree tahijaa naau ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak: with Your Name within my mind, O my Husband Lord, I am filled with delight. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਏ ਹਭੇ ਹੀ ਛਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kapaR bhog vikaar e habhe hee chhaar ||
verses.translation: Enjoyment of clothes and corrupt pleasures - all these are nothing more than dust.

verses.original: ਖਾਕੁ ਲੋੁੜੇਦਾ ਤੰਨਿ ਖੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khaak luoRedhaa ta(n)n khe jo rate dheedhaar ||2||
verses.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤਕਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਪਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa takeh biaa paas kar heeaRe hik adhaar ||
verses.translation: Why do you look in other directions? O my heart, take the Support of the Lord alone.

verses.original: ਥੀਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਭੀ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: theeau sa(n)tan kee ren jit labhee sukh dhaataar ||3||
verses.translation: Become the dust of the feet of the Saints, and find the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: vin karamaa har jeeau na paieeaai bin satigur manooaa na lagai ||
verses.translation: Without good karma, the Dear Lord is not found; without the True Guru, the mind is not joined to Him.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਾ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharam dheeraa kal a(n)dhare ih paapee mool na tagai ||
verses.translation: Only the Dharma remains stable in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; these sinners will not last at all.

verses.original: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: eh kar kare su eh kar paae ik ghaRee muhat na lagai ||
verses.translation: Whatever one does with this hand, he obtains with the other hand, without a moment's delay.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਮੈ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: chaare jug mai sodhiaa vin sa(n)gat aha(n)kaar na bhagai ||
verses.translation: I have examined the four ages, and without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, egotism does not depart.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਸੰਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mool na chhuTiee vin saadhoo satasa(n)gai ||
verses.translation: Egotism is never eradicated without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਭੰਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: tichar thaeh na paaviee jichar saahib siau man bha(n)gai ||
verses.translation: As long as one's mind is torn away from his Lord and Master, he finds no place of rest.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin jan gurmukh seviaa tis ghar dheebaan abhagai ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, has the Support of the Imperishable Lord in the home of his heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗੈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te sukh paiaa gur satigur charanee lagai ||11||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Grace, peace is obtained, and one is attached to the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||11||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋੜੀਦੋ ਹਭ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਮੀਰਾ ਮੀਰੰਨ ਸਿਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: loReedho habh jai so meeraa meera(n)n sir ||
verses.translation: I have searched everywhere for the King over the heads of kings.

verses.original: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਚਉਦੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haTh ma(n)jhaahoo so dhanee chaudho mukh alai ||1||
verses.translation: That Master is within my heart; I chant His Name with my mouth. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਣਿਕੂ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਉ ਡਿੰਨਾ ਧਣੀ ਅਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maanikoo moh maau ddi(n)naa dhanee apaeh ||
verses.translation: O my mother, the Master has blessed me with the jewel.

verses.original: ਹਿਆਉ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਠੰਢੜਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hiaau mahijaa Tha(n)ddaRaa mukhahu sach alai ||2||
verses.translation: My heart is cooled and soothed, chanting the True Name with my mouth. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਸੇਜ ਨੈਣਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਛਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: moo theeaauoo sej nainaa piree vichhaavanaa ||
verses.translation: I have become the bed for my Beloved Husband Lord; my eyes have become the sheets.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਡੇਖੈ ਹਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਮਾ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je ddekhai hik vaar taa sukh keemaa hoo baahare ||3||
verses.translation: If You look at me, even for an instant, then I obtain peace beyond all price. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: man lochai har milan kau kiau dharasan paieeaa ||
verses.translation: My mind longs to meet the Lord; how can I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan?

verses.original: ਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਿੜਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਜੇ ਬਿੰਦ ਬੋੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai lakh viRate saahibaa je bi(n)dh buolaieeaa ||
verses.translation: I obtain hundreds of thousands, if my Lord and Master speaks to me, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਸਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai chaare ku(n)ddaa bhaaleeaa tudh jevadd na saieeaa ||
verses.translation: I have searched in four directions; there is no other as great as You, Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੋ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhasih maarag sa(n)taho kiau prabhoo milaieeaa ||
verses.translation: Show me the Path, O Saints. How can I meet God?

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਜੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: man arapih haumai tajahu it pa(n)th julaieeaa ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind to Him, and renounce my ego. This is the Path which I shall take.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit sevih saahib aapanaa satasa(n)g milaieeaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I serve my Lord and Master continually.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe aasaa pooreeaa gur mahal bulaieeaa ||
verses.translation: All my hopes are fulfilled; the Guru has ushered me into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd hor na sujhiee mere mitr guosaieeaa ||12||
verses.translation: I cannot conceive of any other as great as You, O my Friend, O Lord of the World. ||12||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਤਖਤੁ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿੰਜੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: moo theeaauoo takhat piree mahi(n)je paatisaeh ||
verses.translation: I have become the throne for my Beloved Lord King.

verses.original: ਪਾਵ ਮਿਲਾਵੇ ਕੋਲਿ ਕਵਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਬਿਗਸਾਵਦੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paav milaave kol kaval jivai bigasaavadho ||1||
verses.translation: If You place Your foot on me, I blossom forth like the lotus flower. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਭੁਖ ਮੂ ਲਾਵਣ ਥੀ ਵਿਥਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pireeaa sa(n)dhaRee bhukh moo laavan thee vitharaa ||
verses.translation: If my Beloved becomes hungry, I will become food, and place myself before Him.

verses.original: ਜਾਣੁ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਇਖ ਬੇਈ ਪੀੜੇ ਨਾ ਹੁਟੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaan miThaiee ikh beiee peeRe naa huTai ||2||
verses.translation: I may be crushed, again and again, but like sugarcane, I do not stop yielding sweet juice. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਗਾ ਨੀਹੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬਾ ਨਗਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: Thagaa neeh matroR jaan ga(n)dhrabaa nagaree ||
verses.translation: Break off your love with the cheaters; realize that it is a mirage.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਘਟਾਊ ਡੂਇ ਇਸੁ ਪੰਧਾਣੂ ਘਰ ਘਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukh ghaTaauoo ddooi is pa(n)dhaanoo ghar ghane ||3||
verses.translation: Your pleasure lasts for only two moments; this traveller wanders through countless homes. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਲੇਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: akal kalaa neh paieeaai prabh alakh alekha(n) ||
verses.translation: God is not found by intellectual devices; He is unknowable and unseen.

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: khaT dharasan bhramate fireh neh mileeaai bhekha(n) ||
verses.translation: The followers of the six orders wander and roam around wearing religious robes, but they do not meet God.

verses.original: ਵਰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: varat kareh cha(n)dhrainaa se kitai na lekha(n) ||
verses.translation: They keep the lunar fasts, but they are of no account.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪੇਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: bedh paReh sa(n)pooranaa tat saar na pekha(n) ||
verses.translation: Those who read the Vedas in their entirety, still do not see the sublime essence of reality.

verses.original: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: tilak kaddeh isanaan kar a(n)tar kaalekha(n) ||
verses.translation: They apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, and take cleansing baths, but they are blackened within.

verses.original: ਭੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhee prabhoo na labhiee vin sachee sikha(n) ||
verses.translation: They wear religious robes, but without the True Teachings, God is not found.

verses.original: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolaa maarag so pavai jis dhur masatak lekha(n) ||
verses.translation: One who had strayed, finds the Path again, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੰ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: tin janam savaariaa aapanaa jin gur akhee dhekha(n) ||13||
verses.translation: One who sees the Guru with his eyes, embellishes and exalts his human life. ||13||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਗਡਿ ਜੋ ਚਲਾਊ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: so nivaahoo gadd jo chalaauoo na theeaai ||
verses.translation: Focus on that which will not pass away.

verses.original: ਕਾਰ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ ਛਡਿ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaar kooRaavee chhadd sa(n)mal sach dhanee ||1||
verses.translation: Abandon your false actions, and meditate on the True Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਭ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਘਟਾਊ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: habh samaanee jot jiau jal ghaTaauoo cha(n)dhramaa ||
verses.translation: God's Light is permeating all, like the moon reflected in the water.

verses.original: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paragaT theeaa aap naanak masatak likhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself is revealed, O Nanak, to one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mukh suhaave naam chau aaTh pahar gun gaau ||
verses.translation: One's face becomes beautiful, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dharageh ma(n)ne'eeh milee nithaave thaau ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the Court of the Lord, you shall be accepted; even the homeless find a home there. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰ ਭੇਖਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: baahar bhekh na paieeaai prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: By wearing religious robes outwardly, God, the Inner-knower is not found.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਿਕਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: eikas har jeeau baaharee sabh firai nikaamee ||
verses.translation: Without the One Dear Lord, all wander around aimlessly.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਫਿਰਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: man rataa kuTa(n)b siau nit garab firaamee ||
verses.translation: Their minds are imbued with attachment to family, and so they continually wander around, puffed up with pride.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਦਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: fireh gumaanee jag meh kiaa garabeh dhaamee ||
verses.translation: The arrogant wander around the world; why are they so proud of their wealth?

verses.original: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: chaladhiaa naal na chaliee khin jai bilaamee ||
verses.translation: Their wealth shall not go with them when they depart; in an instant, it is gone.

verses.original: ਬਿਚਰਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਹੁਕਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: bicharadhe fireh sa(n)saar meh har jee hukaamee ||
verses.translation: They wander around in the world, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: karam khulaa gur paiaa har miliaa suaamee ||
verses.translation: When one's karma is activated, one finds the Guru, and through Him, the Lord and Master is found.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jo jan har kaa sevako har tis kee kaamee ||14||
verses.translation: That humble being, who serves the Lord, has his affairs resolved by the Lord. ||14||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਹਭ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਛਾਣੰਦੋ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mukhahu alaae habh maran pachhaana(n)dho koi ||
verses.translation: All speak with their mouths, but rare are those one who realize death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਯਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਕ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tinaa khaak jinaa yakeenaa hik siau ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who have faith in the One Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਣੁ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਮੰਝਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਕੋ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaan vasa(n)dho ma(n)jh pachhaanoo ko hekaRo ||
verses.translation: Know that He dwells within all; rare are those who realize this.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tai tan paRadhaa naeh naanak jai gur bheTiaa ||2||
verses.translation: There is no obscuring veil on the body of that one, O Nanak, who meets the Guru. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਤੜੀ ਕਾਂਢਕੁ ਆਹ ਪਾਵ ਧੋਵੰਦੋ ਪੀਵਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: mataRee kaa(n)ddak aaeh paav dhova(n)dho peevasaa ||
verses.translation: I drink in the water which has washed the feet of those who share the Teachings.

verses.original: ਮੂ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਪਸਣ ਕੂ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moo tan prem athaeh pasan koo sachaa dhanee ||3||
verses.translation: My body is filled with infinite love to see my True Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau naam visaariaa naal maiaa rachaa ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord, he becomes attached to Maya.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavai jai bhavaieeaai bahu jonee nachaa ||
verses.translation: He comes and goes, and wanders, dancing in countless incarnations.

verses.original: ਬਚਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਖਿਸਕਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: bachan kare tai khisak jai bole sabh kachaa ||
verses.translation: He gives his word, but then backs out. All that he says is false.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਥੋਥਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਭ ਖਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu thothaa kooRiaar kooRee sabh khachaa ||
verses.translation: The false person is hollow within; he is totally engrossed in falsehood.

verses.original: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: vair kare niravair naal jhooThe laalachaa ||
verses.translation: He tries to take vengeance upon the Lord, who bears no vengeance; such a person is trapped by falsehood and greed.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: maariaa sachai paatisaeh vekh dhur karamachaa ||
verses.translation: The True King, the Primal Lord God, kills him when He sees what he has done.

verses.original: ਜਮਦੂਤੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: jamadhootee hai heriaa dhukh hee meh pachaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death sees him, and he rots away in pain.

verses.original: ਹੋਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: hoaa tapaavas dharam kaa naanak dhar sachaa ||15||
verses.translation: Even-handed justice is administered, O Nanak, in the Court of the True Lord. ||15||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: parabhaate prabh naam jap gur ke charan dhiaai ||
verses.translation: In the early hours of the morning, chant the Name of God, and meditate on the Feet of the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran mal utarai sache ke gun gai ||1||
verses.translation: The filth of birth and death is erased, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)n(j)ee naam vihooneeaa ||
verses.translation: The body is dark, blind and empty, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak safal jana(n)m jai ghaT vuThaa sach dhanee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, fruitful is the birth of one, within whose heart the True Master dwells. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: loin loiee ddiTh piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I have seen the Light; my great thirst for Him is not quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak se akhaReeaa bia(n)n jinee ddisa(n)dho maa piree ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, these are not the eyes which can see my Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin jan gurmukh seviaa tin sabh sukh paiee ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, obtains all peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: oh aap tariaa kuTa(n)b siau sabh jagat taraiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is saved, along with his family, and all the world is saved as well.

verses.original: ਓਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: on har naamaa dhan sa(n)chiaa sabh tikhaa bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: He collects the wealth of the Lord's Name, and all his thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਓਨਿ ਛਡੇ ਲਾਲਚ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: on chhadde laalach dhunee ke a(n)tar liv laiee ||
verses.translation: He renounces worldly greed, and his inner being is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: os sadhaa sadhaa ghar ana(n)dh hai har sakhaa sahaiee ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, the home of his heart is filled with bliss; the Lord is his companion, help and support.

verses.original: ਓਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: on vairee mitr sam keetiaa sabh naal subhaiee ||
verses.translation: He looks alike upon enemy and friend, and wishes well to all.

verses.original: ਹੋਆ ਓਹੀ ਅਲੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hoaa ohee al jag meh gur giaan japaiee ||
verses.translation: He alone is fulfilled in this world, who meditates on the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa paiaa har siau ban aaiee ||16||
verses.translation: He obtains what is pre-ordained for him, according to the Lord. ||16||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach suhaavaa kaaddeeaai kooRai kooRee soi ||
verses.translation: The true person is said to be beautiful; false is the reputation of the false.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak virale jaane'eeh jin sach palai hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, rare are those who have Truth in their laps. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਮੁਖੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਨਿਹਾਲਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sajan mukh anoop aThe pahar nihaalasaa ||
verses.translation: The face of my friend, the Lord, is incomparably beautiful; I would watch Him, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਸੁਤੜੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਤੈ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sutaRee so sahu ddiTh tai supane hau kha(n)neeaai ||2||
verses.translation: In sleep, I saw my Husband Lord; I am a sacrifice to that dream. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਵਣੁ ਥੋਥਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sajan sach parakh mukh alaavan thotharaa ||
verses.translation: O my friend, realize the True Lord. Just to talk about Him is useless.

verses.original: ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਲਖਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਸੁ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ma(n)n majhaahoo lakh tudhahu dhoor na su piree ||3||
verses.translation: See Him within your mind; your Beloved is not far away. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharat aakaas paataal hai cha(n)dh soor binaasee ||
verses.translation: The earth, the Akaashic ethers of the sky, the nether regions of the underworld, the moon and the sun shall pass away.

verses.original: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਖਾਨ ਢਾਹਿ ਡੇਰੇ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: baadhisaeh saeh umaraav khaan ddaeh ddere jaasee ||
verses.translation: Emperors, bankers, rulers and leaders shall depart, and their homes shall be demolished.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਤੁੰਗ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਤ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g tu(n)g gareeb masat sabh lok sidhaasee ||
verses.translation: The poor and the rich, the humble and the intoxicated, all these people shall pass away.

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਸਭੇ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaajee sekh masaikaa sabhe uTh jaasee ||
verses.translation: The Qazis, Shaykhs and preachers shall all arise and depart.

verses.original: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਬਰ ਅਉਲੀਏ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: peer paikaabar aaule'ee ko thir na rahaasee ||
verses.translation: The spiritual teachers, prophets and disciples - none of these shall remain permanently.

verses.original: ਰੋਜਾ ਬਾਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਕਤੇਬ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਸਭ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: rojaa baag nivaaj kateb vin bujhe sabh jaasee ||
verses.translation: Fasts, calls to prayer and sacred scriptures - without understanding, all these shall vanish.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਭ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee sabh aavai jaasee ||
verses.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings of the earth shall all continue coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਬੰਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: nihachal sach khudhai ek khudhai ba(n)dhaa abinaasee ||17||
verses.translation: The One True Lord God is eternal and unchanging. The Lord's slave is also eternal. ||17||

verses.original: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡਿਠੀ ਹਭ ਢੰਢੋਲਿ ਹਿਕਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddiThee habh dda(n)ddol hikas baajh na koi ||
verses.translation: I have seen and examined all; without the One Lord, there is none at all.

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਜਣ ਤੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aau sajan too mukh lag meraa tan man Tha(n)ddaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Come, and show me Your face, O my friend, so that my body and mind may be cooled and soothed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਕੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਮੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: aasak aasaa baaharaa moo man vaddee aas ||
verses.translation: The lover is without hope, but within my mind, there is great hope.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗਈਆਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aas niraasaa hik too hau bal bal bal gieeaas ||2||
verses.translation: In the midst of hope, only You, O Lord, remain free of hope; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਡੁਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਮਰਿਓਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: vichhoRaa sune ddukh vin ddiThe mariodh ||
verses.translation: Even if I just hear of separation from You, I am in pain; without seeing You, O Lord, I die.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੋਦਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baajh piaare aapane birahee naa dheerodh ||3||
verses.translation: Without her Beloved, the separated lover takes no comfort. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਲਿਆ ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: taT teerath dhev dhevaaliaa kedhaar mathuraa kaasee ||
verses.translation: River-banks, sacred shrines, idols, temples, and places of pilgrimage like Kaydarnaat'h, Mat'huraa and Benares,

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਸਣੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: koT teteesaa dhevate san i(n)dhrai jaasee ||
verses.translation: the three hundred thirty million gods, along with Indra, shall all pass away.

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasatr bedh chaar khaT dharas samaasee ||
verses.translation: The Simritees, Shaastras, the four Vedas and the six systems of philosophy shall vanish.

verses.original: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਵਤੇ ਭੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: pothee pa(n)ddit geet kavit kavate bhee jaasee ||
verses.translation: Prayer books, Pandits, religious scholars, songs, poems and poets shall also depart.

verses.original: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jatee satee sa(n)niaaseeaa sabh kaalai vaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who are celibate, truthful and charitiable, and the Sannyaasee hermits are all subject to death.

verses.original: ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਾ ਜਮੈ ਸਣੁ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: mun jogee dhiga(n)baraa jamai san jaasee ||
verses.translation: The silent sages, the Yogis and the nudists, along with the Messengers of Death, shall pass away.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so vinasanaa sabh binas binaasee ||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen shall perish; all will dissolve and disappear.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਸੀ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: thir paarabraham paramesaro sevak thir hosee ||18||
verses.translation: Only the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is permanent. His servant becomes permanent as well. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੈ ਨੰਗੇ ਨਹ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖੇ ਲਖ ਨ ਭੁਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sai na(n)ge neh na(n)g bhukhe lakh na bhukhiaa ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of times naked does not make the person naked; tens of thousands of hungers do not make him hungry;

verses.original: ਡੁਖੇ ਕੋੜਿ ਨ ਡੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਖੰਦੋ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ddukhe koR na ddukh naanak piree pikha(n)dho subh dhisaT ||1||
verses.translation: millions of pains do not cause him pain. O Nanak, the Husband Lord blesses him with his Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sukh samoohaa bhog bhoom sabaiee ko dhanee ||
verses.translation: Even if one were to enjoy all pleasures, and be master of the entire earth,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੋ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak habho rog mritak naam vihooniaa ||2||
