verses.translation: O Nanak, all of that is just a disease. Without the Naam, he is dead. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਿਕਸ ਕੂੰ ਤੂ ਆਹਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਭੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hikas koo(n) too aaeh pachhaanoo bhee hik kar ||
verses.translation: Yearn for the One Lord, and make Him your friend.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਰਥਾਈ ਲਜੀਵਦੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aasaRee nibaeh maanukh parathaiee lajeevadho ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He alone fulfills your hopes; you should feel embarrassed, visiting other places. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal ek naraino har agam agaadhaa ||
verses.translation: The One and only Lord is eternal, imperishable, inaccessible and incomprehensible.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal naam nidhaan hai jis simarat har laadhaa ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam is eternal and imperishable. Meditating in remembrance on Him, the Lord is attained.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal keeratan gun gobi(n)dh gurmukh gaavaadhaa ||
verses.translation: The Kirtan of His Praises is eternal and imperishable; the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach dharam tap nihachalo dhin rain araadhaa ||
verses.translation: Truth, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable. Day and night, worship the Lord in adoration.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dharam tap nihachalo jis karam likhaadhaa ||
verses.translation: Compassion, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable; they alone obtain these, who have such pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਟਲੈ ਨ ਟਲਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal masatak lekh likhiaa so Talai na Talaadhaa ||
verses.translation: The inscription inscribed upon one's forehead is eternal and imperishable; it cannot be avoided by avoidance.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal sa(n)gat saadh jan bachan nihachal gur saadhaa ||
verses.translation: The Congregation, the Company of the Holy, and the word of the humble, are eternal and imperishable. The Holy Guru is eternal and imperishable.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin sadhaa sadhaa aaraadhaa ||19||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny worship and adore the Lord, forever and ever. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਡੁਬੰਦੋ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਤਰਾਏ ਕਿਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dduba(n)dho aap so taraae kin(h) khe ||
verses.translation: One who himself has drowned - how can he carry anyone else across?

verses.original: ਤਾਰੇਦੜੋ ਭੀ ਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taaredhaRo bhee taar naanak pir siau ratiaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who is imbued with the Love of the Husband Lord - O Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves others as well. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਕਥੰਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jithai koi katha(n)n naau suna(n)dho maa piree ||
verses.translation: Wherever someone speaks and hears the Name of my Beloved Lord,

verses.original: ਮੂੰ ਜੁਲਾਊਂ ਤਥਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਹਰਿਓ ਥੀਓਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moo(n) julaauoo(n) tath naanak piree pasa(n)dho hario theeos ||2||
verses.translation: that is where I go, O Nanak, to see Him, and blossom forth in bliss. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਨੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kiaa kareh putr kalatr saneh ||
verses.translation: You are in love with your children and your wife; why do you keep calling them your own?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਨਿਮੁਣੀਆਦੀ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vihooneeaa nimuneeaadhee dheh ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the human body has no foundation. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: nainee dhekhau gur dharasano gur charanee mathaa ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; I touch my forehead to the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਪੈਰੀ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਹਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: pairee maarag gur chaladhaa pakhaa feree hathaa ||
verses.translation: With my feet I walk on the Guru's Path; with my hands, I wave the fan over Him.

verses.original: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਪੰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: akaal moorat ridhai dhiaaidhaa dhin rain japa(n)thaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate on Akaal Moorat, the undying form, within my heart; day and night, I meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਛਡਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਾਇਣੋ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai chhaddiaa sagal apaino bharavaasai gur samarathaa ||
verses.translation: I have renounced all possessiveness, and have placed my faith in the all-powerful Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bakhasiaa naam nidhaan sabho dhukh lathaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed me with the treasure of the Naam; I am rid of all sufferings.

verses.original: ਭੋਗਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhogahu bhu(n)chahu bhaieeho palai naam agathaa ||
verses.translation: Eat and enjoy the Naam, the Name of the indescribable Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan isanaan dhiR sadhaa karahu gur kathaa ||
verses.translation: Confirm your faith in the Naam, charity and self-purification; chant the Guru's sermon forever.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਲਥਾ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sahaj bhiaa prabh paiaa jam kaa bhau lathaa ||20||
verses.translation: Blessed with intuitive poise, I have found God; I am rid of the fear of the Messenger of Death. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਗੜੀਆ ਪਿਰੀਅੰਨਿ ਪੇਖੰਦੀਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: lagaReeaa pireea(n)n pekha(n)dheeaa naa tipeeaa ||
verses.translation: I am centered and focused on my Beloved, but I am not satisfied, even by seeing Him.

verses.original: ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਡਿਠੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: habh majhaahoo so dhanee biaa na ddiTho koi ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master is within all; I do not see any other. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਥੜੀਆ ਸੰਤਾਹ ਤੇ ਸੁਖਾਊ ਪੰਧੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kathaReeaa sa(n)taeh te sukhaauoo pa(n)dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The sayings of the Saints are the paths of peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧੜੀਆ ਤਿੰਨਾਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਹੜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ladhaReeaa ti(n)naeh jinaa bhaag mathaahaRai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain them, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਜਲਾ ਥਲਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਨਾ ਫਲ ਕੰਦਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddoo(n)gar jalaa thalaa bhoom banaa fal ka(n)dharaa ||
verses.translation: He is totally permeating the mountains, oceans, deserts, lands, forests, orchards, caves,

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹਭ ਘਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: paataalaa aakaas pooran habh ghaTaa ||
verses.translation: the nether regions of the underworld, the Akaashic ethers of the skies, and all hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਓ ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਤੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak pekh jeeo ikat soot paroteeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak sees that they are all strung on the same thread. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ॥
verses.translit: har jee maataa har jee pitaa har jeeau pratipaalak ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is my mother, the Dear Lord is my father; the Dear Lord cherishes and nurtures me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਾਲਕ ॥
verses.translit: har jee meree saar kare ham har ke baalak ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord takes care of me; I am the child of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਖਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਲਕ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje sahaj khilaidhaa nahee karadhaa aalak ||
verses.translation: Slowly and steadily, He feeds me; He never fails.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਚਿਤਾਰਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
verses.translit: aaugan ko na chitaaradhaa gal setee laik ||
verses.translation: He does not remind me of my faults; He hugs me close in His embrace.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਿ ਮੰਗਾਂ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ॥
verses.translit: muh ma(n)gaa(n) soiee dhevadhaa har pitaa sukhadhaik ||
verses.translation: Whatever I ask for, He give me; the Lord is my peace-giving father.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਪਿਓਨੁ ਇਸੁ ਸਉਦੇ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
verses.translit: giaan raas naam dhan saupion is saudhe laik ||
verses.translation: He has blessed me with the capital, the wealth of spiritual wisdom; He has made me worthy of this merchandise.

verses.original: ਸਾਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਕ ॥
verses.translit: saajhee gur naal bahaaliaa sarab sukh paik ||
verses.translation: He has made me a partner with the Guru; I have obtained all peace and comforts.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਲਾਇਕ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: mai naalahu kadhe na vichhuRai har pitaa sabhanaa galaa laik ||21||
verses.translation: He is with me, and shall never separate from me; the Lord, my father, is potent to do everything. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok ddakhane mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਚੜਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਪਕਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kachaRiaa siau toR ddoodd sajan sa(n)t pakiaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, break away from the false, and seek out the Saints, your true friends.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਓਇ ਮੁਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਛੋੜਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oi jeeva(n)dhe vichhuReh oi muiaa na jaahee chhoR ||1||
verses.translation: The false shall leave you, even while you are still alive; but the Saints shall not forsake you, even when you are dead. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਜੁਲੀਆ ਚਮਕੰਨਿ ਘੁਰਨਿੑ ਘਟਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bijuleeaa chamaka(n)n ghurani(h) ghaTaa at kaaleeaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the lightning flashes, and thunder echoes in the dark black clouds.

verses.original: ਬਰਸਨਿ ਮੇਘ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਸੁਹੰਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: barasan megh apaar naanak sa(n)gam piree suha(n)dheeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The downpour from the clouds is heavy; O Nanak, the soul-brides are exalted and embellished with their Beloved. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal neer bhare seetal pavan jhulaaradhe ||
verses.translation: The ponds and the lands are overflowing with water, and the cold wind is blowing.

verses.original: ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ਸੋਇੰਨ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜੰਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sejaReeaa soi(n)n heere laal jaRa(n)dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Her bed is adorned with gold, diamonds and rubies;

verses.original: ਸੁਭਰ ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਤਤੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: subhar kapaR bhog naanak piree vihoonee tateeaa ||3||
verses.translation: she is blessed with beautiful gowns and delicacies, O Nanak, but without her Beloved, she burns in agony. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaaran karatai jo keeaa soiee hai karanaa ||
verses.translation: He does the dees which the Creator causes him to do.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: je sau dhaaveh praaneeaa paaveh dhur lahanaa ||
verses.translation: Even if you run in hundreds of directions, O mortal, you shall still receive what you are pre-destined to receive.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin karamaa kichhoo na labhiee je fireh sabh dharanaa ||
verses.translation: Without good karma, you shall obtain nothing, even if you wander across the whole world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਭੈ ਡਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil bhau govi(n)dh kaa bhai ddar dhoor karanaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, you shall know the Fear of God, and other fears shall be taken away.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te bairaag uoopajai har khojat firanaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, the attitude of detachment wells up, and one sets out in search of the Lord.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat sahaj upajiaa fir janam na maranaa ||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, intuitive wisdom wells up, and then, one is not born to die again.

verses.original: ਹਿਆਇ ਕਮਾਇ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hiaai kamai dhiaaiaa paiaa saadh saranaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing meditation within my heart, I have found the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੜਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: bohith naanak dheau gur jis har chaRaae tis bhaujal taranaa ||22||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord places on the boat of Guru Nanak, is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Dakhanay Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਕਬੂਲਿ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਛਡਿ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa maran kabool jeevan kee chhadd aas ||
verses.translation: First, accept death, and give up any hope of life.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਤਉ ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoh sabhanaa kee renukaa tau aau hamaarai paas ||1||
verses.translation: Become the dust of the feet of all, and then, you may come to me. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵੰਦਾ ਪੇਖੁ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: muaa jeeva(n)dhaa pekh jeeva(n)dhe mar jaan ||
verses.translation: See, that only one who has died, truly lives; one who is alive, consider him dead.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਇਕ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa muhabat ik siau te maanas paradhaan ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are in love with the One Lord, are the supreme people. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jis man vasai paarabraham nikaT na aavai peer ||
verses.translation: Pain does not even approach that person, within whose mind God abides.

verses.original: ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੀਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhukh tikh tis na viaapiee jam nahee aavai neer ||3||
verses.translation: Hunger and thirst do not affect him, and the Messenger of Death does not approach him. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਅਡੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kahan na jaieeaai sach saeh addolai ||
verses.translation: Your worth cannot be estimated, O True, Unmoving Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਤੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik giaanee dhiaaneeaa kaun tudhuno tolai ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, seekers, spiritual teachers and meditators - who among them can measure You?

verses.original: ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਪਰਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath hai opat sabh paralai ||
verses.translation: You are all-powerful, to form and break; You create and destroy all.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਭ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath hai ghaT ghaT sabh bolai ||
verses.translation: You are all-powerful to act, and inspire all to act; You speak through each and every heart.

verses.original: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: rijak samaahe sabhasai kiaa maanas ddolai ||
verses.translation: You give sustanance to all; why should mankind waver?

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਮੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: gahir gabheer athaahu too gun giaan amolai ||
verses.translation: You are deep, profound and unfathomable; Your virtuous spiritual wisdom is priceless.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਉਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee ka(n)m kamaavanaa keeaa dhur maulai ||
verses.translation: They do the deeds which they are pre-ordained to do.

verses.original: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੨੩॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: tudhahu baahar kichh nahee naanak gun bolai ||23||1||2||
verses.translation: Without You, there is nothing at all; Nanak chants Your Glorious Praises. ||23||1||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag maaroo baanee kabeer jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਡੀਆ ਕਵਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: paddeeaa kavan kumat tum laage ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, in what foul thoughts are you engaged?

verses.original: ਬੂਡਹੁਗੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: booddahuge paravaar sakal siau raam na japahu abhaage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall be drowned, along with your family, if you do not meditate on the Lord, you unfortunate person. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨੁ ਖਰ ਚੰਦਨ ਜਸ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan paRe kaa kiaa gun khar cha(n)dhan jas bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: What is the use of reading the Vedas and the Puraanas? It is like loading a donkey with sandalwood.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee kaise utaras paaraa ||1||
verses.translation: You do not know the exalted state of the Lord's Name; how will you ever cross over? ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਬਧਹੁ ਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea badhahu su dharam kar thaapahu adharam kahahu kat bhaiee ||
verses.translation: You kill living beings, and call it a righteous action. Tell me, brother, what would you call an unrighteous action?

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੁਨਿਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aapas kau munivar kar thaapahu kaa kau kahahu kasaiee ||2||
verses.translation: You call yourself the most excellent sage; then who would you call a butcher? ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਾਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man ke a(n)dhe aap na boojhahu kaeh bujhaavahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: You are blind in your mind, and do not understand your own self; how can you make others understand, O brother?

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬੇਚਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaaran bidhiaa bechahu janam abirathaa jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: For the sake of Maya and money, you sell knowledge; your life is totally worthless. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਆਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਕ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naaradh bachan biaas kahat hai suk kau poochhahu jaiee ||
verses.translation: Naarad and Vyaasa say these things; go and ask Suk Dayv as well.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰਮਿ ਛੂਟਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer raamai ram chhooTahu naeh ta boodde bhaiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, you shall be saved; otherwise, you shall drown, brother. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬਨਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਤਜਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baneh base kiau paieeaai jau lau manahu na tajeh bikaar ||
verses.translation: Living in the forest, how will you find Him? Not until you remove corruption from your mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਘਰੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh ghar ban samasar keeaa te poore sa(n)saar ||1||
verses.translation: Those who look alike upon home and forest, are the most perfect people in the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: saar sukh paieeaai raamaa ||
verses.translation: You shall find real peace in the Lord,

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g ravahu aatamai raam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: if you lovingly dwell on the Lord within your being. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਟਾ ਭਸਮ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaTaa bhasam lepan keeaa kahaa gufaa meh baas ||
verses.translation: What is the use of wearing matted hair, smearing the body with ashes, and living in a cave?

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man jeete jag jeetiaa jaa(n) te bikhiaa te hoi udhaas ||2||
verses.translation: Conquering the mind, one conquers the world, and then remains detached from corruption. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਈ ਟੁਕੁ ਚਾਹਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan dhei sabhai koiee Tuk chaahan maeh biddaan ||
verses.translation: They all apply make-up to their eyes; there is little difference between their objectives.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan jeh paiaa te loin paravaan ||3||
verses.translation: But those eyes, to which the ointment of spiritual wisdom is applied, are approved and supreme. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ab jaaniaa gur giaan dheeaa samajhai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, now I know my Lord; the Guru has blessed me with spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)taragat har bheTiaa ab meraa man katahoo na jai ||4||2||
verses.translation: I have met the Lord, and I am emancipated within; now, my mind does not wander at all. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰੀ ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: ridh sidh jaa kau furee tab kaahoo siau kiaa kaaj ||
verses.translation: You have riches and miraculous spiritual powers; so what business do you have with anyone else?

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਮੈ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਬਡ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tere kahane kee gat kiaa kahau mai bolat hee badd laaj ||1||
verses.translation: What should I say about the reality of your talk? I am embarrassed even to speak to you. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raam jeh paiaa raam ||
verses.translation: One who has found the Lord,

verses.original: ਤੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: te bhaveh na baarai baar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: does not wander from door to door. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਜਗੁ ਡਹਕੈ ਘਨਾ ਦਿਨ ਦੁਇ ਬਰਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa jag ddahakai ghanaa dhin dhui baratan kee aas ||
verses.translation: The false world wanders all around, in hopes of finding wealth to use for a few days.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam udhak jeh jan peeaa teh bahur na bhiee piaas ||2||
verses.translation: That humble being, who drinks in the Lord's water, never becomes thirsty again. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਿਹ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh jeh boojhiaa aasaa te bhiaa niraas ||
verses.translation: Whoever understands, by Guru's Grace, becomes free of hope in the midst of hope.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਉ ਆਤਮ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh sach nadharee aaiaa jau aatam bhiaa udhaas ||3||
verses.translation: One comes to see the Lord everywhere, when the soul becomes detached. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ras chaakhiaa har naamaa har taar ||
verses.translation: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name carries everyone across.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ka(n)chan bhiaa bhram giaa samudhrai paar ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have become like gold; doubt is dispelled, and I have crossed over the world-ocean. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਉਦਕ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਲਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਖਿਆ ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: audhak samu(n)dh salal kee saakhiaa nadhee tara(n)g samaavahige ||
verses.translation: Like drops of water in the water of the ocean, and like waves in the stream, I merge in the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨਹਿ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: su(n)neh su(n)n miliaa samadharasee pavan roop hoi jaavahige ||1||
verses.translation: Merging my being into the Absolute Being of God, I have become impartial and transparent, like the air. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਹਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: bahur ham kaahe aavahige ||
verses.translation: Why should I come into the world again?

verses.original: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa hukam tisai kaa hukamai bujh samaavahige ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Coming and going is by the Hukam of His Command; realizing His Hukam, I shall merge in Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jab chookai pa(n)ch dhaat kee rachanaa aaise bharam chukaavahige ||
verses.translation: When the body, formed of the five elements, perishes, then any such doubts shall end.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਏ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharasan chhodd bhe samadharasee eko naam dhiaavahige ||2||
verses.translation: Giving up the different schools of philosophy, I look upon all equally; I meditate only on the One Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਤ ਹਮ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jit ham laae tit hee laage taise karam kamaavahige ||
verses.translation: Whatever I am attached to, to that I am attached; such are the deeds I do.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਤੌ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jee kirapaa kare jau apanee tau gur ke sabadh samaavahige ||3||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then I am merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹੁ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marahu marahu fun jeevahu punarap janam na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Die while yet alive, and by so dying, be alive; thus you shall not be reborn again.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jo naam samaane su(n)n rahiaa liv soiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, whoever is absorbed in the Naam remains lovingly absorbed in the Primal, Absolute Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jau tum(h) mo kau dhoor karat hau tau tum mukat bataavahu ||
verses.translation: If You keep me far away from You, then tell me, what is liberation?

verses.original: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਭਰਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek anek hoi rahio sagal meh ab kaise bharamaavahu ||1||
verses.translation: The One has many forms, and is contained within all; how can I be fooled now? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam mo kau taar kahaa(n) lai jiee hai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, where will You take me, to save me?

verses.original: ਸੋਧਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਦੇਉ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sodhau mukat kahaa dheau kaisee kar prasaadh moh paiee hai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Tell me where, and what sort of liberation shall You give me? By Your Grace, I have already obtained it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨੁ ਤਬੈ ਲਗੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: taaran taran tabai lag kaheeaai jab lag tat na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: People talk of salvation and being saved, as long as they do not understand the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਭਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: ab tau bimal bhe ghaT hee meh keh kabeer man maaniaa ||2||5||
verses.translation: I have now become pure within my heart, says Kabeer, and my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਕੀਏ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸੋ ਰਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin gaR koT ke'ee ka(n)chan ke chhodd giaa so raavan ||1||
verses.translation: Raawan made castles and fortresses of gold, but he had to abandon them when he left. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀਜਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe keejat hai man bhaavan ||
verses.translation: Why do you act only to please your mind?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਕੇਸ ਤੇ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab jam aai kes te pakarai teh har ko naam chhaddaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When Death comes and grabs you by the hair, then only the Name of the Lord will save you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਕਾਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੑਾ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਬਧਾਵਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaal akaal khasam kaa keen(h)aa ih parapa(n)ch badhaavan ||
verses.translation: Death, and deathlessness are the creations of our Lord and Master; this show, this expanse, is only an entanglement.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer te a(n)te mukate jin(h) hiradhai raam rasain ||2||6||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those who have the sublime essence of the Lord in their hearts - in the end, they are liberated. ||2||6||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੀਉ ਧਰ ਮਹਤਉ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਿਰਸਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee gaavaa jeeau dhar mahatau baseh pa(n)ch kirasaanaa ||
verses.translation: The body is a village, and the soul is the owner and farmer; the five farm-hands live there.

verses.original: ਨੈਨੂ ਨਕਟੂ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੂ ਰਸਪਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nainoo nakaToo sravanoo rasapat i(n)dhree kahiaa na maanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The eyes, nose, ears, tongue and sensory organs of touch do not obey any order. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਬ ਨ ਬਸਉ ਇਹ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa ab na basau ieh gaau ||
verses.translation: O father, now I shall not live in this village.

verses.original: ਘਰੀ ਘਰੀ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਾਇਥੁ ਚੇਤੂ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gharee gharee kaa lekhaa maagai kaith chetoo naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The accountants summoned Chitar and Gupat, the recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, to ask for an account of each and every moment. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਬਾਕੀ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai jab lekhaa maagai baakee nikasee bhaaree ||
verses.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for my account, there shall be a very heavy balance against me.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਵਾ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਲੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜੀਉ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch kirasaanavaa bhaag ge lai baadhio jeeau dharabaaree ||2||
verses.translation: The five farm-hands shall then run away, and the bailiff shall arrest the soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਖੇਤ ਹੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu khet hee karahu niberaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: settle your accounts in this farm.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: ab kee baar bakhas ba(n)dhe kau bahur na bhaujal feraa ||3||7||
verses.translation: O Lord, please forgive Your slave now, in this life, so that he may not have to return again to this terrifying world-ocean. ||3||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag maaroo baanee kabeer jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਨਭਉ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: anabhau kinai na dhekhiaa bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: No one has seen the Fearless Lord, O renunciate.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਅਨਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin bhai anabhau hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, how can the Fearless Lord be obtained? ||1||

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: sahu hadhoor dhekhai taa(n) bhau pavai bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: If one sees the Presence of his Husband Lord near at hand, then he feels the Fear of God, O renunciate.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hukamai boojhai ta nirabhau hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||2||
verses.translation: If he realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he becomes fearless. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: har paakha(n)dd na keejiee bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: Don't practice hypocrisy with the Lord, O renunciate!

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd rataa sabh lok vanaaha(n)bai ||3||
verses.translation: The whole world is filled with hypocrisy. ||3||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa paas na chhoddiee bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: Thirst and desire do not just go away, O renunciate.

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mamataa jaaliaa pi(n)dd vanaaha(n)bai ||4||
verses.translation: The body is burning in the fire of worldly love and attachment. ||4||

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa jaal tan jaaliaa bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: Anxiety is burned, and the body is burned, O renunciate,

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: je man mritak hoi vanaaha(n)bai ||5||
verses.translation: only if one lets his mind become dead. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bin bairaag na hoviee bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, there can be no renunciation,

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: je lochai sabh koi vanaaha(n)bai ||6||
verses.translation: even though all the people may wish for it. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: karam hovai satigur milai bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: When God grants His Grace, one meets the True Guru, O renunciate,

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sahaje paavai soi vanaaha(n)bai ||7||
verses.translation: and automatically, intuitively finds that Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ik benatee bairaageeaRe ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I offer this one prayer, O renunciate.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਵਣਾਹੰਬੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: mo kau bhaujal paar utaar vanaaha(n)bai ||8||1||8||
verses.translation: Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||1||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਨ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: raajan kaun tumaarai aavai ||
verses.translation: O king, who will come to you?

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਦਰ ਕੋ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso bhaau bidhar ko dhekhio oh gareeb moh bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have seen such love from Bidur, that the poor man is pleasing to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਸਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਰਮ ਤੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hasatee dhekh bharam te bhoolaa sree bhagavaan na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon your elephants, you have gone astray in doubt; you do not know the Great Lord God.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਕੋ ਪਾਨੑੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaro dhoodh bidhar ko paan(h)o a(n)mrit kar mai maaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: I judge Bidur's water to be like ambrosial nectar, in comparison with your milk. ||1||

verses.original: ਖੀਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kheer samaan saag mai paiaa gun gaavat rain bihaanee ||
verses.translation: I find his rough vegetables to be like rice pudding; the night of my life passes singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: kabeer ko Thaakur anadh binodhee jaat na kaahoo kee maanee ||2||9||
verses.translation: Kabeer's Lord and Master is joyous and blissful; He does not care about anyone's social class. ||2||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: salok kabeer ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Kabeer:

verses.original: ਗਗਨ ਦਮਾਮਾ ਬਾਜਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ਘਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gagan dhamaamaa baajio pario neesaanai ghaau ||
verses.translation: The battle-drum beats in the sky of the mind; aim is taken, and the wound is inflicted.

verses.original: ਖੇਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਂਡਿਓ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਅਬ ਜੂਝਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khetu ju maa(n)ddio sooramaa ab joojhan ko dhaau ||1||
verses.translation: The spiritual warriors enter the field of battle; now is the time to fight! ||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ਜੁ ਲਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: sooraa so pahichaaneeaai ju larai dheen ke het ||
verses.translation: He alone is known as a spiritual hero, who fights in defense of those in need.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਜਾ ਪੁਰਜਾ ਕਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: purajaa purajaa kaT marai kabahoo na chhaaddai khet ||2||2||
verses.translation: He may be cut apart, piece by piece, but he never leaves the field of battle. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: kabeer kaa sabadh raag maaroo baanee naamadheau jee kee
verses.translation: Shabad Of Kabeer, Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਚਾਰੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਦੂਲਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: chaar mukat chaarai sidh mil kai dhooleh prabh kee saran pario ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the four kinds of liberation, and the four miraculous spiritual powers, in the Sanctuary of God, my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਚਉਹੂੰ ਜੁਗ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukat bhio chauhoo(n) jug jaanio jas keerat maathai chhatr dhario ||1||
verses.translation: I am liberated, and famous throughout the four ages; the canopy of praise and fame waves over my head. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam japat ko ko na tario ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Sovereign Lord God, who has not been saved?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes saadh kee sa(n)gat bhagat bhagat taa ko naam pario ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings and joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is called the most devoted of the devotees. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kh chakar maalaa tilak biraajit dhekh prataap jam ddario ||
verses.translation: He is adorned with the conch, the chakra, the mala and the ceremonial tilak mark on his forehead; gazing upon his radiant glory, the Messenger of Death is scared away.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਬਲ ਗਰਜਿਤ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਹਿਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe raam bal garajit janam maran sa(n)taap hirio ||2||
verses.translation: He becomes fearless, and the power of the Lord thunders through him; the pains of birth and death are taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਭਭੀਖਨ ਅਧਿਕ ਕਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)bareek kau dheeo abhai padh raaj bhabheekhan adhik kario ||
verses.translation: The Lord blessed Ambreek with fearless dignity, and elevated Bhabhikhan to become king.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦਈ ਸੁਦਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨ ਟਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nau nidh Thaakur dhiee sudhaamai dhraooa aTal ajahoo na Tario ||3||
verses.translation: Sudama's Lord and Master blessed him with the nine treasures; he made Dhroo permanent and unmoving; as the north star, he still hasn't moved. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਹੇਤਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹ ਧਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat het maario haranaakhas narasi(n)gh roop hoi dheh dhario ||
verses.translation: For the sake of His devotee Prahlaad, God assumed the form of the man-lion, and killed Harnaakhash.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੇਸਵ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਬਲਿ ਕੇ ਦੁਆਰ ਖਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naamaa kahai bhagat bas kesav ajahoo(n) bal ke dhuaar kharo ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, the beautiful-haired Lord is in the power of His devotees; He is standing at Balraja's door, even now! ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo kabeer jeeau ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਦੀਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਦੀਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dheen bisaario re dhivaane dheen bisaario re ||
verses.translation: You have forgotten your religion, O madman; you have forgotten your religion.

verses.original: ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਪਸੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: peT bhario pasooaa jiau soio manukh janam hai haario ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You fill your belly, and sleep like an animal; you have wasted and lost this human life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਰਚਿਓ ਧੰਧੈ ਝੂਠ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kabahoo nahee keenee rachio dha(n)dhai jhooTh ||
verses.translation: You never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. You are engrossed in false pursuits.

verses.original: ਸੁਆਨ ਸੂਕਰ ਬਾਇਸ ਜਿਵੈ ਭਟਕਤੁ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਊਠਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: suaan sookar bais jivai bhaTakat chaalio uooTh ||1||
verses.translation: You wander like a dog, a pig, a crow; soon, you shall have to get up and leave. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰਨ ਕਉ ਲਗ ਮਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: aapas kau dheeragh kar jaanai aauran kau lag maat ||
verses.translation: You believe that you yourself are great, and that others are small.

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਬਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਨਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਦੋਜਕ ਜਾਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manasaa baachaa karamanaa mai dhekhe dhojak jaat ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are false in thought, word and deed, I have seen them going to hell. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੀ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਬੇਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kaamee karodhee chaaturee baajeegar bekaam ||
verses.translation: The lustful, the angry, the clever, the deceitful and the lazy

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa karate janam siraano kabahoo na simario raam ||3||
verses.translation: waste their lives in slander, and never remember their Lord in meditation. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer chetai nahee moorakh mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the fools, the idiots and the brutes do not remember the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam jaanio nahee kaise utaras paar ||4||1||
verses.translation: They do not know the Lord's Name; how can they be carried across? ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag maaroo baanee jaidheau jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Jai Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚੰਦ ਸਤ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਨਾਦ ਸਤ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੂਰ ਸਤ ਖੋੜਸਾ ਦਤੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sat bhedhiaa naadh sat pooriaa soor sat khoRasaa dhat keeaa ||
verses.translation: The breath is drawn in through the left nostril; it is held in the central channel of the Sushmanaa, and exhaled through the right nostril, repeating the Lord's Name sixteen times.

verses.original: ਅਬਲ ਬਲੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ਅਚਲ ਚਲੁ ਥਪਿਆ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਆ ਤਹਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: abal bal toRiaa achal chal thapiaa aghaR ghaRiaa tahaa apiau peeaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am powerless; my power has been broken. My unstable mind has been stabliized, and my unadorned soul has been adorned. I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਆਦਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man aadh gun aadh vakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Within my mind, I chant the Name of the Primal Lord God, the Source of virtue.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree dhubidhaa dhirasaT sa(n)maaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My vision, that You are I are separate, has melted away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਰਧਿ ਕਉ ਅਰਧਿਆ ਸਰਧਿ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਸਲਲ ਕਉ ਸਲਲਿ ਸੰਮਾਨਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aradh kau aradhiaa saradh kau saradhiaa salal kau salal sa(n)maan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I worship the One who is worthy of being worshipped. I trust the One who is worthy of being trusted. Like water merging in water, I merge in the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਦਤਿ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਕਉ ਰੰਮਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: badhat jaidheau jaidhev kau ra(n)miaa braham nirabaan liv leen paiaa ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Jai Dayv, I meditate and contemplate the Luminous, Triumphant Lord. I am lovingly absorbed in the Nirvaanaa of God. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥ ਮਾਰੂ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer || maaroo ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, Maaroo:

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿਗਾ ਮਨ ॥
verses.translit: raam simar pachhutaahigaa man ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, or else you will regret it in the end, O mind.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paapee jeearaa lobh karat hai aaj kaal uTh jaahigaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O sinful soul, you act in greed, but today or tomorrow, you will have to get up and leave. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: laalach laage janam gavaiaa maiaa bharam bhulaahigaa ||
verses.translation: Clinging to greed, you have wasted your life, deluded in the doubt of Maya.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਗਦ ਜਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan joban kaa garab na keejai kaagadh jiau gal jaahigaa ||1||
verses.translation: Do not take pride in your wealth and youth; you shall crumble apart like dry paper. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਪਟਕੈ ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jau jam aai kes geh paTakai taa dhin kichh na basaahigaa ||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by the hair, and knocks you down, on that day, you shall be powerless.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simaran bhajan dhiaa nahee keenee tau mukh choTaa khaahigaa ||2||
verses.translation: You do not remember the Lord, or vibrate upon Him in meditation, and you do not practice compassion; you shall be beaten on your face. ||2||

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai jab lekhaa maagai kiaa mukh lai kai jaahigaa ||
verses.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for your account, what face will you show Him then?

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿਗਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu saadhasa(n)gat tar jaa(n)higaa ||3||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag maaroo baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਲਾਲ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee laal tujh bin kaun karai ||
verses.translation: O Love, who else but You could do such a thing?

verses.original: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gareeb nivaaj gusieeaa meraa maathai chhatr dharai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Patron of the poor, Lord of the World, You have put the canopy of Your Grace over my head. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਛੋਤਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਪਰ ਤੁਹਂੀ ਢਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee chhot jagat kau laagai taa par tuha(n)ee ddarai ||
verses.translation: Only You can grant Mercy to that person whose touch pollutes the world.

verses.original: ਨੀਚਹ ਊਚ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਨ ਡਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: neecheh uooch karai meraa gobi(n)dh kaahoo te na ddarai ||1||
verses.translation: You exalt and elevate the lowly, O my Lord of the Universe; You are not afraid of anyone. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਧਨਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naamadhev kabeer tilochan sadhanaa sain tarai ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan, Sadhana and Sain crossed over.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas sunahu re sa(n)tahu har jeeau te sabhai sarai ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, listen, O Saints, through the Dear Lord, all is accomplished. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo ||
verses.translation: Maaroo:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਰਿਤਰੁ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar suritar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke re ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the jewel of miracles and the wish-fulfilling cow are all under His power.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath asaT mahaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa kai ||1||
verses.translation: The four great blessings, the eight great miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures are in the palm of His hand. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har har na japas rasanaa ||
verses.translation: Why don't you chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har?

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਛਾਡਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar sabh chhaadd bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon all other devices of words. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਛਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa khiaan puraan bedh bidh chautees achhar maahee ||
verses.translation: The many epics, the Puraanas and the Vedas are all composed out of the letters of the alphabet.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਸ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: biaas beechaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
verses.translation: After careful thought, Vyaasa spoke the supreme truth, that there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat hoi badde bhaag liv laagee ||
verses.translation: In intuitive Samaadhi, their troubles are eliminated; the very fortunate ones lovingly focus on the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas udhaas dhaas mat janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||2||15||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord's slave remains detached from the world; the fear of birth and death runs away from his mind. ||3||2||15||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ
verses.translit: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa baareh maahaa
verses.translation: Tukhaari Chhant, First Mehla, Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too sun kirat kara(n)maa purab kamaiaa || sir sir sukh saha(n)maa dheh su too bhalaa ||
verses.translation: Listen: according to the karma of their past actions, each and every person experiences happiness or sorrow; whatever You give, Lord, is good.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: har rachanaa teree kiaa gat meree har bin ghaRee na jeevaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, the Created Universe is Yours; what is my condition? Without the Lord, I cannot survive, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਾਝੁ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: pria baajh dhuhelee koi na belee gurmukh a(n)mrit peevaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Without my Beloved, I am miserable; I have no friend at all. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: rachanaa raach rahe nira(n)kaaree prabh man karam sukaramaa ||
verses.translation: The Formless Lord is contained in His Creation. To obey God is the best course of action.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pa(n)th nihaale saa dhan too sun aatam raamaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride is gazing upon Your Path; please listen, O Supreme Soul. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa priau bole kokil baaneeaa ||
verses.translation: The rainbird cries out, ""Pri-o! Beloved!"", and the song-bird sings the Lord's Bani.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਚੋਲੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan sabh ras cholai a(n)k samaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride enjoys all the pleasures, and merges in the Being of her Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)k samaanee jaa prabh bhaanee saa sohaagan naare ||
verses.translation: She merges into the Being of her Beloved, when she becomes pleasing to God; she is the happy, blessed soul-bride.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਘਰ ਥਾਪਿ ਮਹਲ ਘਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nav ghar thaap mahal ghar uoochau nij ghar vaas muraare ||
verses.translation: Establishing the nine houses, and the Royal Mansion of the Tenth Gate above them, the Lord dwells in that home deep within the self.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teree too meraa preetam nis baasur ra(n)g raavai ||
verses.translation: All are Yours, You are my Beloved; night and day, I celebrate Your Love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak priau priau chavai babeehaa kokil sabadh suhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the rainbird cries out, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!"" The song-bird is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: too sun har ras bhi(n)ne preetam aapane ||
verses.translation: Please listen, O my Beloved Lord - I am drenched with Your Love.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਤ ਰਵੰਨੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan ravat rava(n)ne ghaRee na beesarai ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are absorbed in dwelling on You; I cannot forget You, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਘੜੀ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kiau ghaRee bisaaree hau balihaaree hau jeevaa gun gaae ||
verses.translation: How could I forget You, even for an instant? I am a sacrifice to You; singing Your Glorious Praises, I live.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naa koiee meraa hau kis keraa har bin rahan na jaae ||
verses.translation: No one is mine; unto whom do I belong? Without the Lord, I cannot survive.

verses.original: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੇ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: oT gahee har charan nivaase bhe pavitr sareeraa ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Support of the Lord's Feet; dwelling there, my body has become immaculate.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhirasaT dheeragh sukh paavai gur sabadhee man dheeraa ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have obtained profound insight, and found peace; my mind is comforted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: barasai a(n)mirat dhaar boo(n)dh suhaavanee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down on us! Its drops are so delightful!

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan mile sahaj subhai har siau preet banee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, the Best Friend, with intuitive ease, the mortal falls in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਨ ਊਭੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar aavai jaa prabh bhaavai dhan uoobhee gun saaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord comes into the temple of the body, when it pleases God's Will; the soul-bride rises up, and sings His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar ka(n)t ravai sohaagan hau kiau ka(n)t visaaree ||
verses.translation: In each and every home, the Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; so why has He forgotten me?

verses.original: ਉਨਵਿ ਘਨ ਛਾਏ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aunav ghan chhaae baras subhaae man tan prem sukhaavai ||
verses.translation: The sky is overcast with heavy, low-hanging clouds; the rain is delightful, and my Beloved's Love is pleasing to my mind and body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak varasai a(n)mirat baanee kar kirapaa ghar aavai ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar of Gurbani rains down; the Lord, in His Grace, has come into the home of my heart. ||4||

verses.original: ਚੇਤੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਭਵਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: chet basa(n)t bhalaa bhavar suhaavaRe ||
verses.translation: In the month of Chayt, the lovely spring has come, and the bumble bees hum with joy.

verses.original: ਬਨ ਫੂਲੇ ਮੰਝ ਬਾਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ban foole ma(n)jh baar mai pir ghar baahuRai ||
verses.translation: The forest is blossoming in front of my door; if only my Beloved would return to my home!

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਧਨ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: pir ghar nahee aavai dhan kiau sukh paavai bireh birodh tan chheejai ||
verses.translation: If her Husband Lord does not return home, how can the soul-bride find peace? Her body is wasting away with the sorrow of separation.

verses.original: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਅੰਬਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kokil a(n)b suhaavee bolai kiau dhukh a(n)k saheejai ||
verses.translation: The beautiful song-bird sings, perched on the mango tree; but how can I endure the pain in the depths of my being?

verses.original: ਭਵਰੁ ਭਵੰਤਾ ਫੂਲੀ ਡਾਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhavar bhava(n)taa foolee ddaalee kiau jeevaa mar maae ||
verses.translation: The bumble bee is buzzing around the flowering branches; but how can I survive? I am dying, O my mother!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak chet sahaj sukh paavai je har var ghar dhan paae ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in Chayt, peace is easily obtained, if the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, within the home of her own heart. ||5||

verses.original: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਭਲਾ ਸਾਖਾ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaisaakh bhalaa saakhaa ves kare ||
verses.translation: Vaisakhi is so pleasant; the branches blossom with new leaves.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhekhai har dhuaar aavahu dhiaa kare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride yearns to see the Lord at her door. Come, O Lord, and take pity on me!

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੁਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਮੋਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: ghar aau piaare dhutar taare tudh bin add na molo ||
verses.translation: Please come home, O my Beloved; carry me across the treacherous world-ocean. Without You, I am not worth even a shell.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਕਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾਂ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਢੋਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kaun kare tudh bhaavaa(n) dhekh dhikhaavai ddolo ||
verses.translation: Who can estimate my worth, if I am pleasing to You? I see You, and inspire others to see You, O my Love.

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoor na jaanaa a(n)tar maanaa har kaa mahal pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: I know that You are not far away; I believe that You are deep within me, and I realize Your Presence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੈਸਾਖੀਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak vaisaakhee(n) prabh paavai surat sabadh man maanaa ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, finding God in Vaisakhi, the consciousness is filled with the Word of the Shabad, and the mind comes to believe. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਹੁ ਜੇਠੁ ਭਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: maahu jeTh bhalaa preetam kiau bisarai ||
verses.translation: The month of Jayt'h is so sublime. How could I forget my Beloved?

verses.original: ਥਲ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਸਰ ਭਾਰ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: thal taapeh sar bhaar saa dhan binau karai ||
verses.translation: The earth burns like a furnace, and the soul-bride offers her prayer.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan binau karedhee gun saaredhee gun saaree prabh bhaavaa ||
verses.translation: The bride offers her prayer, and sings His Glorious Praises; singing His Praises, she becomes pleasing to God.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਵਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਆਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachai mahal rahai bairaagee aavan dheh ta aavaa ||
verses.translation: The Unattached Lord dwells in His true mansion. If He allows me, then I will come to Him.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਨਿਤਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: nimaanee nitaanee har bin kiau paavai sukh mahalee ||
verses.translation: The bride is dishonored and powerless; how will she find peace without her Lord?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਠਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿਲੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak jeTh jaanai tis jaisee karam milai gun gahilee ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in Jayt'h, she who knows her Lord becomes just like Him; grasping virtue, she meets with the Merciful Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਗਗਨਿ ਤਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aasaaR bhalaa sooraj gagan tapai ||
verses.translation: The month of Aasaarh is good; the sun blazes in the sky.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee dhookh sahai sokhai agan bhakhai ||
verses.translation: The earth suffers in pain, parched and roasted in the fire.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਧੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: agan ras sokhai mareeaai dhokhai bhee so kirat na haare ||
verses.translation: The fire dries up the moisture, and she dies in agony. But even then, the sun does not grow tired.

verses.original: ਰਥੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਤਾਕੈ ਟੀਡੁ ਲਵੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: rath firai chhaiaa dhan taakai Teedd lavai ma(n)jh baare ||
verses.translation: His chariot moves on, and the soul-bride seeks shade; the crickets are chirping in the forest.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਬਾਧਿ ਚਲੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: avagan baadh chalee dhukh aagai sukh tis saach samaale ||
verses.translation: She ties up her bundle of faults and demerits, and suffers in the world hereafter. But dwelling on the True Lord, she finds peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jis no ih man dheeaa maran jeevan prabh naale ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have given this mind to Him; death and life rest with God. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸ ਮਨਾ ਘਣ ਵਰਸਹਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: saavan saras manaa ghan varaseh rut aae ||
verses.translation: In Saawan, be happy, O my mind. The rainy season has come, and the clouds have burst into showers.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan sahu bhaavai pir paradhes sidhaae ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are pleased by my Lord, but my Beloved has gone away.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pir ghar nahee aavai mareeaai haavai dhaaman chamak ddaraae ||
verses.translation: My Beloved has not come home, and I am dying of the sorrow of separation. The lightning flashes, and I am scared.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sej ikelee kharee dhuhelee maran bhiaa dhukh maae ||
verses.translation: My bed is lonely, and I am suffering in agony. I am dying in pain, O my mother!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਭੂਖ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: har bin needh bhookh kahu kaisee kaapaR tan na sukhaave ||
verses.translation: Tell me - without the Lord, how can I sleep, or feel hungry? My clothes give no comfort to my body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕੰਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak saa sohaagan ka(n)tee pir kai a(n)k samaave ||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she alone is a happy soul-bride, who merges in the Being of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਭਾਦਉ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhaadhau bharam bhulee bhar joban pachhutaanee ||
verses.translation: In Bhaadon, the young woman is confused by doubt; later, she regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਰਸ ਰੁਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal neer bhare baras rute ra(n)g maanee ||
verses.translation: The lakes and fields are overflowing with water; the rainy season has come - the time to celebrate!

verses.original: ਬਰਸੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਲੀ ਦਾਦਰ ਮੋਰ ਲਵੰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: barasai nis kaalee kiau sukh baalee dhaadhar mor lava(n)te ||
verses.translation: In the dark of night it rains; how can the young bride find peace? The frogs and peacocks send out their noisy calls.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਡਸੰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: priau priau chavai babeehaa bole bhuia(n)gam fireh ddasa(n)te ||
verses.translation: "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" cries the rainbird, while the snakes slither around, biting.

verses.original: ਮਛਰ ਡੰਗ ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: machhar dda(n)g sair bhar subhar bin har kiau sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The mosquitoes bite and sting, and the ponds are filled to overflowing; without the Lord, how can she find peace?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਛਿ ਚਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਹ ਹੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak poochh chalau gur apune jeh prabh teh hee jaieeaai ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I will go and ask my Guru; wherever God is, there I will go. ||10||

verses.original: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਆਉ ਪਿਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਝੂਰਿ ਮੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: asun aau piraa saa dhan jhoor muiee ||
verses.translation: In Assu, come, my Beloved; the soul-bride is grieving to death.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa mileeaai prabh mele dhoojai bhai khuiee ||
verses.translation: She can only meet Him, when God leads her to meet Him; she is ruined by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀ ਕੁਕਹ ਕਾਹ ਸਿ ਫੁਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh vigutee taa pir mutee kukeh kaeh s fule ||
verses.translation: If she is plundered by falsehood, then her Beloved forsakes her. Then, the white flowers of old age blossom in my hair.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਘਾਮ ਪਿਛੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਜਾਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: aagai ghaam pichhai rut jaaddaa dhekh chalat man ddole ||
verses.translation: Summer is now behind us, and the winter season is ahead. Gazing upon this play, my shaky mind wavers.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸਾਖ ਹਰੀ ਹਰੀਆਵਲ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਕੈ ਸੋ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis saakh haree hareeaaval sahaj pakai so meeThaa ||
verses.translation: In all ten directions, the branches are green and alive. That which ripens slowly, is sweet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸੁਨਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak asun milahu piaare satigur bhe baseeThaa ||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in Assu, please meet me, my Beloved. The True Guru has become my Advocate and Friend. ||11||

verses.original: ਕਤਕਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: katak kirat piaa jo prabh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: In Katak, that alone comes to pass, which is pleasing to the Will of God.

verses.original: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਲੈ ਤਤਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheepak sahaj balai tat jalaiaa ||
verses.translation: The lamp of intuition burns, lit by the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਦੀਪਕ ਰਸ ਤੇਲੋ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲੋ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੈ ਸਰਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheepak ras telo dhan pir melo dhan omaahai sarasee ||
verses.translation: Love is the oil in the lamp, which unites the soul-bride with her Lord. The bride is delighted, in ecstasy.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਮਾਰੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਮਾਰੀ ਤਾ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: avagan maaree marai na seejhai gun maaree taa marasee ||
verses.translation: One who dies in faults and demerits - her death is not successful. But one who dies in glorious virtue, really truly dies.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਅਜਹੁ ਤਿਨਾੜੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam bhagat dhe nij ghar baiThe ajahu tinaaRee aasaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with devotional worship of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sit in the home of their own inner being. They place their hopes in You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਕਪਟ ਦਰ ਖੋਲਹੁ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਖਟੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak milahu kapaT dhar kholahu ek ghaRee khaT maasaa ||12||
verses.translation: Nanak: please open the shutters of Your Door, O Lord, and meet me. A single moment is like six months to me. ||12||

verses.original: ਮੰਘਰ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ghar maahu bhalaa har gun a(n)k samaave ||
verses.translation: The month of Maghar is good, for those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merge in His Being.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee gun ravai mai pir nihachal bhaave ||
verses.translation: The virtuous wife utters His Glorious Praises; my Beloved Husband Lord is Eternal and Unchanging.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal chatur sujaan bidhaataa cha(n)chal jagat sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord is Unmoving and Unchanging, Clever and Wise; all the world is fickle.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੇ ਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan gun a(n)k samaane prabh bhaane taa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: By virtue of spiritual wisdom and meditation, she merges in His Being; she is pleasing to God, and He is pleasing to her.

verses.original: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਵੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: geet naadh kavit kave sun raam naam dhukh bhaagai ||
verses.translation: I have heard the songs and the music, and the poems of the poets; but only the Name of the Lord takes away my pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਅਭ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਆਗੈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan naeh piaaree abh bhagatee pir aagai ||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who performs loving devotional worship before her Beloved. ||13||

verses.original: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਪੜੈ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: pokh tukhaar paRai van tiran ras sokhai ||
verses.translation: In Poh, the snow falls, and the sap of the trees and the fields dries up.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੁਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: aavat kee naahee man tan vaseh mukhe ||
verses.translation: Why have You not come? I keep You in my mind, body and mouth.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rav rahiaa jagajeevan gur sabadhee ra(n)g maanee ||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body; He is the Life of the World. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj ghaT ghaT jot samaanee ||
verses.translation: His Light fills all those born of eggs, born from the womb, born of sweat and born of the earth, each and every heart.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dheh dhiaapat dhaate gat paavau mat dheho ||
verses.translation: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Lord of Mercy and Compassion. O Great Giver, grant me understanding, that I might find salvation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੋ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ra(n)g ravai ras raseeaa har siau preet saneho ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord enjoys, savors and ravishes the bride who is in love with Him. ||14||

verses.original: ਮਾਘਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maagh puneet bhiee teerath a(n)tar jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: In Maagh, I become pure; I know that the sacred shrine of pilgrimage is within me.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saajan sahaj mile gun geh a(n)k samaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I have met my Friend with intuitive ease; I grasp His Glorious Virtues, and merge in His Being.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੰਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: preetam gun a(n)ke sun prabh ba(n)ke tudh bhaavaa sar naavaa ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, Beauteous Lord God, please listen: I sing Your Glories, and merge in Your Being. If it is pleasing to Your Will, I bathe in the sacred pool within.

verses.original: ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਤਹ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)g jamun teh benee sa(n)gam saat samu(n)dh samaavaa || pu(n)n dhaan poojaa paramesur jug jug eko jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Ganges, Jamunaa, the sacred meeting place of the three rivers, the seven seas, charity, donations, adoration and worship all rest in the Transcendent Lord God; throughout the ages, I realize the One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਘਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak maagh mahaa ras har jap aThasaTh teerath naataa ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in Maagh, the most sublime essence is meditation on the Lord; this is the cleansing bath of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||15||

verses.original: ਫਲਗੁਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: falagun man rahasee prem subhaiaa ||
verses.translation: In Phalgun, her mind is enraptured, pleased by the Love of her Beloved.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin rahas bhiaa aap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, she is enraptured, and her selfishness is gone.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਓ ॥
verses.translit: man moh chukaiaa jaa tis bhaiaa kar kirapaa ghar aao ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment is eradicated from her mind, when it pleases Him; in His Mercy, He comes to my home.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮਹਲੀ ਲਹਾ ਨ ਥਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: bahute ves karee pir baajhahu mahalee lahaa na thaao ||
verses.translation: I dress in various clothes, but without my Beloved, I shall not find a place in the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਰਸ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਪਿਰਿ ਲੋੜੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: haar ddor ras paaT paTa(n)bar pir loRee seegaaree ||
verses.translation: I have adorned myself with garlands of flowers, pearl necklaces, scented oils and silk robes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak mel liee gur apanai ghar var paiaa naaree ||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Guru has united me with Him. The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, within the home of her own heart. ||16||

verses.original: ਬੇ ਦਸ ਮਾਹ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਭਲੇ ॥ ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: be dhas maeh rutee thitee vaar bhale || ghaRee moorat pal saache aae sahaj mile ||
verses.translation: The twelve months, the seasons, the weeks, the days, the hours, the minutes and the seconds are all sublime, when the True Lord comes and meets her with natural ease.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mile piaare kaaraj saare karataa sabh bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: God, my Beloved, has met me, and my affairs are all resolved. The Creator Lord knows all ways and means.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin seegaaree tiseh piaaree mel bhiaa ra(n)g maanai ||
verses.translation: I am loved by the One who has embellished and exalted me; I have met Him, and I savor His Love.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: ghar sej suhaavee jaa pir raavee gurmukh masatak bhaago ||
verses.translation: The bed of my heart becomes beautiful, when my Husband Lord ravishes me. As Gurmukh, the destiny on my forehead has been awakened and activated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ॥੧੭॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ahinis raavai preetam har var thir sohaago ||17||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, day and night, my Beloved enjoys me; with the Lord as my Husband, my Marriage is Eternal. ||17||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਨੈਣ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai paharai nain salonaRe'e rain a(n)dhiaaree raam ||
verses.translation: In the first watch of the dark night, O bride of splendored eyes,

verses.original: ਵਖਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: vakhar raakh muie'ee aavai vaaree raam ||
verses.translation: protect your riches; your turn is coming soon.

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਸੂਤੀ ਜਮ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਸਏ ॥
verses.translit: vaaree aavai kavan jagaavai sootee jam ras choose ||
verses.translation: When your turn comes, who will wake you? While you sleep, your juice shall be sucked out by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚੋਰੁ ਪੜੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਏ ॥
verses.translit: rain a(n)dheree kiaa pat teree chor paRai ghar moose ||
verses.translation: The night is so dark; what will become of your honor? The thieves will break into your home and rob you.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaaraa agam apaaraa sun bena(n)tee mereeaa ||
verses.translation: O Saviour Lord, Inaccessible and Infinite, please hear my prayer.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੂਝੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak moorakh kabeh na chetai kiaa soojhai rain a(n)dhereeaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the fool never remembers Him; what can he see in the dark of night? ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ਅਚੇਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa pahar bhiaa jaag achetee raam ||
verses.translation: The second watch has begun; wake up, you unconscious being!

verses.original: ਵਖਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਖਾਜੈ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: vakhar raakh muie'ee khaajai khetee raam ||
verses.translation: Protect your riches, O mortal; your farm is being eaten.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: raakhahu khetee har gur hetee jaagat chor na laagai ||
verses.translation: Protect your crops, and love the Lord, the Guru. Stay awake and aware, and the thieves shall not rob you.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jam mag na jaavahu naa dhukh paavahu jam kaa ddar bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: You shall not have to go on the path of Death, and you shall not suffer in pain; your fear and terror of death shall run away.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: rav sas dheepak gurmat dhuaarai man saachaa mukh dhiaave ||
