verses.translation: The lamps of the sun and the moon are lit by the Guru's Teachings, through His Door, meditating on the True Lord, in the mind and with the mouth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਿਵ ਦੂਜੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak moorakh ajahu na chetai kiv dhoojai sukh paave ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the fool still does not remember the Lord. How can he find peace in duality? ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਜਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਨੀਦ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: teejaa pahar bhiaa needh viaapee raam ||
verses.translation: The third watch has begun, and sleep has set in.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa sut dhaaraa dhookh sa(n)taapee raam ||
verses.translation: The mortal suffers in pain, from attachment to Maya, children and spouse.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa sut dhaaraa jagat piaaraa chog chugai nit faasai ||
verses.translation: Maya, his children, his wife and the world are so dear to him; he bites the bait, and is caught.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaavai taa sukh paavai gurmat kaal na graasai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he shall find peace; following the Guru's Teachings, he shall not be seized by death.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran kaal nahee chhoddai vin naavai sa(n)taapee ||
verses.translation: He cannot escape from birth, dying and death; without the Name, he suffers.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak teejai tirabidh lokaa maiaa moh viaapee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the third watch of the three-phased Maya, the world is engrossed in attachment to Maya. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਉਥਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਉਤੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: chauthaa pahar bhiaa dhaut bihaagai raam ||
verses.translation: The fourth watch has begun, and the day is about to dawn.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਜੋੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tin ghar raakhiaRaa juo anadhin jaagai raam ||
verses.translation: Those who remain awake and aware, night and day, preserve and protect their homes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poochh jaage naam laage tinaa rain suheleeaa ||
verses.translation: The night is pleasant and peaceful, for those who remain awake; following the Guru's advice, they focus on the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh kamaaveh janam na aaveh tinaa har prabh beleeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad are not reincarnated again; the Lord God is their Best Friend.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਕੰਪਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੰਪੈ ਨੈਣ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar ka(n)p charan sareer ka(n)pai nain a(n)dhule tan bhasam se ||
verses.translation: The hands shake, the feet and body totter, the vision goes dark, and the body turns to dust.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhukheeaa jug chaare bin naam har ke man vase ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, people are miserable throughout the four ages, if the Name of the Lord does not abide in the mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਖੂਲੀ ਗੰਠਿ ਉਠੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: khoolee ga(n)Th uTho likhiaa aaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The knot has been untied; rise up - the order has come!

verses.original: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸੁਖ ਠਾਕੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ras kas sukh Thaake ba(n)dh chalaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Pleasures and comforts are gone; like a prisoner, you are driven on.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dh chalaiaa jaa prabh bhaiaa naa dheesai naa suneeaai ||
verses.translation: You shall be bound and gagged, when it pleases God; you will not see or hear it coming.

verses.original: ਆਪਣ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਪਕੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਲੁਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aapan vaaree sabhasai aavai pakee khetee luneeaai ||
verses.translation: Everyone will have their turn; the crop ripens, and then it is cut down.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਚਸੇ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaRee chase kaa lekhaa leejai buraa bhalaa sahu jeeaa ||
verses.translation: The account is kept for every second, every instant; the soul suffers for the bad and the good.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sur nar sabadh milaae tin prabh kaaran keeaa ||5||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the angelic beings are united with the Word of the Shabad; this is the way God made it. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾਰਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਲੰਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: taaraa chaRiaa la(n)maa kiau nadhar nihaaliaa raam ||
verses.translation: The meteor shoots across the sky. How can it be seen with the eyes?

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sevak poor kara(n)maa satigur sabadh dhikhaaliaa raam ||
verses.translation: The True Guru reveals the Word of the Shabad to His servant who has such perfect karma.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh dhikhaaliaa sach samaaliaa ahinis dhekh beechaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru reveals the Shabad; dwelling on the True Lord, day and night, he beholds and reflects on God.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat pa(n)ch rahe ghar jaaniaa kaam karodh bikh maariaa ||
verses.translation: The five restless desires are restrained, and he knows the home of his own heart. He conquers sexual desire, anger and corruption.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਚੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot bhiee gur saakhee cheene raam kara(n)maa ||
verses.translation: His inner being is illuminated, by the Guru's Teachings; He beholds the Lord's play of karma.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਤਾਰਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਲੰਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak haumai maar pateene taaraa chaRiaa la(n)maa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, killing his ego, he is satisfied; the meteor has shot across the sky. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaag rahe chookee abhimaanee raam ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware; their egotistical pride is eradicated.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhor bhiaa saach samaanee raam ||
verses.translation: Night and day, it is dawn for them; they merge in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: saach samaanee gurmukh man bhaanee gurmukh saabat jaage ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are merged in the True Lord; they are pleasing to His Mind. The Gurmukhs are intact, safe and sound, awake and awake.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: saach naam a(n)mrit gur dheeaa har charanee liv laage ||
verses.translation: The Guru blesses them with the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTee jot jot meh jaataa manmukh bharam bhulaanee ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light is revealed, and in that Light, they achieve realization; the self-willed manmukhs wander in doubt and confusion.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhor bhiaa man maaniaa jaagat rain vihaanee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the dawn breaks, their minds are satisfied; they pass their life-night awake and aware. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aaugan veesariaa gunee ghar keeaa raam ||
verses.translation: Forgetting faults and demerits, virtue and merit enter one's home.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa avar na beeaa raam ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is permeating everywhere; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa soiee avar na koiee man hee te man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: He is All-pervading; there is no other. The mind comes to believe, from the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਘਟੁ ਘਟੁ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin jal thal tirabhavan ghaT ghaT thaapiaa so prabh gurmukh jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The One who established the water, the land, the three worlds, each and every heart - that God is known by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa tirabidh meT samaiee ||
verses.translation: The Infinite, All-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; erasing the three-phased Maya, we merge in Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਹ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak avagan guneh samaane aaisee gurmat paiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, then, demerits are dissolved by merits; such are the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe chookaa bholaa raam ||
verses.translation: My coming and going in reincarnation have ended; doubt and hesitation are gone.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar mile saachaa cholaa raam ||
verses.translation: Conquering my ego, I have met the True Lord, and now I wear the robe of Truth.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai gur khoiee paragaT hoiee chooke sog sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: The Guru has rid me of egotism; my sorrow and suffering are dispelled.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jotee a(n)dhar jot samaanee aap pachhaataa aapai ||
verses.translation: My light merges into the Light; I realize and understand my own self.

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai ghar sabadh pateenee saahuraRai pir bhaanee ||
verses.translation: In this world of my parents' home, I am satisfied with the Shabad; at my in-laws' home, in the world beyond, I shall be pleasing to my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋਕਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur mel milaiee chookee kaan lokaanee ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru has united me in His Union; my dependence on people has ended. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੋਲਾਵੜੈ ਭੁਲੀ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bholaavaRai bhulee bhul bhul pachhotaanee ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, misled and confused, the soul-bride later regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pir chhoddiaRee sutee pir kee saar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: Abandoning her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and does not appreciate His Worth.

verses.original: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਵਿਧਣ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir chhoddee sutee avagan mutee tis dhan vidhan raate ||
verses.translation: Leaving her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and is plundered by her faults and demerits. The night is so painful for this bride.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਲਗੀ ਤਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar vigutee haumai lagee taate ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and egotism destroy her. She burns in egotism.

verses.original: ਉਡਰਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਭਸਮੈ ਭਸਮ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: auddar ha(n)s chaliaa furamaiaa bhasamai bhasam samaanee ||
verses.translation: When the soul-swan flies away, by the Command of the Lord, her dust mingles with dust.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam vihoonee bhul bhul pachhotaanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, she is confused and deluded, and so she regrets and repents. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਕ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun naeh piaare ik bena(n)tee meree ||
verses.translation: Please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord, to my one prayer.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਅੜਾ ਹਉ ਰੁਲਿ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too nij ghar vasiaRaa hau rul bhasamai dderee ||
verses.translation: You dwell in the home of the self deep within, while I roll around like a dust-ball.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin apane naahai koi na chaahai kiaa kaheeaai kiaa keejai ||
verses.translation: Without my Husband Lord, no one likes me at all; what can I say or do now?

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam rasan ras rasanaa gur sabadhee ras peejai ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest nectar of nectars. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with my tongue, I drink in this nectar.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee aavai jai ghaneree ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, no one has any friend or companion; millions come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak laahaa lai ghar jaieeaai saachee sach mat teree ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak: the profit is earned and the soul returns home. True, true are Your Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਵਿਦੇਸੀਅੜੇ ਸਾਨੇਹੜੇ ਦੇਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan dhes vidheseeaRe saanehaRe dhedhee ||
verses.translation: O Friend, You have travelled so far from Your homeland; I send my message of love to You.

verses.original: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: saar samaale tin sajanaa mu(n)dh nain bharedhee ||
verses.translation: I cherish and remember that Friend; the eyes of this soul-bride are filled with tears.

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh nain bharedhee gun saaredhee kiau prabh milaa piaare ||
verses.translation: The eyes of the soul-bride are filled with tears; I dwell upon Your Glorious Virtues. How can I meet my Beloved Lord God?

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maarag pa(n)th na jaanau vikhaRaa kiau paieeaai pir paare ||
verses.translation: I do not know the treacherous path, the way to You. How can I find You and cross over, O my Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadhee milai vichhu(n)nee tan man aagai raakhai ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the separated soul-bride meets with the Lord; I place my body and mind before You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਫਲਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)mirat birakh mahaa ras faliaa mil preetam ras chaakhai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the ambrosial tree bears the most delicious fruits; meeting with my Beloved, I taste the sweet essence. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: mahal bulaiRe'e bilam na keejai ||
verses.translation: The Lord has called you to the Mansion of His Presence - do not delay!

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੜੀਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin rataRe'e sahaj mileejai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, imbued with His Love, you shall meet with Him with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sahaj mileejai ros na keejai garab nivaar samaanee ||
verses.translation: In celestial peace and poise, you shall meet Him; do not harbor anger - subdue your proud self!

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saachai raatee milai milaiee manmukh aavan jaanee ||
verses.translation: Imbued with Truth, I am united in His Union, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਨਾਚੀ ਤਬ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਫੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab naachee tab ghooghaT kaisaa maTukee foR niraaree ||
verses.translation: When you dance, what veil covers you? Break the water pot, and be unattached.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aapai aap pachhaanai gurmukh tat beechaaree ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, realize your own self; as Gurmukh, contemplate the essence of reality. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹਮ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere laal ra(n)geele ham laalan ke laale ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Beloved, I am the slave of Your slaves.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur alakh lakhaiaa avar na dhoojaa bhaale ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord, and now, I do not seek any other.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur alakh lakhaiaa jaa tis bhaiaa jaa prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Guru showed me the Invisible Lord, when it pleased Him, and when God showered His Blessings.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan dhaataa purakh bidhaataa sahaj mile banavaaree ||
verses.translation: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, the Lord of the woods - I have met Him with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kareh too taareh tareeaai sach dhevahu dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Bestow Your Glance of Grace and carry me across, to save me. Please bless me with the Truth, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa too sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of Your slaves. You are the Cherisher of all souls. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bharipur dhaar rahe at piaare ||
verses.translation: My Dear Beloved is enshrined throughout the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe rav rahiaa gur roop muraare ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is pervading, through the Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur roop muraare tirabhavan dhaare taa kaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord, is enshrined throughout the three worlds; His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਰੰਗੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gee jinasee ja(n)t upaae nit dhevai chaRai savaiaa ||
verses.translation: He created the beings of various colors and kinds; His Blessings increase day by day.

verses.original: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: apara(n)par aape thaap uthaape tis bhaavai so hovai ||
verses.translation: The Infinite Lord Himself establishes and disestablishes; whatever pleases Him, happens.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਕੈ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak heeraa heerai bedhiaa gun kai haar parovai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the diamond of spiritual wisdom. The garland of virtue is strung. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: gun guneh samaane masatak naam neesaano ||
verses.translation: The virtuous person merges in the Virtuous Lord; his forehead bears the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: sach saach samaiaa chookaa aavan jaano ||
verses.translation: The true person merges in the True Lord; his comings and goings are over.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach saach pachhaataa saachai raataa saach milai man bhaavai ||
verses.translation: The true person realizes the True Lord, and is imbued with Truth. He meets the True Lord, and is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saache uoopar avar na dheesai saache saach samaavai ||
verses.translation: No one else is seen to be above the True Lord; the true person merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mohan moh leeaa man meraa ba(n)dhan khol niraare ||
verses.translation: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; releasing me from bondage, He has set me free.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jotee jot samaanee jaa miliaa at piaare ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my light merged into the Light, when I met my most Darling Beloved. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: sach ghar khoj lahe saachaa gur thaano ||
verses.translation: By searching, the true home, the place of the True Guru is found.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh neh paieeaai gurmukh giaano ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, while the self-willed manmukh does not.

verses.original: ਦੇਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੋ ਸਦ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhevai sach dhaano so paravaano sadh dhaataa vadd dhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord has blessed with the gift of Truth is accepted; the Supremely Wise Lord is forever the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਚਿਰਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: amar ajonee asathir jaapai saachaa mahal chiraanaa ||
verses.translation: He is known to be Immortal, Unborn and Permanent; the True Mansion of His Presence is everlasting.

verses.original: ਦੋਤਿ ਉਚਾਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhot uchaapat lekh na likheeaai pragaTee jot muraaree ||
verses.translation: The day-to-day account of deeds is not recorded for that person, who manifests the radiance of the Divine Light of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak saachaa saachai raachaa gurmukh tareeaai taaree ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the true person is absorbed in the True Lord; the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਇਆਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa too samajh achet iaaniaa raam ||
verses.translation: O my ignorant, unconscious mind, reform yourself.

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਛਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa chhadd avagan gunee samaaniaa raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, leave behind your faults and demerits, and be absorbed in virtue.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦ ਲੁਭਾਣੇ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu saadh lubhaane kirat kamaane vichhuRiaa nahee melaa ||
verses.translation: You are deluded by so many flavors and pleasures, and you act in such confusion. You are separated, and you will not meet your Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau dhutar tareeaai jam ddar mareeaai jam kaa pa(n)th dhuhelaa ||
verses.translation: How can the impassible world-ocean be crossed? The fear of the Messenger of Death is deadly. The path of Death is agonizingly painful.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਾਝ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤਾ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰੁਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man raam nahee jaataa saajh prabhaataa avaghaT rudhaa kiaa kare ||
verses.translation: The mortal does not know the Lord in the evening, or in the morning; trapped on the treacherous path, what will he do then?

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੈ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa in bidh chhooTai gurmukh sevai narahare ||1||
verses.translation: Bound in bondage, he is released only by this method: as Gurmukh, serve the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa too chhodd aal ja(n)jaalaa raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, abandon your household entanglements.

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa har sevahu purakh niraalaa raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Primal, Detached Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har simar eka(n)kaar saachaa sabh jagat ji(n)n upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Universal Creator; the True Lord created the entire Universe.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee agan baadhe gur khel jagat dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru controls the air, water and fire; He has staged the drama of the world.

verses.original: ਆਚਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪੋ ॥
verses.translit: aachaar too veechaar aape har naam sa(n)jam jap tapo ||
verses.translation: Reflect on your own self, and so practice good conduct; chant the Name of the Lord as your self-discipline and meditation.

verses.original: ਸਖਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sakhaa sain piaar preetam naam har kaa jap japo ||2||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is your Companion, Friend and Dear Beloved; chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa too thir rahu choT na khaavahee raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain steady and stable, and you will not have to endure beatings.

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa gun gaaveh sahaj samaavahee raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall merge into Him with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇ ਰਸੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gai raam rasai rase'eeh gur giaan a(n)jan saarahe ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, be happy. Apply the ointment of spiritual wisdom to your eyes.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: trai lok dheepak sabadh chaanan pa(n)ch dhoot sa(n)ghaarahe ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is the lamp which illuminates the three worlds; it slaughters the five demons.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਹਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhai kaaT nirabhau tareh dhutar gur miliaai kaaraj saare ||
verses.translation: Quieting your fears, become fearless, and you shall cross over the impassible world ocean. Meeting the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: roop ra(n)g piaar har siau har aap kirapaa dhaare ||3||
verses.translation: You shall find the joy and the beauty of the Lord's Love and Affection; the Lord Himself shall shower you with His Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa too kiaa lai aaiaa kiaa lai jaisee raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, why did you come into the world? What will you take with you when you go?

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤਾ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa taa chhuTasee jaa bharam chukaisee raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, you shall be emancipated, when you eliminate your doubts.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਪਛਾਣਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan sa(n)ch har har naam vakhar gur sabadh bhaau pachhaanahe ||
verses.translation: So gather the wealth and capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall realize its value.

verses.original: ਮੈਲੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: mail parahar sabadh niramal mahal ghar sach jaanahe ||
verses.translation: Filth shall be taken away, through the Immaculate Word of the Shabad; you shall know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, your true home.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਧਾਵਹਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀ ਰਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: pat naam paaveh ghar sidhaaveh jhol a(n)mirat pee raso ||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, you shall obtain honor, and come home. Eagerly drink in the Ambrosial Amrit.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaaieeaai sabadh ras paieeaai vaddabhaag japeeaai har jaso ||4||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall obtain the sublime essence of the Shabad; by great good fortune, chant the Praises of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀਆ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa bin pauReeaa ma(n)dhar kiau chaRai raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, without a ladder, how will you climb up to the Temple of the Lord?

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa bin beRee paar na a(n)baRai raam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, without a boat, you shall not reach the other shore.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: paar saajan apaar preetam gur sabadh surat la(n)ghaave ||
verses.translation: On that far shore is Your Beloved, Infinite Friend. Only your awareness of the Guru's Shabad will carry you across.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)gat kareh raleeaa fir na pachhotaave ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall enjoy ecstasy; you shall not regret or repent later on.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਓ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhiaa dhaan dhiaal saachaa har naam sa(n)gat paavo ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful, O Merciful True Lord God: please give me the Blessing of the Lord's Name, and the Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਓ ॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai sunahu preetam gur sabadh man samajhaavo ||5||6||
verses.translation: Nanak prays: please hear me, O my Beloved; instruct my mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||6||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Tukhaari Chhant, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar piree piaar kiau pir bin jeeveeaai raam ||
verses.translation: My inner being is filled with love for my Beloved Husband Lord. How can I live without Him?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag dharas na hoi kiau a(n)mrit peeveeaai raam ||
verses.translation: As long as I do not have the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kiau a(n)mrit peeveeaai har bin jeeveeaai tis bin rahan na jaae ||
verses.translation: How can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar without the Lord? I cannot survive without Him.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin priau priau kare dhin raatee pir bin piaas na jaae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I cry out, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!"", day and night. Without my Husband Lord, my thirst is not quenched.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: apanee kirapaa karahu har piaare har har naam sadh saariaa ||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with Your Grace, O my Beloved Lord, that I may dwell on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh miliaa mai preetam hau satigur viTahu vaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have met my Beloved; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਿ ਰਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jab dhekhaa(n) pir piaaraa har gun ras ravaa raam ||
verses.translation: When I see my Beloved Husband Lord, I chant the Lord's Glorious Praises with love.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: merai a(n)tar hoi vigaas priau priau sach nit chavaa raam ||
verses.translation: My inner being blossoms forth; I continually utter, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!""

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: priau chavaa piaare sabadh nisataare bin dhekhe tirapat na aave ||
verses.translation: I speak of my Dear Beloved, and through the Shabad, I am saved. Unless I can see Him, I am not satisfied.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh seegaar hovai nit kaaman har har naam dhiaave ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride who is ever adorned with the Shabad, meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaan ma(n)gat jan dheejai mai preetam dheh milaae ||
verses.translation: Please bless this beggar, Your humble servant, with the Gift of Mercy; please unite me with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadhin gur gopaal dhiaaiee ham satigur viTahu ghumaae ||2||
verses.translation: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the World; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਵ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ham paathar gur naav bikh bhavajal taareeaai raam ||
verses.translation: I am a stone in the Boat of the Guru. Please carry me across the terrifying ocean of poison.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhevahu sabadh subhai mai mooR nisataareeaai raam ||
verses.translation: O Guru, please, lovingly bless me with the Word of the Shabad. I am such a fool - please save me!

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਵਡ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham mooR mugadh kichh mit nahee paiee too aga(n)m vadd jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a fool and an idiot; I know nothing of Your extent. You are known as Inaccessible and Great.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aap dhiaal dhiaa kar meleh ham niragunee nimaaniaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are Merciful; please, mercifully bless me. I am unworthy and dishonored - please, unite me with Yourself!

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: anek janam paap kar bharame hun tau saranaagat aae ||
verses.translation: Through countless lifetimes, I wandered in sin; now, I have come seeking Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu rakh levahu har jeeau ham laageh satigur paae ||3||
verses.translation: Take pity on me and save me, Dear Lord; I have grasped the Feet of the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur paaras ham loh mil ka(n)chan hoiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Philosopher's Stone; by His touch, iron is transformed into gold.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milai kaiaa gaR sohiaa raam ||
verses.translation: My light merges into the Light, and my body-fortress is so beautiful.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa gaR sohiaa merai prabh mohiaa kiau saas giraas visaareeaai ||
verses.translation: My body-fortress is so beautiful; I am fascinated by my God. How could I forget Him, for even a breath, or a morsel of food?

verses.original: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: adhirasaT agochar pakaRiaa gur sabadhee hau satigur kai balihaareeaai ||
verses.translation: I have seized the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur aagai sees bheT dheau je satigur saache bhaavai ||
verses.translation: I place my head in offering before the True Guru, if it truly pleases the True Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape dhiaa karahu prabh dhaate naanak a(n)k samaavai ||4||1||
verses.translation: Take pity on me, O God, Great Giver, that Nanak may merge in Your Being. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har agam agaadh apara(n)par aparaparaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tum dhiaaveh jagadhees te jan bhau bikham taraa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on You, O Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross over the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bikham bhau tin tariaa suhelaa jin har har naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, easily cross over the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur vaak satigur jo bhai chale tin har har aap milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who lovingly walk in harmony with the Word of the Guru, the True Guru - the Lord, Har, Har, unites them with Himself.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot mil jot samaanee har kirapaa kar dharaneedharaa ||
verses.translation: The mortal's light meets the Light of God, and blends with that Divine Light when the Lord, the Support of the Earth, grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har agam agaadh apara(n)par aparaparaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tum suaamee agam athaeh too ghaT ghaT poor rahiaa ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too alakh abheau aga(n)m gur satigur bachan lahiaa ||
verses.translation: You are Unseen, Unknowable and Unfathomable; You are found through the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n te jan purakh poore jin gur sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil gun rave ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble, powerful and perfect people, who join the Guru's Sangat, the Society of the Saints, and chant His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: bibek budh beechaar gurmukh gur sabadh khin khin har nit chave ||
verses.translation: With clear and precise understanding, the Gurmukhs contemplate the Guru's Shabad; each and every instant, they continually speak of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜਾ ਖੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa baheh gurmukh har naam boleh jaa khaRe gurmukh har har kahiaa ||
verses.translation: When the Gurmukh sits down, he chants the Lord's Name. When the Gurmukh stands up, he chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tum suaamee agam athaeh too ghaT ghaT poor rahiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak jan seveh te paravaan jin seviaa gurmat hare ||
verses.translation: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They serve the Lord, and follow the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke koT sabh paap khin parahar har dhoor kare ||
verses.translation: All their millions of sins are taken away in an instant; the Lord takes them far away.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke paap dhokh sabh binase jin man chit ik araadhiaa ||
verses.translation: All their sin and blame is washed away. They worship and adore the One Lord with their conscious minds.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa janam safalio sabh keeaa karatai jin gur bachanee sach bhaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator makes fruitful the lives of all those who, through the Guru's Word, chant the True Name.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: te dha(n)n jan vadd purakh poore jo gurmat har jap bhau bikham tare ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those humble beings, those great and perfect people, who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sevak jan seveh te paravaan jin seviaa gurmat hare ||3||
verses.translation: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They follow the Guru's Teachings, and serve the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too a(n)tarajaamee har aap jiau too chalaaveh piaare hau tivai chalaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਉ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: hamarai haath kichh naeh jaa too meleh taa hau aai milaa ||
verses.translation: Nothing is in my hands; when You unite me, then I come to be united.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau too har meleh suaamee sabh tin kaa lekhaa chhuTak giaa ||
verses.translation: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O my Lord and Master - all their accounts are settled.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee ganat na kariahu ko bhaiee jo gur bachanee har mel liaa ||
verses.translation: No one can go through the accounts of those, O Siblings of Destiny, who through the Word of the Guru's Teachings are united with the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhiaal hoaa tin uoopar jin gur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa bhalaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord shows Mercy to those who accept the Guru's Will as good.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: too a(n)tarajaamee har aap jiau too chalaaveh piaare hau tivai chalaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: too jagajeevan jagadhees sabh karataa sirasaT naath ||
verses.translation: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, the Creator of all the Universe.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: tin too dhiaaiaa meraa raam jin kai dhur lekh maath ||
verses.translation: They alone meditate on You, O my Lord, who have such destiny recorded on their foreheads.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau dhur har likhiaa suaamee tin har har naam araadhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are so pre-destined by their Lord and Master, worship and adore the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke paap ik nimakh sabh laathe jin gur bachanee har jaapiaa ||
verses.translation: All sins are erased in an instant, for those who meditate on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਸਨਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n te jan jin har naam japiaa tin dhekhe hau bhiaa sanaath ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name. Seeing them, I am uplifted.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too jagajeevan jagadhees sabh karataa sirasaT naath ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, the Creator of all the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: too jal thal maheeal bharapoor sabh uoopar saach dhanee ||
verses.translation: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are the Master of all.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਘਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa har man cheet har jap jap mukat ghanee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord in their conscious minds - all those who chant and meditate on the Lord are liberated.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa har te mukat praanee tin ke uoojal mukh har dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Those mortal beings who meditate on the Lord are liberated; their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi halat palat jan bhe suhele har raakh le'ee rakhanahaar ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings are exalted in this world and the next; the Savior Lord saves them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਬਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)tasa(n)gat jan sunahu bhaiee gurmukh har sevaa safal banee ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Lord's Name in the Society of the Saints, O humble Siblings of Destiny. The Gurmukh's service to the Lord is fruitful.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too jal thal maheeal bharapoor sabh uoopar saach dhanee ||2||
verses.translation: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are the Master of all. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too thaan thana(n)tar har ek har eko ek raviaa ||
verses.translation: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces.

verses.original: ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran tirabhavan sabh sirasaT mukh har har naam chaviaa ||
verses.translation: The forests and fields, the three worlds and the entire Universe, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਚਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਗਣਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabh chaveh har har naam karate asa(n)kh aganat har dhiaave ||
verses.translation: All chant the Name of the Creator Lord, Har, Har; countless, uncountable beings meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: so dha(n)n dhan har sa(n)t saadhoo jo har prabh karate bhaave ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those Saints and Holy People of the Lord, who are pleasing to the Creator Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਚਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so safal dharasan dheh karate jis har hiradhai naam sadh chaviaa ||
verses.translation: O Creator, please bless me with the Fruitful Vision, the Darshan, of those who chant the Lord's Name in their hearts forever.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too thaan thana(n)tar har ek har eko ek raviaa ||3||
verses.translation: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar asa(n)kh jis too dheveh mere suaamee tis mileh ||
verses.translation: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਟਿਕਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai masatak gur haath tis hiradhai har gun Tikeh ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Glorious Virtues abide within the heart of that person, whose forehead the Guru has touched.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਟਿਕਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun hiradhai Tikeh tis kai jis a(n)tar bhau bhaavanee hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Glorious Virtues of the Lord dwell in the heart of that person, whose inner being is filled with the Fear of God, and His Love.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhai kinai na prem paiaa bin bhai paar na utariaa koiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, His Love is not obtained. Without the Fear of God, no one is carried across to the other side.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhau bhaau preet naanak tiseh laagai jis too aapanee kirapaa kareh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with the Fear of God, and God's Love and Affection, whom You, Lord, bless with Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar asa(n)kh jis too dheveh mere suaamee tis mileh ||4||3||
verses.translation: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with Them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: tukhaaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naavan purab abheech gur satigur dharas bhiaa ||
verses.translation: To receive the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, is to truly bathe at the Abhaijit festival.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat mail haree agiaan a(n)dher giaa ||
verses.translation: The filth of evil-mindedness is washed off, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur dharas paiaa agiaan gavaiaa a(n)tar jot pragaasee ||
verses.translation: Blessed by the Guru's Darshan, spiritual ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light illuminates the inner being.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh khin meh binase har paiaa prabh abinaasee ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death vanish in an instant, and the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God is found.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ਨਾਵਣਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har aap karatai purab keeaa satiguroo kulakhet naavan giaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord God Himself created the festival, when the True Guru went to bathe at the festival in Kuruk-shaytra.

verses.original: ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naavan purab abheech gur satigur dharas bhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: To receive the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, is to truly bathe at the Abhaijit festival. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: maarag pa(n)th chale gur satigur sa(n)g sikhaa ||
verses.translation: The Sikhs travelled with the Guru, the True Guru, on the path, along the road.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਵਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat banee khin khin nimakh vikhaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, devotional worship services were held, each and every instant, with each step.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har bhagat banee prabh keree sabh lok vekhan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship services to the Lord God were held, and all the people came to see the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin dharas satigur guroo keeaa tin aap har melaiaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever was blessed with the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, the Lord united with Himself.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਉਦਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: teerath udham satiguroo keeaa sabh lok udharan arathaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru made the pilgrimage to the sacred shrines, for the sake of saving all the people.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maarag pa(n)th chale gur satigur sa(n)g sikhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Sikhs travelled with the Guru, the True Guru, on the path, along the road. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਆਏ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: pratham aae kulakhet gur satigur purab hoaa ||
verses.translation: When the Guru, the True Guru, first arrived at Kuruk-shaytra, it was a very auspicious time.

verses.original: ਖਬਰਿ ਭਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਆਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: khabar bhiee sa(n)saar aae trai loaa ||
verses.translation: The news spread throughout the world, and the beings of the three worlds came.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਣਿ ਆਏ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhan aae teen lok sur nar mun jan sabh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The angelic beings and silent sages from all the three worlds came to see Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin parasiaa gur satiguroo pooraa tin ke kilavikh naas gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are touched by the Guru, the True Guru - all their sins and mistakes were erased and dispelled.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਦਿਗੰਬਰ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਢੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: jogee dhiga(n)bar sa(n)niaasee khaT dharasan kar ge gosaT ddoaa ||
verses.translation: The Yogis, the nudists, the Sannyaasees and those of the six schools of philosophy spoke with Him, and then bowed and departed.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਆਏ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਹੋਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pratham aae kulakhet gur satigur purab hoaa ||3||
verses.translation: When the Guru, the True Guru, first arrived at Kuruk-shaytra, it was a very auspicious time. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਮੁਨ ਗਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhuteeaa jamun ge gur har har japan keeaa ||
verses.translation: Second, the Guru went to the river Jamunaa, where He chanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇ ਭੇਟ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਲੰਘਾਇ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaagaatee mile dhe bheT gur pichhai la(n)ghai dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The tax collectors met the Guru and gave Him offerings; they did not impose the tax on His followers.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਛੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh chhuTee satiguroo pichhai jin har har naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: All the True Guru's followers were excused from the tax; they meditated on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਜੋ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachan maarag jo pa(n)th chaale tin jam jaagaatee neR na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who have walked on the path, and followed the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਸਭਿ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh guroo guroo jagat bolai gur kai nai liaai sabh chhuTak giaa ||
verses.translation: All the world said, ""Guru! Guru! Guru!"" Uttering the Guru's Name, they were all emancipated.

verses.original: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਮੁਨ ਗਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhuteeaa jamun ge gur har har japan keeaa ||4||
verses.translation: Second, the Guru went to the river Jamunaa, where He chanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਆਏ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਤਹ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tirateeaa aae surasaree teh kautak chalat bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Third, He went to the Ganges, and a wonderful drama was played out there.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਕਿਨੈ ਆਢੁ ਨ ਦਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh mohee dhekh dharasan gur sa(n)t kinai aadd na dhaam liaa ||
verses.translation: All were fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saintly Guru's Darshan; no tax at all was imposed upon anyone.

verses.original: ਆਢੁ ਦਾਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਇਆ ਨ ਬੋਲਕ ਜਾਗਾਤੀਆ ਮੋਹਣ ਮੁੰਦਣਿ ਪਈ ॥
verses.translit: aadd dhaam kichh piaa na bolak jaagaateeaa mohan mu(n)dhan piee ||
verses.translation: No tax at all was collected, and the mouths of the tax collectors were sealed.

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਮਾਂਗਹ ਸਭ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee ham kareh kiaa kis paas maa(n)geh sabh bhaag satigur pichhai piee ||
verses.translation: They said, ""O brothers, what should we do? Who should we ask? Everyone is running after the True Guru.""

verses.original: ਜਾਗਾਤੀਆ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਭੰਨਿ ਬੋਲਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaagaateeaa upaav siaanap kar veechaar ddiThaa bha(n)n bolakaa sabh uTh giaa ||
verses.translation: The tax collectors were smart; they thought about it, and saw. They broke their cash-boxes and left.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਆਏ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਤਹ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tirateeaa aae surasaree teh kautak chalat bhiaa ||5||
verses.translation: Third, He went to the Ganges, and a wonderful drama was played out there. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਾ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mil aae nagar mahaa janaa gur satigur oT gahee ||
verses.translation: The important men of the city met together, and sought the Protection of the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur gur govidh puchh simirat keetaa sahee ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe. Go ahead and consult the Simritees - they will confirm this.

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਨੀ ਸਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੁਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasatr sabhanee sahee keetaa suk prahilaadh sreeraam kar gur govidh dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Simritees and the Shaastras all confirm that Suk Dayv and Prahlaad meditated on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, and knew Him as the Supreme Lord.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਟਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਥੇਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee nagar koT pa(n)ch chor vaTavaare tin kaa thaau theh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The five thieves and the highway robbers dwell in the fortress of the body-village; the Guru has destroyed their home and place.

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਨਿਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: keeratan puraan nit pu(n)n hoveh gur bachan naanak har bhagat lahee ||
verses.translation: The Puraanas continually praise the giving of charity, but devotional worship of the Lord is only obtained through the Word of Guru Nanak.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਾ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥੬॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: mil aae nagar mahaa janaa gur satigur oT gahee ||6||4||10||
verses.translation: The important men of the city met together, and sought the Protection of the Guru, the True Guru. ||6||4||10||

verses.original: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Tukhaari Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਲਾਲਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghol ghumaiee laalanaa gur man dheenaa ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, I am a sacrifice to You. Through the Guru, I have dedicated my mind to You.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun sabadh tumaaraa meraa man bheenaa ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Word of Your Shabad, my mind is enraptured.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih man bheenaa jiau jal meenaa laagaa ra(n)g muraaraa ||
verses.translation: This mind is enraptured, like the fish in the water; it is lovingly attached to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kahee na jaiee Thaakur teraa mahal apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Worth cannot be described, O my Lord and Master; Your Mansion is Incomparable and Unrivalled.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal gunaa ke dhaate suaamee binau sunahu ik dheenaa ||
verses.translation: O Giver of all Virtue, O my Lord and Master, please hear the prayer of this humble person.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheh dharas naanak balihaaree jeeaRaa bal bal keenaa ||1||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan man teraa sabh gun tere ||
verses.translation: This body and mind are Yours; all virtues are Yours.

verses.original: ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa dharasan tere ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, every little bit, to Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan tere sun prabh mere nimakh dhirasaT pekh jeevaa ||
verses.translation: Please hear me, O my Lord God; I live only by seeing Your Vision, even if only for an instant.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam suneejai teraa kirapaa kareh ta peevaa ||
verses.translation: I have heard that Your Name is the most Ambrosial Nectar; please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may drink it in.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਬੂੰਦੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aas piaasee pir kai taiee jiau chaatirak boo(n)dhere ||
verses.translation: My hopes and desires rest in You, O my Husband Lord; like the rainbird, I long for the rain-drop.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jeeaRaa balihaaree dheh dharas prabh mere ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my soul is a sacrifice to You; please bless me with Your Darshan, O my Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too saachaa saahib saahu amitaa ||
verses.translation: You are my True Lord and Master, O Infinite King.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਿਤ ਚਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too preetam piaaraa praan hit chitaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Dear Beloved, so dear to my life and consciousness.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਰੰਗ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: praan sukhadhaataa gurmukh jaataa sagal ra(n)g ban aae ||
verses.translation: You bring peace to my soul; You are known to the Gurmukh. All are blessed by Your Love.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: soiee karam kamaavai praanee jehaa too furamaae ||
verses.translation: The mortal does only those deeds which You ordain, Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau kirapaa karee jagadheesur tin saadhasa(n)g man jitaa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by Your Grace, O Lord of the Universe, conquers his mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਉ ਦਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jeeaRaa balihaaree jeeau pi(n)dd tau dhitaa ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my soul is a sacrifice to You; You gave me my soul and body. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਦਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: niragun raakh leeaa sa(n)tan kaa sadhakaa ||
verses.translation: I am unworthy, but He has saved me, for the sake of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur ddaak leeaa moh paapee paRadhaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has covered my faults; I am such a sinner.

verses.original: ਢਾਕਨਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: ddaakanahaare prabhoo hamaare jeea praan sukhadhaate ||
verses.translation: God has covered for me; He is the Giver of the soul, life and peace.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: abinaasee abigat suaamee pooran purakh bidhaate ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is Eternal and Unchanging, Ever-present; He is the Perfect Creator, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਦ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kahan na jai tumaaree kaun kahai too kadh kaa ||
verses.translation: Your Praise cannot be described; who can say where You are?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਕਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas taa kai balihaaree milai naam har nimakaa ||4||1||11||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the one who blesses him with the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||4||1||11||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man raam naam nit gaaveeaai re ||
verses.translation: O my mind, sing continually the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਖਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar na jaiee har lakhiaa gur pooraa milai lakhaaveeaai re || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be seen; meeting with the Perfect Guru, He is seen. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis aape kirapaa kare meraa suaamee tis jan kau har liv laaveeaai re ||
verses.translation: That person, upon whom my Lord and Master showers His Mercy - the Lord attunes that one to Himself.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh ko bhagat kare har keree har bhaavai so thai paaveeaai re ||1||
verses.translation: Everyone worships the Lord, but only that person who is pleasing to the Lord is accepted. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam amolak har peh har dhevai taa naam dhiaaveeaai re ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless. It rests with the Lord. If the Lord bestows it, then we meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਭੁ ਛਡਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis no naam dhei meraa suaamee tis lekhaa sabh chhaddaaveeaai re ||2||
verses.translation: That person, whom my Lord and Master blesses with His Name - his entire account is forgiven. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam araadheh se dha(n)n jan kahe'eeh tin masatak bhaag dhur likh paaveeaai re ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who worship and adore the Lord's Name, are said to be blessed. Such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin dhekhe meraa man bigasai jiau sut mil maat gal laaveeaai re ||3||
verses.translation: Gazing upon them, my mind blossoms forth, like the mother who meets with her son and hugs him close. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik har pitaa prabh mere mo kau dheh matee jit har paaveeaai re ||
verses.translation: I am a child, and You, O my Lord God, are my Father; please bless me with such understanding, that I may find the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਊ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bachhuraa dhekh guoo sukh maanai tiau naanak har gal laaveeaai re ||4||1||
verses.translation: Like the cow, which is happy upon seeing her calf, O Lord, please hug Nanak close in Your Embrace. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har har gun kahu re ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੁ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo ke charan dhoi dhoi poojahu in bidh meraa har prabh lahu re || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wash the Feet of the True Guru, and worship them. In this way, you shall find my Lord God. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਤੂ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh abhimaan bikhai ras in sa(n)gat te too rahu re ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, attachment, egotism and corrupt pleasures - stay away from these.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਹੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat keejai har gosaT saadhoo siau gosaT har prem rasain raam naam rasain har raam naam raam ramahu re ||1||
verses.translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and speak with the Holy People about the Lord. The Love of the Lord is the healing remedy; the Name of the Lord is the healing remedy. Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kaa abhimaan jor too kichh kichh kichh jaanataa ih dhoor karahu aapan gahu re ||
verses.translation: So you think that the egotistical pride in power which you harbor deep within is everything. Let it go, and restrain your self-conceit.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har dhiaal hoh suaamee har sa(n)tan kee dhoor kar hare ||2||1||2||
verses.translation: Please be kind to servant Nanak, O Lord, my Lord and Master; please make him the dust of the Feet of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiee sa(n)tasa(n)g jaagee ||
verses.translation: O mother, I have awakened in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਪਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pria ra(n)g dhekhai japatee naam nidhaanee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Seeing the Love of my Beloved, I chant His Name, the greatest treasure||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan piaas lochan taar laagee ||
verses.translation: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. my eyes are focused on Him;

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਿਆਸ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisaree tiaas biddaanee ||1||
verses.translation: I have forgotten other thirsts. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab gur paio hai sahaj sukhadhaik dharasan pekhat man lapaTaanee ||
verses.translation: Now, I have found my Peace-giving Guru with ease; seeing His Darshan, my mind clings to Him.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhekh dhamodhar rahas man upajio naanak pria a(n)mirat baanee ||2||1||
verses.translation: Seeing my Lord, joy has welled up in my mind; O Nanak, the speech of my Beloved is so sweet! ||2||1||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: dheen binau sun dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Please listen to the prayers of the humble, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਤੀਨਿ ਦੋਖੀ ਏਕ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhaas teen dhokhee ek man anaath naath ||
verses.translation: The five thieves and the three dispositions torment my mind.

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakh ho kirapaal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, Master of the masterless, please save me from them. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan gavan karau ||
verses.translation: I make all sorts of efforts and go on pilgrimages;

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: khaT karam jugat dhiaan dharau ||
verses.translation: I perform the six rituals, and meditate in the right way.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਨਹ ਨਹ ਹੁਟਹਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aupaav sagal kar haario neh neh huTeh bikaraal ||1||
verses.translation: I am so tired of making all these efforts, but the horrible demons still do not leave me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: saran ba(n)dhan karunaa pate ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, and bow to You, O Compassionate Lord.

verses.original: ਭਵ ਹਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhav haran har har har hare ||
verses.translation: You are the Destroyer of fear, O Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: ek toohee dheen dhiaal ||
verses.translation: You alone are Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: prabh charan naanak aasaro ||
verses.translation: Nanak takes the Support of God's Feet.

verses.original: ਉਧਰੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
verses.translit: audhare bhram moh saagar ||
verses.translation: I have been rescued from the ocean of doubt,

verses.original: ਲਗਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਪਗ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: lag sa(n)tanaa pag paal ||2||1||2||
verses.translation: holding tight to the feet and the robes of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: saranee aaio naath nidhaan ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Supreme Treasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam preet laagee man bheetar maagan kau har dhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is enshrined within my mind; I beg for the gift of Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaiee pooran paramesur kar kirapaa raakhahu maan ||
verses.translation: O Pefect Transcendent Lord, Giver of Peace, please grant Your Grace and save my honor.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheh preet saadhoo sa(n)g suaamee har gun rasan bakhaan ||1||
verses.translation: Please bless me with such love, O my Lord and Master, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I may chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with my tongue. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: gopaal dhiaal gobidh dhamodhar niramal kathaa giaan ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the World, Merciful Lord of the Universe, Your sermon and spiritual wisdom are immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਗਹੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kau har kai ra(n)g raagahu charan kamal sa(n)g dhiaan ||2||1||3||
verses.translation: Please attune Nanak to Your Love, O Lord, and focus his meditation on Your Lotus Feet. ||2||1||3||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dharasan ko man chaau ||
verses.translation: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa satasa(n)g milaavahu tum dhevahu apano naau || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please grant Your Grace, and unite me with the Society of the Saints; please bless me with Your Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਤ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karau sevaa sat purakh piaare jat suneeaai tat man rahasaau ||
verses.translation: I serve my True Beloved Lord. Wherever I hear His Praise, there my mind is in ecstasy.

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਫੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaaree feree sadhaa ghumaiee kavan anoop tero Thaau ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever devoted to You. Your place is incomparably beautiful! ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸਗਲਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab pratipaaleh sagal samaaleh sagaliaa teree chhaau ||
verses.translation: You cherish and nurture all; You take care of all, and Your shade covers all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ke prabh purakh bidhaate ghaT ghaT tujheh dhikhaau ||2||2||4||
verses.translation: You are the Primal Creator, the God of Nanak; I behold You in each and every heart. ||2||2||4||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pria kee preet piaaree ||
verses.translation: I love the Love of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਮਗਨ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਤਾਰ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: magan manai meh chitavau aasaa nainahu taar tuhaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is intoxicated with delight, and my consciousness is filled with hope; my eyes are drenched with Your Love. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਪਲ ਘਰੀ ਕਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: oi dhin pahar moorat pal kaise oi pal gharee kihaaree ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that day, that hour, minute and second when the heavy, rigid shutters are opened, and desire is quenched.
