verses.original: ਖੂਲੇ ਕਪਟ ਧਪਟ ਬੁਝਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜੀਵਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khoole kapaT dhapaT bujh tirasanaa jeevau pekh dharasaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su jatan upaau kinehaa sevaa kaun beechaaree ||
verses.translation: What is the method, what is the effort, and what is the service, which inspires me to contemplate You?

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: maan abhimaan moh taj naanak sa(n)teh sa(n)g udhaaree ||2||3||5||
verses.translation: Abandon your egotistical pride and attachment; O Nanak, you shall be saved in the Society of the Saints. ||2||3||5||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har har gun gaavahu ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa gopaal gobidhe apanaa naam japaavahu || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Have Mercy on me, O Life of the World, O Lord of the Universe, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaadd le'ee prabh aan bikhai te saadhasa(n)g man laavahu ||
verses.translation: Please lift me up, God, out of vice and corruption, and attach my mind to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhram bhau moh kaTio gur bachanee apanaa dharas dhikhaavahu ||1||
verses.translation: Doubt, fear and attachment are eradicated from that person who follows the Guru's Teachings, and gazes on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kee ren hoi man meraa aha(n)budh tajaavahu ||
verses.translation: Let my mind become the dust of all; may I abandon my egotistical intellect.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: apanee bhagat dheh dhiaalaa vaddabhaagee naanak har paavahu ||2||4||6||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your devotional worship, O Merciful Lord; by great good fortune, O Nanak, I have found the Lord. ||2||4||6||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: har bin janam akaarath jaat ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, life is useless.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਖਾਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taj gopaal aan ra(n)g raachat mithiaa pahirat khaat || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who forsake the Lord, and become engrossed in other pleasures - false and useless are the clothes they wear, and the food they eat. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਮਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: dhan joban sa(n)pai sukh bhuogavai sa(n)g na nibahat maat ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of wealth, youth, property and comforts will not stay with you, O mother.

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਾਵਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mirag tirasanaa dhekh rachio baavar dhrum chhaiaa ra(n)g raat ||1||
verses.translation: Seeing the mirage, the madman is entangled in it; he is imbued with pleasures that pass away, like the shade of a tree. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਤ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਖਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: maan moh mahaa madh mohat kaam karodh kai khaat ||
verses.translation: Totally intoxicated with the wine of pride and attachment, he has fallen into the pit of sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੫॥੭॥
verses.translit: kar geh leh dhaas naanak kau prabh jeeau hoi sahaat ||2||5||7||
verses.translation: O Dear God, please be the Help and Support of servant Nanak; please take me by the hand, and uplift me. ||2||5||7||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਲਸਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: har bin koi na chaalas saath ||
verses.translation: Nothing goes along with the mortal, except for the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਾਥਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath karunaapat suaamee anaathaa ke naath || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of Mercy, my Lord and Master, the Master of the masterless. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਭੋੁਗਵਤ ਨਹ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: sut sa(n)pat bikhiaa ras bhuogavat neh nibahat jam kai paath ||
verses.translation: Children, possessions and the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures do not go along with the mortal on the path of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗਾਉ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੇ ਖਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan gaau gun gobi(n)dh udhar saagar ke khaat ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord of the Universe, the mortal is carried across the deep ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: saran samarath akath agochar har simarat dhukh laath ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Indescribable, Unfathomable Lord, meditate in remembrance on Him, and your pains shall vanish.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਿਖਤ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dheen dhoor jan baa(n)chhat milai likhat dhur maath ||2||6||8||
verses.translation: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant; he shall obtain it only if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead. ||2||6||8||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bisarat naeh man te haree ||
verses.translation: I do not forget the Lord in my mind.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਭਈ ਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ab ieh preet mahaa prabal bhiee aan bikhai jaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: This love has now become very strong; it has burnt away other corruption. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੂੰਦ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਘਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: boo(n)dh kahaa tiaag chaatirak meen rahat na gharee ||
verses.translation: How can the rainbird forsake the rain-drop? The fish cannot survive without water, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਟੇਵ ਏਹ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gopaal uchaar rasanaa Tev eh paree ||1||
verses.translation: My tongue chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World; this has become part of my very nature. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਬੇਧਿ ਤੀਖਨ ਸਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa naadh kura(n)k mohio bedh teekhan saree ||
verses.translation: The deer is fascinated by the sound of the bell, and so it is shot with the sharp arrow.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਠਿ ਬਾਧਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: prabh charan kamal rasaal naanak gaaTh baadh dharee ||2||1||9||
verses.translation: God's Lotus Feet are the Source of Nectar; O Nanak, I am tied to them by a knot. ||2||1||9||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਸਤ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: preetam basat ridh meh khor ||
verses.translation: My Beloved dwells in the cave of my heart.

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bheet nivaar Thaakur geh leh apanee or ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Shatter the wall of doubt, O my Lord and Master; please grab hold of me, and lift me up towards Yourself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਧਿਕ ਗਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਚਾਰਹੁ ਧੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: adhik garat sa(n)saar saagar kar dhiaa chaarahu dhor ||
verses.translation: The world-ocean is so vast and deep; please be kind, lift me up and place me on the shore.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਲੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g har charan bohith udharate lai mor ||1||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord's Feet are the boat to carry us across. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: garabh ku(n)T meh jineh dhaario nahee bikhai ban meh hor ||
verses.translation: The One who placed you in the womb of your mother's belly - no one else shall save you in the wilderness of corruption.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਹੋਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har sakat saran samarath naanak aan nahee nihor ||2||2||10||
verses.translation: The power of the Lord's Sanctuary is all-powerful; Nanak does not rely on any other. ||2||2||10||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬਖਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam raam bakhaan ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਏ ਕਲਮਲ ਹਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gun guopaal uchaar dhin rain bhe kalamal haan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, your sins shall be eradicated. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਪਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰ ਪਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag chalanaa sagal sa(n)pat kaal sir par jaan ||
verses.translation: You shall have to leave behind all your riches when you depart. Death is hanging over your head - know this well!

verses.original: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mithan moh dhura(n)t aasaa jhooTh sarapar maan ||1||
verses.translation: Transitory attachments and evil hopes are false. Surely you must believe this! ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sat purakh akaal moorat ridhai dhaarahu dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Within your heart, focus your meditation on the True Primal Being, Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan laabh naanak basat ieh paravaan ||2||3||11||
verses.translation: Only this profitable merchandise, the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak, shall be accepted. ||2||3||11||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam ko aadhaar ||
verses.translation: I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales na kachh biaapai sa(n)tasa(n)g biauhaar || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Suffering and conflict do not afflict me; I deal only with the Society of the Saints. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਤਉ ਬੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar anugrahu aap raakhio neh upajatau bekaar ||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy on me, the Lord Himself has saved me, and no evil thoughts arise within me.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis paraapat hoi simarai tis dhahat neh sa(n)saar ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever receives this Grace, contemplates Him in meditation; he is not burned by the fire of the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukh ma(n)gal aana(n)dh har har prabh charan a(n)mirat saar ||
verses.translation: Peace, joy and bliss come from the Lord, Har, Har. God's Feet are sublime and excellent.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas saranaagatee tere sa(n)tanaa kee chhaar ||2||4||12||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||2||4||12||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam bin dhirag srot ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, one's ears are cursed.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਹੋਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan roop bisaar jeeveh teh kat jeevan hot || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Embodiment of Life - what is the point of their lives? ||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਾਰ ਬਾਹਕ ਖੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: khaat peet anek bi(n)jan jaise bhaar baahak khot ||
verses.translation: One who eats and drinks countless delicacies is no more than a donkey, a beast of burden.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੋਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar mahaa sram paiaa jaise birakh ja(n)tee jot ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he endures terrible suffering, like the bull, chained to the oil-press. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਰੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: taj guopaal j aan laage se bahu prakaaree rot ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Life of the World, and attached to another, they weep and wail in so many ways.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਤ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kar jor naanak dhaan maagai har rakhau ka(n)Th parot ||2||5||13||
verses.translation: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this gift; O Lord, please keep me strung around Your Neck. ||2||5||13||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਲੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)teh dhoor le mukh malee ||
verses.translation: I take the dust of the feet of the Saints and apply it to my face.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਹ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਕਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gunaa achut sadhaa pooran neh dhokh biaapeh kalee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hearing of the Imperishable, Eternally Perfect Lord, pain does not afflict me, even in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਰਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨ ਹਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachan kaaraj sarab pooran ieet uoot na halee ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, all affairs are resolved, and the mind is not tossed about here and there.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਰਬਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh ek anik sarabat pooran bikhai agan na jalee ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever sees the One God to be pervading in all the many beings, does not burn in the fire of corruption. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਰਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa leeno dhaas apano jot jotee ralee ||
verses.translation: The Lord grasps His slave by the arm, and his light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: prabh charan saran anaath aaio naanak har sa(n)g chalee ||2||6||14||
verses.translation: Nanak, the orphan, has come seeking the Sanctuary of God's Feet; O Lord, he walks with You. ||2||6||14||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kedhaaraa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਰੁਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kee man ruchai ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with yearning for the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਲਤ ਛਾਤੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT saa(n)t ana(n)dh pooran jalat chhaatee bujhai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am totally filled with tranquility and bliss; the burning desire within has been quenched. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰੇ ਮੁਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t maarag chalat praanee patit udhare muchai ||
verses.translation: Walking on the path of the Saints, millions of mortal sinners have been saved.

verses.original: ਰੇਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਗੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੁਚੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ren jan kee lagee masatak anik teerath suchai ||1||
verses.translation: One who applies the dust of the feet of the humble to his forehead, is purified, as if he has bathed at countless sacred shrines. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal dhiaan bheetar ghaT ghaTeh suaamee sujhai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on His Lotus Feet deep within, one realizes the Lord and Master in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੁਝੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: saran dhev apaar naanak bahur jam nahee lujhai ||2||7||15||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Divine, Infinite Lord, Nanak shall never again be tortured by the Messenger of Death. ||2||7||15||

verses.original: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: kedhaaraa chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Kaydaaraa Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil mere preetam piaariaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please meet me, O my Dear Beloved. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: poor rahiaa sarabatr mai so purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is All-pervading amongst all, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maarag prabh kaa har keeaa sa(n)tan sa(n)g jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Lord God has created His Path, which is known in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan sa(n)g jaataa purakh bidhaataa ghaT ghaT nadhar nihaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is known in the Society of the Saints; You are seen in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo saranee aavai sarab sukh paavai til nahee bha(n)nai ghaaliaa ||
verses.translation: One who comes to His Sanctuary, finds absolute peace; not even a bit of his work goes unnoticed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har gun nidh gaae sahaj subhaae prem mahaa ras maataa ||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue, is easily, naturally intoxicated with the supreme, sublime essence of divine love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas teree saranaiee too pooran purakh bidhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; You are the Perfect Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਆਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har prem bhagat jan bedhiaa se aan kat jaahee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant is pierced through with loving devotion to Him; where else can he go?

verses.original: ਮੀਨੁ ਬਿਛੋਹਾ ਨਾ ਸਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: meen bichhohaa naa sahai jal bin mar paahee ||
verses.translation: The fish cannot endure separation, and without water, it will die.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਹੀਐ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਿਆਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kiau raheeaai dhookh kin saheeaai chaatirak boo(n)dh piaasiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, how can I survive? How can I endure the pain? I am like the rainbird, thirsty for the rain-drop.

verses.original: ਕਬ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kab rain bihaavai chakavee sukh paavai sooraj kiran pragaasiaa ||
verses.translation: "When will the night pass?," asks the chakvi bird. "I shall find peace only when the rays of the sun shine on me."

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dharas man laagaa dhinas sabhaagaa anadhin har gun gaahee ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord. Blessed are the nights and days, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਟਿਕਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee kat har bin praan Tikaahee ||2||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak utters this prayer; without the Lord, how can the breath of life continue to flow through me? ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਕਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saas binaa jiau dhehuree kat sobhaa paavai ||
verses.translation: Without the breath, how can the body obtain glory and fame?

verses.original: ਦਰਸ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharas bihoonaa saadh jan khin Tikan na aavai ||
verses.translation: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, the humble, holy person does not find peace, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਰਕੁ ਸੋ ਸਹਣਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har bin jo rahanaa narak so sahanaa charan kamal man bedhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are without the Lord suffer in hell; my mind is pierced through with the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਖੇਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har rasik bairaagee naam liv laagee katahu na jai nikhedhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is both sensual and unattached; lovingly attune yourself to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. No one can ever deny Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har siau jai milanaa saadhasa(n)g rahanaa so sukh a(n)k na maavai ||
verses.translation: Go and meet with the Lord, and dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; no one can contain that peace within his being.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal naanak ke suaamee har charaneh sa(n)g samaavai ||3||
verses.translation: Please be kind to me, O Lord and Master of Nanak, that I may merge in You. ||3||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat prabh mile har karunaa dhaare ||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, I have met with my Lord God, who has showered me with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਮੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: niragun neech anaath mai nahee dhokh beechaare ||
verses.translation: I am unworthy, a lowly orphan, but He does not even consider my faults.

verses.original: ਨਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਖਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nahee dhokh beechaare pooran sukh saare paavan biradh bakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He does not consider my faults; He has blessed me with Perfect Peace. It is said that it is His Way to purify us.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਚਲੋੁ ਗਹਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal sun a(n)chaluo gahiaa ghaT ghaT poor samaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Hearing that He is the Love of His devotees, I have grasped the hem of His robe. He is totally permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagaruo paiaa sahaj subhaiaa janam maran dhukh haare ||
verses.translation: I have found the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, with intuitive ease; the pains of birth and death are gone.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene naanak dhaas apane raam naam ur haare ||4||1||
verses.translation: Taking him by the hand, the Lord has saved Nanak, His slave; He has woven the garland of His Name into his heart. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag kedhaaraa baanee kabeer jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat ni(n)dhaa dhouoo bibarajit tajahu maan abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who ignore both praise and slander, who reject egotistical pride and conceit,

verses.original: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lohaa ka(n)chan sam kar jaaneh te moorat bhagavaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: who look alike upon iron and gold - they are the very image of the Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: teraa jan ek aadh koiee ||
verses.translation: Hardly anyone is a humble servant of Yours, O Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh bibarajit har padh cheen(h)ai soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Ignoring sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, such a person becomes aware of the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਤ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raj gun tam gun sat gun kaheeaai ieh teree sabh maiaa ||
verses.translation: Raajas, the quality of energy and activity; Taamas, the quality of darkness and inertia; and Satvas, the quality of purity and light, are all called the creations of Maya, Your illusion.

verses.original: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chauthe padh kau jo nar cheen(h)ai tin(h) hee param padh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: That man who realizes the fourth state - he alone obtains the supreme state. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam sadhaa rahai nihakaamaa ||
verses.translation: Amidst pilgrimages, fasting, rituals, purification and self-discipline, he remains always without thought of reward.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa ar maiaa bhram chookaa chitavat aatam raamaa ||3||
verses.translation: Thirst and desire for Maya and doubt depart, remembering the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ma(n)dhar dheepak paragaasiaa a(n)dhakaar teh naasaa ||
verses.translation: When the temple is illuminated by the lamp, its darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: nirabhau poor rahe bhram bhaagaa keh kabeer jan dhaasaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Fearless Lord is All-pervading. Doubt has run away, says Kabeer, the Lord's humble slave. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਕਿਨਹੀ ਲਉਗ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee banajiaa kaa(n)see taa(n)baa kinahee laug supaaree ||
verses.translation: Some deal in bronze and copper, some in cloves and betel nuts.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕਾ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu banajiaa naam gobidh kaa aaisee khep hamaaree ||1||
verses.translation: The Saints deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. Such is my merchandise as well. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam ke biaapaaree ||
verses.translation: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: heeraa haath chaRiaa niramolak chhooT giee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The priceless diamond has come into my hands. I have left the world behind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਉ ਸਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saache laae tau sach laage saache ke biauhaaree ||
verses.translation: When the True Lord attached me, then I was attached to Truth. I am a trader of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਚਲਾਏ ਪਹੁਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachee basat ke bhaar chalaae pahuche jai bha(n)ddaaree ||2||
verses.translation: I have loaded the commodity of Truth; It has reached the Lord, the Treasurer. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਆਪੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh ratan javaahar maanik aapai hai paasaaree ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the pearl, the jewel, the ruby; He Himself is the jeweller.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਆਪ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aapai dheh dhis aap chalaavai nihachal hai biaapaaree ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself spreads out in the ten directions. The Merchant is Eternal and Unchanging. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਡਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੋਨਿ ਭਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man kar bail surat kar paiddaa giaan gon bhar ddaaree ||
verses.translation: My mind is the bull, and meditation is the road; I have filled my packs with spiritual wisdom, and loaded them on the bull.

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu nibahee khep hamaaree ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: my merchandise has reached its destination! ||4||2||

verses.original: ਰੀ ਕਲਵਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਮੂਢ ਮਤਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਫਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: ree kalavaar gavaar moodd mat ulaTo pavan firaavau ||
verses.translation: You barbaric brute, with your primitive intellect - reverse your breath and turn it inward.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰ ਮੇਰ ਸਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man matavaar mer sar bhaaThee a(n)mirat dhaar chuaavau ||1||
verses.translation: Let your mind be intoxicated with the stream of Ambrosial Nectar which trickles down from the furnace of the Tenth Gate. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu bhieeaa raam kee dhuhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, call on the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਿਆਸ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: peevahu sa(n)t sadhaa mat dhuralabh sahaje piaas bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Saints, drink in this wine forever; it is so difficult to obtain, and it quenches your thirst so easily. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਾਇ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bich bhaau bhai kouoo boojheh har ras paavai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, is the Love of God. Only those few who understand His Love obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jete ghaT a(n)mrit sabh hee meh bhaavai tiseh peeaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: As many hearts as there are - in all of them, is His Ambrosial Nectar; as He pleases, He causes them to drink it in. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਗਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nagaree ekai nau dharavaaje dhaavat baraj rahaiee ||
verses.translation: There are nine gates to the one city of the body; restrain your mind from escaping through them.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਦਸਵਾ ਦਰੁ ਖੂਲੑੈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirakuTee chhooTai dhasavaa dhar khool(h)ai taa man kheevaa bhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: When the knot of the three qualities is untied, then the Tenth Gate opens up, and the mind is intoxicated, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪੂਰਿ ਤਾਪ ਤਹ ਨਾਸੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: abhai padh poor taap teh naase keh kabeer beechaaree ||
verses.translation: When the mortal fully realizes the state of fearless dignity, then his sufferings vanish; so says Kabeer after careful deliberation.

verses.original: ਉਬਟ ਚਲੰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੋਂਦ ਖੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: aubaT chala(n)te ih madh paiaa jaise kho(n)dh khumaaree ||4||3||
verses.translation: Turning away from the world, I have obtained this wine, and I am intoxicated with it. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh tirasanaa ke leene gat nahee ekai jaanee ||
verses.translation: You are engrossed with unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger; you do not know the State of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਫੂਟੀ ਆਖੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਡਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: fooTee aakhai kachhoo na soojhai boodd mooe bin paanee ||1||
verses.translation: Your eyes are blinded, and you see nothing at all. You drown and die without water. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਲਤ ਕਤ ਟੇਢੇ ਟੇਢੇ ਟੇਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: chalat kat Tedde Tedde Tedde ||
verses.translation: Why do you walk in that crooked, zig-zag way?

verses.original: ਅਸਤਿ ਚਰਮ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੂੰਦੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਬੇਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: asat charam bisaTaa ke moo(n)dhe dhuraga(n)dh hee ke bedde ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are nothing more than a bundle of bones, wrapped in skin, filled with manure; you give off such a rotten smell! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam na japahu kavan bhram bhoole tum te kaal na dhoore ||
verses.translation: You do not meditate on the Lord. What doubts have confused and deluded you? Death is not far away from you!

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar ih tan raakhahu rahai avasathaa poore ||2||
verses.translation: Making all sorts of efforts, you manage to preserve this body, but it shall only survive until its time is up. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aapan keeaa kachhoo na hovai kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
verses.translation: By one's own efforts, nothing is done. What can the mere mortal accomplish?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavai satigur bheTai eko naam bakhaanee ||3||
verses.translation: When it pleases the Lord, the mortal meets the True Guru, and chants the Name of the One Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਲੂਆ ਕੇ ਘਰੂਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਫੁਲਵਤ ਦੇਹ ਅਇਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: balooaa ke gharooaa meh basate fulavat dheh iaane ||
verses.translation: You live in a house of sand, but you still puff up your body - you ignorant fool!

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਬੂਡੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jeh raam na chetio boodde bahut siaane ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those who do not remember the Lord may be very clever, but they still drown. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਟੇਢੀ ਪਾਗ ਟੇਢੇ ਚਲੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬੀਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: Teddee paag Tedde chale laage beere khaan ||
verses.translation: Your turban is crooked, and you walk crooked; and now you have started chewing betel leaves.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਦੀਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhagat siau kaaj na kachhooaai mero kaam dheevaan ||1||
verses.translation: You have no use at all for loving devotional worship; you say you have business in court. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam bisaario hai abhimaan ||
verses.translation: In your egotistical pride, you have forgotten the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kanik kaamanee mahaa su(n)dharee pekh pekh sach maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon your gold, and your very beautiful wife, you believe that they are permanent. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: laalach jhooTh bikaar mahaa madh ieh bidh aaudh bihaan ||
verses.translation: You are engrossed in greed, falsehood, corruption and great arrogance. Your life is passing away.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਰ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer a(n)t kee ber aai laago kaal nidhaan ||2||5||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, at the very last moment, death will come and seize you, you fool! ||2||5||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਉਬਤਿ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaar dhin apanee naubat chale bajai ||
verses.translation: The mortal beats the drum for a few days, and then he must depart.

verses.original: ਇਤਨਕੁ ਖਟੀਆ ਗਠੀਆ ਮਟੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eitanak khaTeeaa gaTheeaa maTeeaa sa(n)g na kachh lai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With so much wealth and cash and buried treasure, still, he cannot take anything with him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਿਹਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਿਹਰੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਲਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiharee baiThee miharee rovai dhuaarai lau sa(n)g mai ||
verses.translation: Sitting on the threshhold, his wife weeps and wails; his mother accompanies him to the outer gate.

verses.original: ਮਰਹਟ ਲਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: marahaT lag sabh log kuTa(n)b mil ha(n)s ikelaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: All the people and relatives together go to the crematorium, but the swan-soul must go home all alone. ||1||

verses.original: ਵੈ ਸੁਤ ਵੈ ਬਿਤ ਵੈ ਪੁਰ ਪਾਟਨ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: vai sut vai bit vai pur paaTan bahur na dhekhai aai ||
verses.translation: Those children, that wealth, that city and town - he shall not come to see them again.

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer raam kee na simarahu janam akaarath jai ||2||6||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, why do you not meditate on the Lord? Your life is uselessly slipping away! ||2||6||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag kedhaaraa baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਜੁਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: khaT karam kul sa(n)jugat hai har bhagat hiradhai naeh ||
verses.translation: One who performs the six religious rituals and comes from a good family, but who does not have devotion to the Lord in his heart,

verses.original: ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਥਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਪਚ ਤੁਲਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charanaarabi(n)dh na kathaa bhaavai supach tul samaan ||1||
verses.translation: one who does not appreciate talk of the Lord's Lotus Feet, is just like an outcaste, a pariah. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: re chit chet chet achet ||
verses.translation: Be conscious, be conscious, be conscious, O my unconscious mind.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਬਾਲਮੀਕਹਿ ਦੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe na baalameekeh dhekh ||
verses.translation: Why do you not look at Baalmeek?

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਕਿਹ ਪਦਹਿ ਅਮਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਸੇਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kis jaat te keh padheh amario raam bhagat bisekh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: From such a low social status, what a high status he obtained! Devotional worship to the Lord is sublime! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਜਾਤੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿ੍ਰਸ੍ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: suaan satr ajaat sabh te kirarasan laavai het ||
verses.translation: The killer of dogs, the lowest of all, was lovingly embraced by Krishna.

verses.original: ਲੋਗੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਰਾਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: log bapuraa kiaa saraahai teen lok praves ||2||
verses.translation: See how the poor people praise him! His praise extends throughout the three worlds. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: ajaamal pi(n)gulaa lubhat ku(n)char ge har kai paas ||
verses.translation: Ajaamal, Pingulaa, Lodhia and the elephant went to the Lord.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਤਰਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaise dhuramat nisatare too kiau na tareh ravidhaas ||3||1||
verses.translation: Even such evil-minded beings were emancipated. Why should you not also be saved, O Ravi Daas? ||3||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Bhairao, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without You, nothing happens.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too kar kar dhekheh jaaneh soi ||1||
verses.translation: You create the creatures, and gazing on them, you know them. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa kaheeaai kichh kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh ahai sabh teree rajai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever exists, is by Your Will. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa su terai paas ||
verses.translation: Whatever is to be done, rests with You.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kis aagai keechai aradhaas ||2||
verses.translation: Unto whom should I offer my prayer? ||2||

verses.original: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan sunanaa teree baanee ||
verses.translation: I speak and hear the Bani of Your Word.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too aape jaaneh sarab viddaanee ||3||
verses.translation: You Yourself know all Your Wondrous Play. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: kare karaae jaanai aap ||
verses.translation: You Yourself act, and inspire all to act; only You Yourself know.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhekhai thaap uthaap ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, You, Lord, see, establish and disestablish. ||4||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: raag bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Bhairao, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh tare mun kete i(n)dhraadhik brahamaadh tare ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, so many silent sages have been saved; Indra and Brahma have also been saved.

verses.original: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਤਪਸੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sanak sana(n)dhan tapasee jan kete gur parasaadhee paar pare ||1||
verses.translation: Sanak, Sanandan and many humble men of austerity, by Guru's Grace, have been carried across to the other side. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhavajal bin sabadhai kiau tareeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa jag rog biaapiaa dhubidhaa ddub ddub mareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is entangled in the disease of duality, and is drowned, drowned, and dies. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhevaa gur alakh abhevaa tirabhavan sojhee gur kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru is Divine; the Guru is Inscrutable and Mysterious. Serving the Guru, the three worlds are known and understood.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape dhaat karee gur dhaatai paiaa alakh abhevaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Giver, has Himself given me the Gift; I have obtained the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man raajaa man man te maaniaa manasaa maneh samaiee ||
verses.translation: The mind is the king; the mind is appeased and satisfied through the mind itself, and desire is stilled in the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man jogee man binas biogee man samajhai gun gaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The mind is the Yogi, the mind wastes away in separation from the Lord; singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the mind is instructed and reformed. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur te man maariaa sabadh veechaariaa te virale sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: How very rare are those in this world who, through the Guru, subdue their minds, and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib bharipur leenaa saach sabadh nisataaraa ||4||1||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is All-pervading; through the True Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated. ||4||1||2||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੈਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਰਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: nainee dhirasaT nahee tan heenaa jar jeetiaa sir kaalo ||
verses.translation: The eyes lose their sight, and the body withers away; old age overtakes the mortal, and death hangs over his head.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਛੋਡੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: roop ra(n)g rahas nahee saachaa kiau chhoddai jam jaalo ||1||
verses.translation: Beauty, loving attachment and the pleasures of life are not permanent. How can anyone escape from the noose of death? ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: praanee har jap janam gio ||
verses.translation: O mortal, meditate on the Lord - your life is passing away!

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh bin kabahu na chhooTas birathaa janam bhio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True Word of the Shabad, you shall never be released, and your life shall be totally useless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਠਿਨ ਪੀਰ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tan meh kaam karodh hau mamataa kaThin peer at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Within the body are sexual desire, anger, egotism and attachment. This pain is so great, and so difficult to endure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam japahu ras rasanaa in bidh tar too taaree ||2||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Lord's Name, and savor it with your tongue; in this way, you shall cross over to the other side. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਹਰੇ ਕਰਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਹੋਛੀ ਸਬਦ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahare karan akal bhiee hochhee sabadh sahaj nahee boojhiaa ||
verses.translation: Your ears are deaf, and your intellect is worthless, and still, you do not intuitively understand the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath manmukh haariaa bin gur a(n)dh na soojhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wastes this priceless human life and loses it. Without the Guru, the blind person cannot see. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: rahai udhaas aas niraasaa sahaj dhiaan bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Whoever remains detached and free of desire in the midst of desire - and whoever, unattached, intuitively meditates on the Celestial Lord

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak gurmukh chhooTas raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||3||
verses.translation: - prays Nanak, as Gurmukh, he is released. He is lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||||2||3||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਚਾਲ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਖਿਸਰੇ ਤੁਚਾ ਦੇਹ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhoo(n)ddee chaal charan kar khisare tuchaa dheh kumalaanee ||
verses.translation: His walk becomes weak and clumsy, his feet and hands shake, and the skin of his body is withered and wrinkled.

verses.original: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਧੁੰਧਿ ਕਰਨ ਭਏ ਬਹਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: netree dhu(n)dh karan bhe bahare manmukh naam na jaanee ||1||
verses.translation: His eyes are dim, his ears are deaf, and yet, the self-willed manmukh does not know the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhule kiaa paiaa jag aai ||
verses.translation: O blind man, what have you obtained by coming into the world?

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam ridhai nahee gur kee sevaa chaale mool gavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is not in your heart, and you do not serve the Guru. After wasting your capital, you shall have to depart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਬ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਬ ਫੀਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa ra(n)g nahee har raatee jab bolai tab feeke ||
verses.translation: Your tongue is not imbued with the Love of the Lord; whatever you say is tasteless and insipid.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਨੀਕੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)dhaa viaapas pasoo bhe kadhe hoh na neeke ||2||
verses.translation: You indulge in slander of the Saints; becoming a beast, you shall never be noble. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kaa ras viralee paiaa satigur mel milaae ||
verses.translation: Only a few obtain the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Amrit, united in Union with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jab lag sabadh bhedh nahee aaiaa tab lag kaal sa(n)taae ||3||
verses.translation: As long as the mortal does not come to understand the mystery of the Shabad, the Word of God, he shall continue to be tormented by death. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: an ko dhar ghar kabahoo na jaanas eko dhar sachiaaraa ||
verses.translation: Whoever finds the door of the One True Lord, does not know any other house or door.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||3||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; so says poor Nanak. ||4||3||4||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee rain sovat gal faahee dhinas ja(n)jaal gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: He spends the entire night in sleep; the noose is tied around his neck. His day is wasted in worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin pal ghaRee nahee prabh jaaniaa jin ih jagat upaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He does not know God, who created this world, for a moment, for even an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man re kiau chhooTas dhukh bhaaree ||
verses.translation: O mortal, how will you escape this terrible disaster?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa le aavas kiaa le jaavas raam japahu gunakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What did you bring with you, and what will you take away? Meditate on the Lord, the Most Worthy and Generous Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਂਧਉ ਕਵਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)dhau kaval manmukh mat hochhee man a(n)dhai sir dha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus of the self-willed manmukh is upside-down; his intellect is shallow; his mind is blind, and his head is entangled in worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਲਿ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaal bikaal sadhaa sir terai bin naavai gal fa(n)dhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Death and re-birth constantly hang over your head; without the Name, your neck shall be caught in the noose. ||2||

verses.original: ਡਗਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੁਨਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ddagaree chaal netr fun a(n)dhule sabadh surat nahee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Your steps are unsteady, and your eyes are blind; you are not aware of the Word of the Shabad, O Sibling of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧੁਲਉ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saasatr bedh trai gun hai maiaa a(n)dhulau dha(n)dh kamaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Shaastras and the Vedas keep the mortal bound to the three modes of Maya, and so he performs his deeds blindly. ||3||

verses.original: ਖੋਇਓ ਮੂਲੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: khoio mool laabh keh paavas dhuramat giaan vihoone ||
verses.translation: He loses his capital - how can he earn any profit? The evil-minded person has no spiritual wisdom at all.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabadh beechaar raam ras chaakhiaa naanak saach pateene ||4||4||5||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; O Nanak, his faith is confirmed in the Truth. ||4||4||5||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sa(n)g rahai dhin raatee raam rasan ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: He remains with the Guru, day and night, and his tongue savors the savory taste of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar na jaanas sabadh pachhaanas a(n)tar jaan pachhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: He does not know any other; he realizes the Word of the Shabad. He knows and realizes the Lord deep within his own being. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jan aaisaa mai man bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Such a humble person is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap maar apara(n)par raataa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He conquers his self-conceit, and is imbued with the Infinite Lord. He serves the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar purakh nira(n)jan aadh purakh aadheso ||
verses.translation: Deep within my being, and outside as well, is the Immaculate Lord God. I bow humbly before that Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa sach veso ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, and amidst all, the Embodiment of Truth is permeating and pervading. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saach rate sach a(n)mrit jihavaa mithiaa mail na raiee ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Truth - their tongues are tinged with Truth; they do not have even an iota of the filth of falsehood.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niramal naam a(n)mirat ras chaakhiaa sabadh rate pat paiee ||3||
verses.translation: They taste the sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Shabad, they are blessed with honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਣੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gunee gunee mil laahaa paavas gurmukh naam vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: The virtuous meet with the virtuous, and earn the profit; as Gurmukh, they obtain the glorious greatness of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: sagale dhookh miTeh gur sevaa naanak naam sakhaiee ||4||5||6||
verses.translation: All sorrows are erased, by serving the Guru; O Nanak, the Naam is our only Friend and Companion. ||4||5||6||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਧਨੁ ਧਾਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam sarab dhan dhaaran gur parasaadhee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the wealth and support of all; It is enshrined in the heart, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: amar padhaarath te kirataarath sahaj dhiaan liv laieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: One who gathers this imperishable wealth is fulfilled, and through intuitive meditation, is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: man re raam bhagat chit laieeaai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, focus your consciousness on devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam jap hiradhai sahaj setee ghar jaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord in your heart, and you shall return to your home with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhedh bhau kabahu na chhooTas aavat jaat na jaanee ||
verses.translation: Doubt, separation and fear are never eradicated, and the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation, as long as he does not know the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin har naam ko mukat na paavas ddoob mue bin paanee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated; they drown and die without water. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਸਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa karat sagalee pat khovas bharam na miTas gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: Busy with his worldly affairs, all honor is lost; the ignorant one is not rid of his doubts.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh mukat nahee kab hee a(n)dhule dha(n)dh pasaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is never liberated; he remains blindly entangled in the expanse of worldly affairs. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: akul nira(n)jan siau man maaniaa man hee te man mooaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is pleased and appeased with the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. Through the mind itself, the mind is subdued.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar eko jaaniaa naanak avar na dhooaa ||4||6||7||
verses.translation: Deep within my being, and outside as well, I know only the One Lord. O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||4||6||7||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਗਨ ਹੋਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖੀ ਨਿਤ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jagan hom pu(n)n tap poojaa dheh dhukhee nit dhookh sahai ||
verses.translation: You may give feasts, make burnt offerings, donate to charity, perform austere penance and worship, and endure pain and suffering in the body.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na paavas mukat naam gurmukh lahai ||1||
verses.translation: But without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained. As Gurmukh, obtain the Naam and liberation. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin birathe jag janamaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, birth into the world is useless.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਮਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bikh khaavai bikh bolee bolai bin naavai nihafal mar bhramanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the mortal eats poison and speaks poisonous words; he dies fruitlessly, and wanders in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੁਸਤਕ ਪਾਠ ਬਿਆਕਰਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਤਿਕਾਲ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: pusatak paaTh biaakaran vakhaanai sa(n)dhiaa karam tikaal karai ||
verses.translation: The mortal may read scriptures, study grammar and say his prayers three times a day.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰਝਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh mukat kahaa praanee raam naam bin urajh marai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, where is liberation, O mortal? Without the Lord's Name, the mortal is entangled and dies. ||2||

verses.original: ਡੰਡ ਕਮੰਡਲ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dda(n)dd kama(n)ddal sikhaa soot dhotee teerath gavan at bhraman karai ||
verses.translation: Walking sticks, begging bowls, hair tufts, sacred threads, loin cloths, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and wandering all around

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin saa(n)t na aavai jap har har naamu su paar parai ||3||
verses.translation: - without the Lord's Name, peace and tranquility are not obtained. One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, crosses over to the other side. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਟਾ ਮੁਕਟੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaTaa mukaT tan bhasam lagaiee basatr chhodd tan nagan bhiaa ||
verses.translation: The mortal's hair may be matted and tangled upon his head, and he may smear his body with ashes; he may take off his clothes and go naked.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੈ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਭੇਖੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin tirapat na aavai kirat kai baa(n)dhai bhekh bhiaa ||4||
verses.translation: But without the Lord's Name, he is not satisfied; he wears religious robes, but he is bound by the karma of the actions he committed in past lives. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea ja(n)t jal thal maheeal jatr katr too sarab jeeaa ||
verses.translation: As many beings and creatures as there are in the water, on the land and in the sky - wherever they are, You are with them all, O Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਆ ॥੫॥੭॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh raakh le jan kau har ras naanak jhol peeaa ||5||7||8||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, please preserve Your humble servant; O Lord, Nanak stirs up this juice, and drinks it in. ||5||7||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag bhairau mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Bhairao, Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaat kaa garab na kareeahu koiee ||
verses.translation: No one should be proud of his social class and status.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dhe so braahaman hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaat kaa garab na kar moorakh gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: Do not be proud of your social class and status, you ignorant fool!

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਗਰਬ ਤੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eis garab te chaleh bahut vikaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So much sin and corruption comes from this pride. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਵਰਨ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: chaare varan aakhai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone says that there are four castes, four social classes.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dh te sabh opat hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: They all emanate from the drop of God's Seed. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee ek sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: The entire universe is made of the same clay.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਘੜੈ ਕੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh bhaa(n)dde ghaRai kum(h)aaraa ||3||
verses.translation: The Potter has shaped it into all sorts of vessels. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat mil dhehee kaa aakaaraa ||
verses.translation: The five elements join together, to make up the form of the human body.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਵਧਿ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ghaT vadh ko karai beechaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Who can say which is less, and which is more? ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਮ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak ih jeeau karam ba(n)dh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this soul is bound by its actions.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe mukat na hoiee ||5||1||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, it is not liberated. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jogee girahee pa(n)ddit bhekhadhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Yogis, the householders, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the beggars in religious robes

verses.original: ਏ ਸੂਤੇ ਅਪਣੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e soote apanai aha(n)kaaree ||1||
verses.translation: - they are all asleep in egotism. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa madh maataa rahiaa soi ||
verses.translation: They are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮੂਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat rahai na moosai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only those who remain awake and aware are not robbed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jaagai jis satigur milai ||
verses.translation: One who has met the True Guru, remains awake and aware.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਓਹੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot oh vasagat karai ||2||
verses.translation: Such a person overpowers the five thieves. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jaagai jo tat beechaarai ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates the essence of reality remains awake and aware.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਹ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap marai avaraa neh maarai ||3||
verses.translation: He kills his self-conceit, and does not kill anyone else. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jaagai jo eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who knows the One Lord remains awake and aware.

verses.original: ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: parakirat chhoddai tat pachhaanai ||4||
verses.translation: He abandons the service of others, and realizes the essence of reality. ||4||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chahu varanaa vich jaagai koi ||
verses.translation: Of the four castes, whoever remains awake and aware

verses.original: ਜਮੈ ਕਾਲੈ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jamai kaalai te chhooTai soi ||5||
verses.translation: is released from birth and death. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak jan jaagai soi ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that humble being remains awake and aware,

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥੨॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan jaa kee netree hoi ||6||2||
verses.translation: who applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes. ||6||2||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau raakhai apanee saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord keeps in His Sanctuary,

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saache laagai saachaa fal paiee ||1||
verses.translation: is attached to the Truth, and receives the fruit of Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: re jan kai siau karahu pukaaraa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, unto whom will you complain?

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukame hoaa hukame varataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Hukam of the Lord's Command is pervasive; by the Hukam of His Command, all things happen. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh aakaar teraa hai dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: This Creation was established by You.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khin meh binasai karat na laagai baaraa ||2||
verses.translation: In an instant You destroy it, and You create it again without a moment's delay. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar prasaadh ik khel dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He has staged this Play.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te param padh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: By the Guru's Merciful Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak maar jeevaale soi ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, He alone kills and revives.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaisaa boojhahu bharam na bhoolahu koi ||4||3||
verses.translation: Understand this well - do not be confused by doubt. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai kaaman meraa ka(n)t karataar ||
verses.translation: I am the bride; the Creator is my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਕਰਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਕਰੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jehaa karaae tehaa karee seegaar ||1||
verses.translation: As He inspires me, I adorn myself. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) tis bhaavai taa(n) kare bhog ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, He enjoys me.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man saache saahib jog ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am joined, body and mind, to my True Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat ni(n)dhaa kare kiaa koiee ||
verses.translation: How can anyone praise or slander anyone else?

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) aape varatai eko soiee ||2||
verses.translation: The One Lord Himself is pervading and permeating all. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਿਰਮ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee piram kasaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I am attracted by His Love.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: milaugee dhiaal pa(n)ch sabadh vajaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I shall meet with my Merciful Lord, and vibrate the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak kare kiaa koi ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, what can anyone do?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis no aap milaavai soi ||4||4||
verses.translation: He alone meets with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself meets. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: so mun j man kee dhubidhaa maare ||
verses.translation: He alone is a silent sage, who subdues his mind's duality.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa maar braham beechaare ||1||
verses.translation: Subduing his duality, he contemplates God. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kau koiee khojahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Let each person examine his own mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man khojat naam nau nidh paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Examine your mind, and you shall obtain the nine treasures of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mool moh kar karatai jagat upaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator created the world, upon the foundation of worldly love and attachment.

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੋੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mamataa lai bharam bhuolaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Attaching it to possessiveness, He has led it into confusion with doubt. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis man te sabh pi(n)dd paraanaa ||
verses.translation: From this Mind come all bodies, and the breath of life.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man kai veechaar hukam bujh samaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: By mental contemplation, the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merges in Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: karam hovai gur kirapaa karai ||
verses.translation: When the mortal has good karma, the Guru grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਰੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eih man jaagai is man kee dhubidhaa marai ||4||
verses.translation: Then this mind is awakened, and the duality of this mind is subdued. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa subhaau sadhaa bairaagee ||
verses.translation: It is the innate nature of the mind to remain forever detached.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabh meh vasai ateet anaraagee ||5||
verses.translation: The Detached, Dispassionate Lord dwells within all. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak jo jaanai bheau ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who understands this mystery,

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੬॥੫॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh nira(n)jan dheau ||6||5||
verses.translation: becomes the embodiment of the Primal, Immaculate, Divine Lord God. ||6||5||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jagat nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: The world is saved through Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhavajal paar utaaranahaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: It carries the mortal across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har naam sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, dwell upon the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadh hee nibahai terai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It shall stand by you forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam na cheteh manmukh gaavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai kaise paaveh paaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, how will they cross over? ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaat kare dhaataar ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Great Giver, Himself gives His Gifts.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaare kau jaikaar ||3||
verses.translation: Celebrate and praise the Great Giver! ||3||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare satiguroo milaae ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord unites the mortals with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak hiradhai naam vasaae ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is enshrined within the heart. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਤਨੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
verses.translit: naame udhare sabh jitane loa ||
verses.translation: All people are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jinaa paraapat hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh are blessed to receive It. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau apanee kirapaa karei ||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord showers His Mercy,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam vaddiaaiee dhei ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He blesses the Gurmukh with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jin preet piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who love the Beloved Name of the Lord

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap udhare sabh kul udhaaranahaar ||2||
verses.translation: save themselves, and save all their ancestors. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai manmukh jam pur jaeh ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the self-willed manmukhs go to the City of Death.

verses.original: ਅਉਖੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaukhe hoveh choTaa khaeh ||3||
verses.translation: They suffer in pain and endure beatings. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa dhevai soi ||
verses.translation: When the Creator Himself gives,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam paraapat hoi ||4||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, then the mortals receive the Naam. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh preet sanakaadhik udhaare ||
verses.translation: Love of the Lord of the Universe saved Sanak and his brother, the sons of Brahma.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam sabadh beechaare ||1||
verses.translation: They contemplated the Word of the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau apanee kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naame lagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that as Gurmukh, I may embrace love for Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar preet bhagat saachee hoi ||
verses.translation: Whoever has true loving devotional worship deep within his being

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poorai gur melaavaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: meets the Lord, through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vasai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: He naturally, intuitively dwells within the home of his own inner being.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam vasai man aai ||3||
verses.translation: The Naam abides within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai vekhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Seer, Himself sees.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||4||8||
