verses.translation: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kalajug meh raam naam ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai maathai paavai chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Name, ashes will be blown in your face. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhulabh hai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh vasai man aaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, it comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jan bhaaleh soi ||
verses.translation: That humble being who seeks the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poore gur te praapat hoi ||2||
verses.translation: receives it from the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)neh se jan paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who accept the Will of the Lord, are approved and accepted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh naam neesaan ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they bear the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਲ ਰਹਿਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so sevahu jo kal rahiaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: So serve the One, whose power supports the Universe.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam piaar ||4||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh loves the Naam. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kalajug meh bahu karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, many rituals are performed.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa rut na karam thai paeh ||1||
verses.translation: But it is not the time for them, and so they are of no use. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kalajug meh raam naam hai saar ||
verses.translation: In Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saachaa lagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, be lovingly attached to Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan man khoj gharai meh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Searching my body and mind, I found Him within the home of my own heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam chit laiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan satigur te hoi ||
verses.translation: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is obtained from the True Guru.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam rav rahiaa tih loi ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is pervading the three worlds. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਹੋਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug meh har jeeau ek hor rut na kaiee ||
verses.translation: In Kali Yuga, it is the time for the One Dear Lord; it is not the time for anything else.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh hiradhai raam naam leh jamaiee ||4||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, let the Lord's Name grow within your heart. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa manmukh rog viaape tirasanaa jaleh adhikaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with the disease of duality; they are burnt by the intense fire of desire.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)meh Thaur na paaveh birathaa janam gavaiee ||1||
verses.translation: They die and die again, and are reborn; they find no place of rest. They waste their lives uselessly. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetam kar kirapaa dheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, grant Your Grace, and give me understanding.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rogee jagat upaiaa bin sabadhai rog na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The world was created in the disease of egotism; without the Word of the Shabad, the disease is not cured. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasatr paReh mun kete bin sabadhai surat na paiee ||
verses.translation: There are so many silent sages, who read the Simritees and the Shaastras; without the Shabad, they have no clear awareness.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: trai gun sabhe rog viaape mamataa surat gavaiee ||2||
verses.translation: All those under the influence of the three qualities are afflicted with the disease; through possessiveness, they lose their awareness. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape kaadd le prabh aape gur sevaa prabh laae ||
verses.translation: O God, you save some, and you enjoin others to serve the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nidhaano paiaa sukh vasiaa man aai ||3||
verses.translation: They obtain the treasure of the Name of the Lord; peace comes to abide within their minds. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chauthee padhavee gurmukh varateh tin nij ghar vaasaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs dwell in the fourth state; they obtain a dwelling in the home of their own inner being.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: poorai satigur kirapaa keenee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru shows His Mercy to them; they eradicate their self-conceit from within. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਏਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ekas kee sir kaar ek jin brahamaa bisan rudhr upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone must serve the One Lord, who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nihachal saachaa eko naa oh marai na jaiaa ||5||1||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One True Lord is permanent and stable. He does not die, and He is not born. ||5||1||11||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhubidhaa sadhaa hai rogee rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is afflicted with the disease of duality forever; the entire universe is diseased.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh boojheh rog gavaaveh gur sabadhee veechaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh understands, and is cured of the disease, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau satasa(n)gat melai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tis no dhei vaddiaaiee jo raam naam chit lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord blesses with glorious greatness, those who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mamataa kaal sabh rog viaape tin jam kee hai sir kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Death takes all those who are afflicted with the disease of possessiveness. They are subject to the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh praanee jam neR na aavai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that mortal who, as Gurmukh, enshrines the Lord within his heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin har kaa naam na gurmukh jaataa se jag meh kaahe aaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who does not know the Lord's Name, and who does not become Gurmukh - why did he even come into the world?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa kadhe na keenee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: He never serves the Guru; he wastes his life uselessly. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naanak se poore vaddabhaagee satigur sevaa laae ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whom the True Guru enjoins to His service, have perfect good fortune.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jo ichheh soiee fal paaveh gurbaanee sukh paae ||4||2||12||
verses.translation: They obtain the fruits of their desires, and find peace in the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||4||2||12||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh vich ja(n)mai dhukh marai dhukh vich kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: In pain he is born, in pain he dies, and in pain he does his deeds.

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: garabh jonee vich kadhe na nikalai bisaTaa maeh samai ||1||
verses.translation: He is never released from the womb of reincarnation; he rots away in manure. ||1||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag dhirag manmukh janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Cursed, cursed is the self-willed manmukh, who wastes his life away.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee sev na keenee har kaa naam na bhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not serve the Perfect Guru; he does not love the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh sabh rog gavaae jis no har jeeau laae ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad cures all diseases; he alone is attached to it, whom the Dear Lord attaches.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naame naam milai vaddiaaiee jis no ma(n)n vasaae ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; he alone obtains it, whose mind is filled with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai taa fal paae sach karanee sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the fruitful rewards are obtained. This true lifestyle brings sublime peace.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se jan niramal jo har laage har naame dhareh piaar ||3||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are attached to the Lord are immaculate; they enshrine love for the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee ren milai taa(n) masatak laiee jin satigur pooraa dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: If I obtain the dust of their feet, I apply it to my forehead. They meditate on the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kee ren poorai bhaag paieeaai jinee raam naam chit laiaa ||4||3||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this dust is obtained only by perfect destiny. They focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||4||3||13||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh beechaare so jan saachaa jin kai hiradhai saachaa soiee ||
verses.translation: That humble being who contemplates the Word of the Shabad is true; the True Lord is within his heart.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤਾਂ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saachee bhagat kareh dhin raatee taa(n) tan dhookh na hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: If someone performs true devotional worship day and night, then his body will not feel pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhagat kahai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone calls him, ""Devotee, devotee.""

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve bhagat na paieeaai poorai bhaag milai prabh soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But without serving the True Guru, devotional worship is not obtained. Only through perfect destiny does one meet God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਿਦੂ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mool gavaaveh laabh maageh laahaa laabh kidhoo hoiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs lose their capital, and still, they demand profits. How can they earn any profit?

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jamakaal sadhaa hai sir uoopar dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death is always hovering above their heads. In the love of duality, they lose their honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bahale bhekh bhaveh dhin raatee haumai rog na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Trying on all sorts of religious robes, they wander around day and night, but the disease of their egotism is not cured.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paR paR loojheh baadh vakhaaneh mil maiaa surat gavaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Reading and studying, they argue and debate; attached to Maya, they lose their awareness. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh param gat paaveh naam milai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with the supreme status; through the Naam, they are blessed with glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam jinaa man vasiaa dhar saachai pat paiee ||4||4||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Naam, are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||4||14||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh aasaa nahee utarai dhoojai bhai khuaae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh cannot escape false hope. In the love of duality, he is ruined.

verses.original: ਉਦਰੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੁ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਕਬਹੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਚਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: audhar nai saan na bhareeaai kabahoo tirasanaa agan pachaae ||1||
verses.translation: His belly is like a river - it is never filled up. He is consumed by the fire of desire. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh raam ras raate ||
verses.translation: Eternally blissful are those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam dhubidhaa man bhaagee har har a(n)mrit pee tirapataate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, fills their hearts, and duality runs away from their minds. Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape paarabraham sirasaT jin saajee sir sir dha(n)dhai laae ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God Himself created the Universe; He links each and every person to their tasks.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh keeaa jin aape aape dhoojai laae ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself created love and attachment to Maya; He Himself attaches the mortals to duality. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tis no kih kaheeaai je dhoojaa hovai sabh tudhai maeh samaae ||
verses.translation: If there were any other, then I would speak to him; all will be merged in You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan tat beechaaraa jotee jot milaae ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; his light merges into the Light. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh saachaa sadh hee saachaa saachaa sabh aakaaraa ||
verses.translation: God is True, Forever True, and all His Creation is True.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur sojhee paiee sach naam nisataaraa ||4||5||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding; the True Name brings emancipation. ||4||5||15||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh pret jin(h)ee raam na pachhaataa satajug param ha(n)s beechaaree ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who do not realize the Lord are goblins. In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the supreme soul-swans contemplated the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuaapur tretai maanas varateh viralai haumai maaree ||1||
verses.translation: In the Silver Age of Dwaapur Yuga, and the Brass Age of Traytaa Yuga, mankind prevailed, but only a rare few subdued their egos. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh raam naam vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness is obtained through the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug gurmukh eko jaataa vin naavai mukat na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs know the One Lord; without the Name, liberation is not attained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖੈ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam lakhai jan saachaa gurmukh ma(n)n vasaiee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is revealed in the heart of the True Lord's humble servant. It dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap tare sagale kul taare jinee raam naam liv laiee ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are lovingly focused on the Lord's Name save themselves; they save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh hai gun kaa dhaataa avagan sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: My Lord God is the Giver of virtue. The Word of the Shabad burns away all faults and demerits.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin man vasiaa se jan sohe hiradhai naam vasaae ||3||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam are beautiful; they enshrine the Naam within their hearts. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar mahal satiguroo dhikhaiaa ra(n)g siau raleeaa maanai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed to me the Lord's Home and His Court, and the Mansion of His Presence. I joyfully enjoy His Love.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kahai su bhalaa kar maanai naanak naam vakhaanai ||4||6||16||
verses.translation: Whatever He says, I accept as good; Nanak chants the Naam. ||4||6||16||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maneh samai lai gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: The desires of the mind are absorbed in the mind, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poore te sojhee pavai fir marai na vaaro vaar ||1||
verses.translation: Understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru, and then the mortal does not die over and over again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere raam naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: My mind takes the Support of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa sabh ichh pujaavanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; the Lord is the Fulfiller of all desires. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh eko rav rahiaa gur bin boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is permeating and pervading amongst all; without the Guru, this understanding is not obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pragaT hoaa meraa har prabh anadhin har gun gai ||2||
verses.translation: My Lord God has been revealed to me, and I have become Gurmukh. Night and day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa har ek hai hor thai sukh na paeh ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of peace; peace is not found anywhere else.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee na seviaa dhaataa se a(n)t ge pachhutaeh ||3||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the Giver, the True Guru, depart regretfully in the end. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa fir dhukh na laagai dhai ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is obtained, and the mortal does not suffer in pain any longer.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak har bhagat paraapat hoiee jotee jot samai ||4||7||17||
verses.translation: Nanak has been blessed with devotional worship of the Lord; his light has merged into the Light. ||4||7||17||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਭੂਲਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa bhoolaa choTaa khaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the world is insane; confused and deluded, it is beaten, and it suffers.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)mai sadhaa dhukh paae dhar kee khabar na paiee ||1||
verses.translation: It dies and dies again, and is reborn, always in pain, but it is unaware of the Lord's Gate. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man sadhaa rahahu satigur kee saranaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain always in the Protection of the True Guru's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har naam meeThaa sadh laagaa gur sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those people, to whose hearts the Lord's Name seems sweet, are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhekh karai bahut chit ddolai a(n)tar kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The mortal wears various religious robes, but his consciousness is unsteady; deep within, he is filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਭੂਖ ਅਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਭਉਕਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar tisaa bhookh at bahutee bhaukat firai dhar baar ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within is the great thirst and immense hunger; he wanders from door to door. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh mareh fir jeeveh tin kau mukat dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Those who die in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are reborn; they find the door of liberation.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadhaa sukh hovai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||3||
verses.translation: With constant peace and tranquility deep within, they enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai karanaa kichhoo na jaiee ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, He inspires us to act. Nothing else can be done.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sabadh sam(h)aale raam naam vaddiaaiee ||4||8||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Lord's Name. ||4||8||18||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maiaa moh khuaaiaa dhukh khaTe dhukh khai ||
verses.translation: Lost in egotism, Maya and attachment, the mortal earns pain, and eats pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਹਲਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh halak dhukh bhaaree bin bibek bharamai ||1||
verses.translation: The great disease, the rabid disease of greed, is deep within him; he wanders around indiscriminately. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhirag jeevan saisaar ||
verses.translation: The life of the self-willed manmukh in this world is cursed.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam supanai nahee chetiaa har siau kadhe na laagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not remember the Lord's Name, even in his dreams. He is never in love with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਸੂਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pasooaa karam karai nahee boojhai kooR kamaavai kooRo hoi ||
verses.translation: He acts like a beast, and does not understand anything. Practicing falsehood, he becomes false.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta ulaTee hovai khoj lahai jan koi ||2||
verses.translation: But when the mortal meets the True Guru, his way of looking at the world changes. How rare are those humble beings who seek and find the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam ridhai sadh vasiaa paiaa gunee nidhaan ||
verses.translation: That person, whose heart is forever filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, obtains the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee pooraa paiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he finds the Perfect Lord; the egotistical pride of his mind is eradicated. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kare karaae aape maarag paae ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act. He Himself places us on the path.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee naanak naam samaae ||4||9||19||
verses.translation: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness; O Nanak, he merges in the Naam. ||4||9||19||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: meree paTeeaa likhahu har govi(n)dh gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: Upon my writing tablet, I write the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਾਥੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai faathe jam jaalaa ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, the mortals are caught in the noose of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kare meree pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru nurtures and sustains me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa merai naalaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is always with me. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes prahilaadh har ucharai ||
verses.translation: Following his Guru's instructions, Prahlaad chanted the Lord's Name;

verses.original: ਸਾਸਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਗਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saasanaa te baalak gam na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: he was a child, but he was not afraid when his teacher yelled at him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maataa upadhesai prahilaadh piaare ||
verses.translation: Prahlaad's mother gave her beloved son some advice:

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: putr raam naam chhoddahu jeeau leh ubaare ||
verses.translation: "My son, you must abandon the Lord's Name, and save your life!"

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prahilaadh kahai sunahu meree mai ||
verses.translation: Prahlaad said: ""Listen, O my mother;

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam na chhoddaa gur dheeaa bujhai ||2||
verses.translation: I shall never give up the Lord's Name. My Guru has taught me this.""||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)ddaa marakaa sabh jai pukaare ||
verses.translation: Sandaa and Markaa, his teachers, went to his father the king, and complained:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਗੜਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਵਿਗਾੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: prahilaadh aap vigaRiaa sabh chaaTaRe vigaaRe ||
verses.translation: "Prahlaad himself has gone astray, and he leads all the other pupils astray."

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaT sabhaa meh ma(n)tr pakaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the court of the wicked king, a plan was hatched.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prahalaadh kaa raakhaa hoi raghuraiaa ||3||
verses.translation: God is the Savior of Prahlaad. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਾਥਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haath khaRag kar dhaiaa at aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: With sword in hand, and with great egotistical pride, Prahlaad's father ran up to him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਝੁ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har teraa kahaa tujh le ubaar ||
verses.translation: "Where is your Lord, who will save you?"

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੈਆਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਥੰਮੑ ਉਪਾੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh bhaiaan roop nikasiaa tha(n)m(h) upaaR ||
verses.translation: In an instant, the Lord appeared in a dreadful form, and shattered the pillar.

verses.original: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: haranaakhas nakhee bidhaariaa prahalaadh leeaa ubaar ||4||
verses.translation: Harnaakhash was torn apart by His claws, and Prahlaad was saved. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa ke har jeeau kaaraj savaare ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord completes the tasks of the Saints.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prahalaadh jan ke ikeeh kul udhaare ||
verses.translation: He saved twenty-one generations of Prahlaad's descendents.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh haumai bikh maare ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the poison of egotism is neutralized.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam sa(n)t nisataare ||5||10||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Name of the Lord, the Saints are emancipated. ||5||10||20||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੈਤ ਲਾਇ ਦਿਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhait lai dhite sa(n)t janaa kau aape raakhaa soiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself makes demons pursue the Saints, and He Himself saves them.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo teree sadhaa saranaiee tin man dhukh na hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who remain forever in Your Sanctuary, O Lord - their minds are never touched by sorrow. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug bhagataa kee rakhadhaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, the Lord saves the honor of His devotees.

verses.original: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhait putr prahalaadh gaitree tarapan kichhoo na jaanai sabadhe mel milaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Prahlaad, the demon's son, knew nothing of the Hindu morning prayer, the Gayatri, and nothing about ceremonial water-offerings to his ancestors; but through the Word of the Shabad, he was united in the Lord's Union. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee dhubidhaa sabadhe khoiee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he performed devotional worship service, day and night, and through the Shabad, his duality was eradicated.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa niramal hai jo sach raate sach vasiaa man soiee ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate and pure; the True Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh dhubidhaa paRheh mool na pachhaaneh birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fools in duality read, but they do not understand anything; they waste their lives uselessly.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੈਤੁ ਚਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)dhaa kareh dhusaT dhait chiRaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The wicked demon slandered the Saint, and stirred up trouble. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਡਰੈ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prahalaadh dhubidhaa na paRai har naam na chhoddai ddarai na kisai dhaa ddaraiaa ||
verses.translation: Prahlaad did not read in duality, and he did not abandon the Lord's Name; he was not afraid of any fear.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਾ ਦੈਤੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kaa har jeeau raakhaa dhaitai kaal neRaa aaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord became the Savior of the Saint, and the demonic Death could not even approach him. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee paij aape raakhai bhagataa(n) dhei vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself saved his honor, and blessed his devotee with glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ਅੰਧੈ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak haranaakhas nakhee bidhaariaa a(n)dhai dhar kee khabar na paiee ||5||11||21||
verses.translation: O Nanak, Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord with His claws; the blind demon knew nothing of the Lord's Court. ||5||11||21||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Bhairao, Fourth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗਿ ਲਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jan sa(n)t kar kirapaa pag lain ||
verses.translation: The Lord, in His Mercy, attaches mortals to the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee har bhaj surat samain ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, vibrate and meditate on the Lord; let your awareness be absorbed in Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har bhaj naam narain ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord and the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa kare sukhadhaataa gurmukh bhavajal har naam tarain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of Peace, grants His Grace; the Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat saadh mel har gain ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmatee le raam rasain ||2||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur saadhoo a(n)mirat giaan sar nain ||
verses.translation: Bathe in the pool of ambrosial nectar, the spiritual wisdom of the Holy Guru.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਗਾਵਾਇਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh kilavikh paap ge gaavain ||3||
verses.translation: All sins will be eliminated and eradicated. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: too aape karataa sirasaT dharain ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Creator, the Support of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak mel teraa dhaas dhasain ||4||1||
verses.translation: Please unite servant Nanak with Yourself; he is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਫਲ ਸਾ ਘਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bol har naam safal saa gharee ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is that moment when the Lord's Name is spoken.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes sabh dhukh paraharee ||1||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, all pains are taken away. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har bhaj naam naraharee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਉ ਤਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa melahu gur pooraa satasa(n)gat sa(n)g si(n)dh bhau taree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, be merciful, and unite me with the Perfect Guru. Joining with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan dhiaai man har simaree ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Life of the World; remember the Lord in your mind.

verses.original: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koT koTa(n)tar tere paap paraharee ||2||
verses.translation: Millions upon millions of your sins shall be taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat saadh dhoor mukh paree ||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, apply the dust of the feet of the holy to your face;

verses.original: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eisanaan keeo aThasaTh surasaree ||3||
verses.translation: this is how to bathe in the sixty-eight sacred shrines, and the Ganges. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh kau har kirapaa karee ||
verses.translation: I am a fool; the Lord has shown mercy to me.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak taario taaran haree ||4||2||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord has saved servant Nanak. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sukirat karanee saar japamaalee ||
verses.translation: To do good deeds is the best rosary.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hiradhai fer chalai tudh naalee ||1||
verses.translation: Chant on the beads within your heart, and it shall go along with you. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu banavaalee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Lord of the forest.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa melahu satasa(n)gat tooT giee maiaa jam jaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Have mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may be released from Maya's noose of death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevaa ghaal jin ghaalee ||
verses.translation: Whoever, as Gurmukh, serves and works hard,

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਟਕਸਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis ghaReeaai sabadh sachee Takasaalee ||2||
verses.translation: is molded and shaped in the true mint of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਦਿਖਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agochar gur agam dhikhaalee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has revealed to me the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vich kaiaa nagar ladhaa har bhaalee ||3||
verses.translation: Searching within the body-village, I have found the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik har pitaa pratipaalee ||
verses.translation: I am just a child; the Lord is my Father, who nurtures and cherishes me.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak taarahu nadhar nihaalee ||4||3||
verses.translation: Please save servant Nanak, Lord; bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT tere too sabhanaa maeh ||
verses.translation: All hearts are Yours, Lord; You are in all.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar koiee naeh ||1||
verses.translation: There is nothing at all except You. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa mere man jaap ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau tudh saalaahee too meraa har prabh baap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I praise You, O Lord God, You are my Father. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh har prabh soi ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see only the Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh terai vas dhoojaa avar na koi ||2||
verses.translation: All are under Your control; there is no other at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau tum har raakhiaa bhaavai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, when it is Your Will to save someone,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis kai neRai koi na jaavai ||3||
verses.translation: then nothing can threaten him. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: too jal thal maheeal sabh tai bharapoor ||
verses.translation: You are totally pervading and permeating the waters, the lands, the skies and all places.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har jap haajaraa hajoor ||4||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Ever-present Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa sa(n)t har kee har moorat jis hiradhai har naam muraar ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saint is the embodiment of the Lord; within his heart is the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: masatak bhaag hovai jis likhiaa so gurmat hiradhai har naam sam(h)aar ||1||
verses.translation: One who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, follows the Guru's Teachings, and contemplates the Name of the Lord within his heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: madhusoodhan japeeaai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Enshrine Him in your heart, and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee nagar tasakar pa(n)ch dhaatoo gur sabadhee har kaadde maar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The five plundering thieves are in the body-village; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord has beaten them and driven them out. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin kaa har setee man maaniaa tin kaaraj har aap savaar ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are satisfied with the Lord - the Lord Himself resolves their affairs.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin chookee muhataajee lokan kee har a(n)geekaar keeaa karataar ||2||
verses.translation: Their subservience and their dependence on other people is ended; the Creator Lord is on their side. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mataa masoorat taa(n) kichh keejai je kichh hovai har baahar ||
verses.translation: If something were beyond the realm of the Lord's Power, only then would we have recourse to consult someone else.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai soiee bhal hosee har dhiaavahu anadhin naam muraar ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does is good. Meditate on the Name of the Lord, night and day. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਓਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jo kichh kare su aape aape oh poochh na kisai kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, He does by Himself. He does not ask or consult anyone else.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak so prabh sadhaa dhiaaieeaai jin meliaa satigur kirapaa dhaar ||4||1||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on God; granting His Grace, He unites us with the True Guru. ||4||1||5||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: te saadhoo har melahu suaamee jin japiaa gat hoi hamaaree ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with the Holy people; meditating on You, I am saved.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin kaa dharas dhekh man bigasai khin khin tin kau hau balihaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, my mind blossoms forth. Each and every moment, I am a sacrifice to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har hiradhai jap naam muraaree ||
verses.translation: Meditate within your heart on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar jagat pit suaamee ham dhaasan dhaas keejai panihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Show Mercy, Mercy to me, O Father of the World, O my Lord and Master; make me the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tin mat uootam tin pat uootam jin hiradhai vasiaa banavaaree ||
verses.translation: Their intellect is sublime and exalted, and so is their honor; the Lord, the Lord of the forest, abides within their hearts.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee sevaa lai har suaamee tin simarat gat hoi hamaaree ||2||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please link me to the service of those who meditate in remembrance on You, and are saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin aaisaa satigur saadh na paiaa te har dharageh kaadde maaree ||
verses.translation: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru are beaten, and driven out of the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਕ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: te nar ni(n)dhak sobh na paaveh tin nak kaaTe sirajanahaaree ||3||
verses.translation: These slanderous people have no honor or reputation; their noses are cut by the Creator Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har aap bulaavai aape bolai har aap nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar niraahaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself speaks, and the Lord Himself inspires all to speak; He is Immaculate and Formless, and needs no sustenance.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: har jis too meleh so tudh milasee jan naanak kiaa eh ja(n)t vichaaree ||4||2||6||
verses.translation: O Lord, he alone meets You, whom You cause to meet. Says servant Nanak, I am a wretched creature. What can I do? ||4||2||6||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat saiee har teree jit har keerat har sunane ||
verses.translation: That is Your True Congregation, Lord, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are heard.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin har naam suniaa man bheenaa tin ham sreveh nit charane ||1||
verses.translation: The minds of those who listen to the Lord's Name are drenched with bliss; I worship their feet continually. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan har dhiaai tarane ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, the Life of the World, the mortals cross over.

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਤੁ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anek asa(n)kh naam har tere na jaahee jihavaa it ganane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Names are so many, they are countless, O Lord. This tongue of mine cannot even count them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਲੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: gursikh har bolahu har gaavahu le gurmat har japane ||
verses.translation: O Gursikhs, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Praises of the Lord. Take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo upadhes sune gur keraa so jan paavai har sukh ghane ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever listens to the Guru's Teachings - that humble being receives countless comforts and pleasures from the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su va(n)s dha(n)nu su pitaa dha(n)nu su maataa jin jan jane ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the ancestry, blessed is the father, and blessed is that mother who gave birth to this humble servant.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin saas giraas dhiaaiaa meraa har har se saachee dharageh har jan bane ||3||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and morsel of food - those humble servants of the Lord look beautiful in the True Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har agam naam har tere vich bhagataa har dharane ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Names are profound and infinite; Your devotees cherish them deep within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਣੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak jan paiaa mat gurmat jap har har paar pavane ||4||3||7||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has obained the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, he crosses over to the other side. ||4||3||7||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਥੀਤਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥ ਅਸਟਮ ਥੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਨਮਾ ਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagalee theet paas ddaar raakhee || asaTam theet govi(n)dh janamaa see ||1||
verses.translation: Setting aside all other days, it is said that the Lord was born on the eighth lunar day. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਰ ਕਰਤ ਕਚਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhoole nar karat kacharain ||
verses.translation: Deluded and confused by doubt, the mortal practices falsehood.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran te rahat naarain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is beyond birth and death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪੰਜੀਰੁ ਖਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: kar pa(n)jeer khavaio chor ||
verses.translation: You prepare sweet treats and feed them to your stone god.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਢੋਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oh janam na marai re saakat ddor ||2||
verses.translation: God is not born, and He does not die, you foolish, faithless cynic! ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਧ ਦੇਹਿ ਲੋਰੋਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal paraadh dheh loronee ||
verses.translation: You sing lullabyes to your stone god - this is the source of all your mistakes.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜੋਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so mukh jalau jit kaheh Thaakur jonee ||3||
verses.translation: Let that mouth be burnt, which says that our Lord and Master is subject to birth. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam na marai na aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: He is not born, and He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa prabh rahio samai ||4||1||
verses.translation: The God of Nanak is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat sukheeaa baiThat sukheeaa ||
verses.translation: Standing up, I am at peace; sitting down, I am at peace.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਂ ਐਸੇ ਬੁਝੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhau nahee laagai jaa(n) aaise bujheeaa ||1||
verses.translation: I feel no fear, because this is what I understand. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: raakhaa ek hamaaraa suaamee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Protector.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal ghaTaa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਗਿ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: soi achi(n)taa jaag achi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: I sleep without worry, and I awake without worry.

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਕਹਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jahaa kahaa(n) prabh too(n) varata(n)taa ||2||
verses.translation: You, O God, are pervading everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar sukh vasiaa baahar sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I dwell in peace in my home, and I am at peace outside.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur ma(n)tr dhiraRaiaa ||3||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਰਤ ਨ ਰਹਉ ਨ ਮਹ ਰਮਦਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: varat na rahau na meh ramadhaanaa ||
verses.translation: I do not keep fasts, nor do I observe the month of Ramadaan.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਜੋ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis sevee jo rakhai nidhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I serve only the One, who will protect me in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek gusaiee alahu meraa ||
verses.translation: He is my One Lord, the same Lord who the Hindus call "Gussayee" and the Muslims call "Allah".

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹਾਂ ਨੇਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo turak dhuhaa(n) neberaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He adminsters justice to both Hindus and Muslims. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਉ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: haj kaabai jaau na teerath poojaa ||
verses.translation: I do not make pilgrimages to Mecca, nor do I worship at Hindu sacred shrines.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eko sevee avar na dhoojaa ||2||
verses.translation: I serve the One Lord, and not any other. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਉ ਨ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa karau na nivaaj gujaarau ||
verses.translation: I do not perform Hindu worship services, nor do I offer the Muslim prayers.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਲੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek nira(n)kaar le ridhai namasakaarau ||3||
verses.translation: I have taken the One Formless Lord into my heart; I humbly worship Him there. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਨ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: naa ham hi(n)dhoo na musalamaan ||
verses.translation: I am not a Hindu, nor am I a Muslim.

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aleh raam ke pi(n)dd paraan ||4||
verses.translation: My body and breath of life belong to Allah - to Raam - the God of both. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ih keeaa vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, this is what I say:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur peer mil khudh khasam pachhaanaa ||5||3||
verses.translation: meeting with the Guru, my Spiritual Teacher, I realize God, my Lord and Master. ||5||3||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਸ ਮਿਰਗੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhas miragee sahaje ba(n)dh aanee ||
verses.translation: I easily tied up the deer - the ten sensory organs.

verses.original: ਪਾਂਚ ਮਿਰਗ ਬੇਧੇ ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paa(n)ch mirag bedhe siv kee baanee ||1||
verses.translation: I shot five of the desires with the Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲੇ ਚੜਿਓ ਸਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g le chaRio sikaar ||
verses.translation: I go out hunting with the Saints,

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਕਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਹਥੀਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mirag pakare bin ghor hatheeaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and we capture the deer without horses or weapons. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਖੇਰ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakher birat baahar aaio dhai ||
verses.translation: My mind used to run around outside hunting.

verses.original: ਅਹੇਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਗਾਂਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aheraa paio ghar kai gaa(n)i ||2||
verses.translation: But now, I have found the game within the home of my body-village. ||2||

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਕਰੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੇ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: mirag pakare ghar aane haaT ||
verses.translation: I caught the deer and brought them home.

verses.original: ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਾਂਢੇ ਬਾਟਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chukh chukh le ge baa(n)dde baaT ||3||
verses.translation: Dividing them up, I shared them, bit by bit. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਅਹੇਰਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh aheraa keeno dhaan ||
verses.translation: God has given this gift.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak kai ghar keval naam ||4||4||
verses.translation: Nanak's home is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚਿ ਲੋਚਿ ਖਾਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: je sau loch loch khaavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Even though he may be fed with hundreds of longings and yearnings,

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saakat har har cheet na aaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: still the faithless cynic does not remember the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee leh mate ||
verses.translation: Take in the teachings of the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g paavahu param gate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paathar kau bahu neer pavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Stones may be kept under water for a long time.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਭੀਗੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਸੂਕਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: neh bheegai adhik sookaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Even so, they do not absorb the water; they remain hard and dry. ||2||

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਰਖੈ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khaT saasatr moorakhai sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: The six Shaastras may be read to a fool,

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaise dheh dhis pavan jhulaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: but it is like the wind blowing in the ten directions. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਣ ਖਲਹਾਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਹਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin kan khalahaan jaise gaahan paiaa ||
verses.translation: It is like threshing a crop without any corn - nothing is gained.

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਰਾਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tiau saakat te ko na baraasaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: In the same way, no benefit comes from the faithless cynic. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tit hee laagaa jit ko laiaa ||
verses.translation: As the Lord attaches them, so are all attached.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh banat banaiaa ||5||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God has formed such a form. ||5||5||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan jin rachio sareer ||
verses.translation: He created the soul, the breath of life and the body.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jineh upaae tis kau peer ||1||
verses.translation: He created all beings, and knows their pains. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur gobi(n)dh jeea kai kaam ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, is the Helper of the soul.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਦ ਛਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat jaa kee sadh chhaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Here and herafter, He always provides shade. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh aaraadhan niramal reet ||
verses.translation: Worship and adoration of God is the pure way of life.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g binasee bipareet ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of duality vanishes. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਨਹ ਪਾਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: meet heet dhan neh paaranaa ||
verses.translation: Friends, well-wishers and wealth will not support you.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n mere naarainaa ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is my Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bolai a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: Nanak utters the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: ek binaa dhoojaa nahee jaanee ||4||6||
verses.translation: Except the One Lord, he does not know any other at all. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਦਯੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: aagai dhay paachhai naarain ||
verses.translation: The Lord is in front of me, and the Lord is behind me.

verses.original: ਮਧਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: madh bhaag har prem rasain ||1||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord, the Source of Nectar, is in the middle as well. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਉਣ ॥
verses.translit: prabhoo hamaarai saasatr saun ||
verses.translation: God is my Shaastra and my favorable omen.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਉਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh gireh bhaun ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In His Home and Mansion, I find peace, poise and bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa naam karan sun jeeve ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with my tongue, and hearing it with my ears, I live.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਮਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh simar simar amar thir theeve ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I have become eternal, permanent and stable. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke dhookh nivaare ||
verses.translation: The pains of countless lifetimes have been erased.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh vaje dharabaare ||3||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, vibrates in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh le'ee milaae ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God has blended me with Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagat aae ||4||7||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: koT manorath aaveh haath ||
verses.translation: It brings millions of desires to fulfillment.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੀ ਪਾਂਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jam maarag kai sa(n)gee paa(n)th ||1||
verses.translation: On the Path of Death, It will go with you and help you. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa jal gur gobi(n)dh naam ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe, is the holy water of the Ganges.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai peevat bahuR na jon bhramaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on it, is saved; drinking it in, the mortal does not wander in reincarnation again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa jaap taap isanaan ||
verses.translation: It is my worship, meditation, austerity and cleansing bath.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simarat naam bhe nihakaam ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I have become free of desire. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਾਲ ਸਾਦਨ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: raaj maal saadhan dharabaar ||
verses.translation: It is my domain and empire, wealth, mansion and court.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: simarat naam pooran aachaar ||3||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam brings perfect conduct. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas ih keeaa beechaar ||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak has deliberated, and has come to this conclusion:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: bin har naam mithiaa sabh chhaar ||4||8||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, everything is false and worthless, like ashes. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: lep na laago til kaa mool ||
verses.translation: The poison had absolutely no harmful effect.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੂਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhusaT braahaman mooaa hoi kai sool ||1||
verses.translation: But the wicked Brahmin died in pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jan raakhe paarabraham aap ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God Himself has saved His humble servant.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀ ਮੂਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paapee mooaa gur parataap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sinner died through the Power of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa khasam jan aap dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord and Master meditates on Him.

verses.original: ਇਆਣਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eiaanaa paapee oh aap pachaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself has destroyed the ignorant sinner. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh maat pitaa apane dhaas kaa rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: God is the Mother, the Father and the Protector of His slave.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਥਾ ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kaa maathaa ieehaa(n) uoohaa kaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: The face of the slanderer, here and hereafter, is blackened. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kee paramesar sunee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord has heard the prayer of servant Nanak.

verses.original: ਮਲੇਛੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਚਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: malechh paapee pachiaa bhiaa niraas ||4||9||
verses.translation: The filthy sinner lost hope and died. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: khoob khoob khoob khoob khoob tero naam ||
verses.translation: Excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent is Your Name.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh dhunee gumaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: False, false, false, false is pride in the world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਗਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nagaj tere ba(n)dhe dheedhaar apaar ||
verses.translation: The glorious vision of Your slaves, O Infinite Lord, is wonderful and beauteous.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sabh dhuneeaa chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is just ashes. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਦਮ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: acharaj teree kudharat tere kadham salaeh ||
verses.translation: Your Creative Power is marvellous, and Your Lotus Feet are admirable.

verses.original: ਗਨੀਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ganeev teree sifat sache paatisaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Your Praise is priceless, O True King. ||2||

verses.original: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਪਨਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: needhariaa dhar paneh khudhai ||
verses.translation: God is the Support of the unsupported.

verses.original: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gareeb nivaaj dhin rain dhiaai ||3||
verses.translation: Meditate day and night on the Cherisher of the meek and humble. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kau khudh khasam miharavaan ||
verses.translation: God has been merciful to Nanak.

verses.original: ਅਲਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਿਲ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: alahu na visarai dhil jeea paraan ||4||10||
verses.translation: May I never forget God; He is my heart, my soul, my breath of life. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saach padhaarath gurmukh lahahu ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, obtain the true wealth.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh kaa bhaanaa sat kar sahahu ||1||
verses.translation: Accept the Will of God as True. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat jeevat jeevat rahahu ||
verses.translation: Live, live, live forever.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam rasain nit uTh peevahu ||
verses.translation: Rise early each day, and drink in the Nectar of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har rasanaa kahahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug meh ik naam udhaar ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the One Name alone shall save you.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bolai braham beechaar ||2||11||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the wisdom of God. ||2||11||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sarab fal paae ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, all fruits and rewards are obtained.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee mail miTaae ||1||
verses.translation: The filth of so many lifetimes is washed away. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan prabh tero naau ||
verses.translation: Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poorab karam likhe gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Because of the karma of my past deeds, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g hovai udhaar ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am saved.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sobhaa paavai prabh kai dhuaar ||2||
verses.translation: I am blessed with honor in God's Court. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਚਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan charan prabh sevaa ||
verses.translation: Serving at God's Feet, all comforts are obtained.

verses.original: ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhoor baachheh sabh sur nar dhevaa ||3||
verses.translation: All the angels and demi-gods long for the dust of the feet of such beings. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak paiaa naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: har jap jap udhariaa sagal jahaan ||4||12||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the whole world is saved. ||4||12||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas kau ka(n)Th lagaavai ||
verses.translation: God hugs His slave close in His Embrace.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kau agan meh paavai ||1||
verses.translation: He throws the slanderer into the fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: paapee te raakhe naarain ||
verses.translation: The Lord saves His servants from the sinners.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਚਿਆ ਆਪ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paapee kee gat katahoo naahee paapee pachiaa aap kamain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: No one can save the sinner. The sinner is destroyed by his own actions. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas raam jeeau laagee preet ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slave is in love with the Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਹੋਈ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kee hoiee bipareet ||2||
verses.translation: The slanderer loves something else. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham apanaa biradh pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has revealed His Innate Nature.

verses.original: ਦੋਖੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhokhee apanaa keetaa paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The evil-doer obtains the fruits of his own actions. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai na jaiee rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: God does not come or go; He is All-pervading and permeating.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas har kee saranaiee ||4||13||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||4||13||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag bhairau mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa
