verses.translation: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਨ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sreedhar mohan sagal upaavan nira(n)kaar sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Fascinating Lord, the Creator of all, the Formless Lord, is the Giver of Peace.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisaa prabh chhodd kareh an sevaa kavan bikhiaa ras maataa ||1||
verses.translation: You have abandoned this Lord, and you serve another. Why are you intoxicated with the pleasures of corruption? ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: re man mere too govidh bhaaj ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਰਸਿ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar upaav sagal mai dhekhe jo chitaveeaai tit bigaras kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have seen all other sorts of efforts; whatever you can think of, will only bring failure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur chhodd dhaasee kau simareh manmukh a(n)dh agiaanaa ||
verses.translation: The blind, ignorant, self-willed manmukhs forsake their Lord and Master, and dwell on His slave Maya.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਪਸੂ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat kareh tin ni(n)dheh nigure pasoo samaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: They slander those who worship their Lord; they are like beasts, without a Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd tan dhan sabh prabh kaa saakat kahate meraa ||
verses.translation: Soul, life, body and wealth all belong to God, but the faithless cynics claim that they own them.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਮੈਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh dhuramat hai mailee bin gur bhavajal feraa ||3||
verses.translation: They are proud and arrogant, evil-minded and filthy; without the Guru, they are reincarnated into the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hom jag jap tap sabh sa(n)jam taT teerath nahee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Through burnt offerings, charitable feasts, ritualistic chants, penance, all sorts of austere self-discipline and pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, they do not find God.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: miTiaa aap pe saranaiee gurmukh naanak jagat taraiaa ||4||1||14||
verses.translation: Self-conceit is only erased when one seeks the Lord's Sanctuary and becomes Gurmukh; O Nanak, he crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||1||14||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਉਦਾਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ban meh pekhio tiran meh pekhio gireh pekhio udhaasaae ||
verses.translation: I have seen Him in the woods, and I have seen Him in the fields. I have seen Him in the household, and in renunciation.

verses.original: ਦੰਡਧਾਰ ਜਟਧਾਰੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)ddadhaar jaTadhaarai pekhio varat nem teerathaae ||1||
verses.translation: I have seen Him as a Yogi carrying His staff, as a Yogi with matted hair, fasting, making vows, and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਏਂ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g pekhio man maae(n) ||
verses.translation: I have seen Him in the Society of the Saints, and within my own mind.

verses.original: ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uoobh piaal sarab meh pooran ras ma(n)gal gun gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the sky, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in everything, He is pervading and permeating. With love and joy, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਭੇਖ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ਕਾਪੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jog bhekh sa(n)niaasai pekhio jat ja(n)gam kaapaRaae ||
verses.translation: I have seen Him among the Yogis, the Sannyaasees, the celibates, the wandering hermits and the wearers of patched coats.

verses.original: ਤਪੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tapee tapeesur mun meh pekhio naT naaTik nirataae ||2||
verses.translation: I have seen Him among the men of severe self-discipline, the silent sages, the actors, dramas and dances. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਖਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: chahu meh pekhio khaT meh pekhio dhas asaTee si(n)mritaae ||
verses.translation: I have seen Him in the four Vedas, I have seen Him in the six Shaastras, in the eighteen Puraanas and the Simritees as well.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਉ ਦੁਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh mil eko ek vakhaaneh tau kis te kahau dhuraae ||3||
verses.translation: All together, they declare that there is only the One Lord. So tell me, from whom is He hidden? ||3||

verses.original: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਹ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ageh ageh bea(n)t suaamee neh keem keem keemaae ||
verses.translation: Unfathomable and Inaccessible, He is our Infinite Lord and Master; His Value is beyond valuation.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tin kai bal bal jaieeaai jeh ghaT paragaTeeaae ||4||2||15||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, within whose heart He is revealed. ||4||2||15||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT bujhai so buraa kiau karai ||
verses.translation: How can anyone do evil, if he realizes that the Lord is near?

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਨਿਤ ਡਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bikh sa(n)chai nit ddarataa firai ||
verses.translation: One who gathers corruption, constantly feels fear.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hai nikaTe ar bhedh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: He is near, but this mystery is not understood.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sabh mohee maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, all are enticed by Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਨੇੜੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: neRai neRai sabh ko kahai ||
verses.translation: Everyone says that He is near, near at hand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhedh viralaa ko lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But rare is that person, who, as Gurmukh, understands this mystery. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT na dhekhai par gireh jai ||
verses.translation: The mortal does not see the Lord near at hand; instead, he goes to the homes of others.

verses.original: ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dharab hirai mithiaa kar khai ||
verses.translation: He steals their wealth and lives in falsehood.

verses.original: ਪਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: piee Thagauree har sa(n)g na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Under the influence of the drug of illusion, he does not know that the Lord is with him.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo hai bharam bhulaaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT na jaanai bolai kooR ||
verses.translation: Not understanding that the Lord is near, he tells lies.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਹੈ ਮੂੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh mooThaa hai mooR ||
verses.translation: In love and attachment to Maya, the fool is plundered.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasat dhisa(n)tar jai ||
verses.translation: That which he seeks is within his own self, but he looks for it outside.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo hai bharam bhulai ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: jis masatak karam likhiaa lilaaT ||
verses.translation: One whose good karma is recorded on his forehead

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve khul(h)e kapaaT ||
verses.translation: serves the True Guru; thus the hard and heavy shutters of his mind are opened wide.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar nikaTe soi ||
verses.translation: Within his own being and beyond, he sees the Lord near at hand.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak aavai na jaavai koi ||4||3||16||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||4||3||16||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis too raakheh tis kaun maarai ||
verses.translation: Who can kill that person whom You protect, O Lord?

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tujh hee a(n)tar sagal sa(n)saarai ||
verses.translation: All beings, and the entire universe, is within You.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: koT upaav chitavat hai praanee ||
verses.translation: The mortal thinks up millions of plans,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so hovai j karai choj viddaanee ||1||
verses.translation: but that alone happens, which the Lord of wondrous plays does. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raakhahu raakhahu kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, O Lord; shower me with Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran terai dharavaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, and Your Court. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa nirabhau sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: Whoever serves the Fearless Lord, the Giver of Peace,

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਏਕੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin bhau dhoor keeaa ek paraataa ||
verses.translation: is rid of all his fears; he knows the One Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo too kareh soiee fun hoi ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, that alone comes to pass in the end.

verses.original: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maarai na raakhai dhoojaa koi ||2||
verses.translation: There is no other who can kill or protect us. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa too socheh maanas baan ||
verses.translation: What do you think, with your human understanding?

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: The All-knowing Lord is the Searcher of Hearts.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ek Tek eko aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The One and only Lord is my Support and Protection.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh jaanai sirajanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord knows everything. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis uoopar nadhar kare karataar ||
verses.translation: That person who is blessed by the Creator's Glance of Grace

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan ke sabh kaaj savaar ||
verses.translation: all his affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa raakhaa eko soi ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is his Protector.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak apaR na saakai koi ||4||4||17||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, no one can equal him. ||4||4||17||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je hovai baahar ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if God were beyond us.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਰਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je visarai narahar ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if we forget the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je dhoojaa bhaae ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if we are in love with duality.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕੜੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiaa kaReeaai jaa(n) rahiaa samaae ||1||
verses.translation: But why should we feel sad? The Lord is pervading everywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੜੇ ਕੜਿ ਪਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh kaRe kaR pachiaa ||
verses.translation: In love and attachment to Maya, the mortals are sad, and are consumed by sadness.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਖਪਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai bhram bhram bhram khapiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they wander and wander and wander, and waste away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je dhoojaa karataa ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if there were another Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਅਨਿਆਇ ਕੋ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je aniaai ko marataa ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if someone dies by injustice.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je kichh jaanai naahee ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if something were not known to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕੜੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kiaa kaReeaai jaa(n) bharapoor samaahee ||2||
verses.translation: But why should we feel sad? The Lord is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je kichh hoi dhin(g)aanai ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if God were a tyrant.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਰੰਞਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: tau kaReeaai je bhool ra(n)n(j)aanai ||
verses.translation: We should feel sad, if He made us suffer by mistake.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa jo hoi sabh prabh te ||
verses.translation: The Guru says that whatever happens is all by God's Will.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਕਾੜਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮ ਸੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tab kaaRaa chhodd achi(n)t ham sote ||3||
verses.translation: So I have abandoned sadness, and I now sleep without anxiety. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh toohai Thaakur sabh ko teraa ||
verses.translation: O God, You alone are my Lord and Master; all belong to You.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau kareh niberaa ||
verses.translation: According to Your Will, You pass judgement.

verses.original: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhuteeaa naasat ik rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: There is no other at all; the One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: raakhahu paij naanak saranai ||4||5||18||
verses.translation: Please save Nanak's honor; I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||5||18||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੇ ਕੈਸੋ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin baaje kaiso niratikaaree ||
verses.translation: Without music, how is one to dance?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਠੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin ka(n)Thai kaise gaavanahaaree ||
verses.translation: Without a voice, how is one to sing?

verses.original: ਜੀਲ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬ ॥
verses.translit: jeel binaa kaise bajai rabaab ||
verses.translation: Without strings, how is a guitar to be played?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam binaa birathe sabh kaaj ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, all affairs are useless. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kahahu ko tariaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam - tell me: who has ever been saved?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kaise paar pariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, how can anyone cross over to the other side? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin jihavaa kahaa ko bakataa ||
verses.translation: Without a tongue, how can anyone speak?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin sravanaa kahaa ko sunataa ||
verses.translation: Without ears, how can anyone hear?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਪੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin netraa kahaa ko pekhai ||
verses.translation: Without eyes, how can anyone see?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam binaa nar kahee na lekhai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the mortal is of no account at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: bin bidhiaa kahaa koiee pa(n)ddit ||
verses.translation: Without learning, how can one be a Pandit - a religious scholar?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਰੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਮੰਡਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: bin amarai kaise raaj ma(n)ddit ||
verses.translation: Without power, what is the glory of an empire?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਹਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe kahaa man Thaharaanaa ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, how can the mind become steady?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sabh jag bauraanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the whole world is insane. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਕਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin bairaag kahaa bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Without detachment, how can one be a detached hermit?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin hau tiaag kahaa kouoo tiaagee ||
verses.translation: Without renouncing egotism, how can anyone be a renunciate?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin bas pa(n)ch kahaa man choore ||
verses.translation: Without overcoming the five thieves, how can the mind be subdued?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sadh sadh hee jhoore ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the mortal regrets and repents forever and ever. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur dheekhiaa kaise giaan ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru's Teachings, how can anyone obtain spiritual wisdom?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin pekhe kahu kaiso dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Without seeing - tell me: how can anyone visualize in meditation?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhai kathanee sarab bikaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, all speech in useless.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੫॥੬॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dhar kaa beechaar ||5||6||19||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this is the wisdom of the Lord's Court. ||5||6||19||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog maanukh kau dheenaa ||
verses.translation: Mankind is afflicted with the disease of egotism.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਰੋਗਿ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਬਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam rog maigal bas leenaa ||
verses.translation: The disease of sexual desire overwhelms the elephant.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT rog pach mue pata(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Because of the disease of vision, the moth is burnt to death.

verses.original: ਨਾਦ ਰੋਗਿ ਖਪਿ ਗਏ ਕੁਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naadh rog khap ge kura(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: Because of the disease of the sound of the bell, the deer is lured to its death. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo dheesai so so rogee ||
verses.translation: Whoever I see is diseased.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਰਹਿਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rog rahit meraa satigur jogee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only my True Guru, the True Yogi, is free of disease. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੋਗਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa rog meen grasiaano ||
verses.translation: Because of the disease of taste, the fish is caught.

verses.original: ਬਾਸਨ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਵਰੁ ਬਿਨਸਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: baasan rog bhavar binasaano ||
verses.translation: Because of the disease of smell, the bumble bee is destroyed.

verses.original: ਹੇਤ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: het rog kaa sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: The whole world is caught in the disease of attachment.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirabidh rog meh badhe bikaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: In the disease of the three qualities, corruption is multiplied. ||2||

verses.original: ਰੋਗੇ ਮਰਤਾ ਰੋਗੇ ਜਨਮੈ ॥
verses.translit: roge marataa roge janamai ||
verses.translation: In disease the mortals die, and in disease they are born.

verses.original: ਰੋਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮੈ ॥
verses.translit: roge fir fir jonee bharamai ||
verses.translation: In disease they wander in reincarnation again and again.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਬੰਧ ਰਹਨੁ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: rog ba(n)dh rahan ratee na paavai ||
verses.translation: Entangled in disease, they cannot stay still, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin satigur rog kateh na jaavai ||3||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the disease is never cured. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jis keenee dhiaa ||
verses.translation: When the Supreme Lord God grants His Mercy,

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਰੋਗਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baeh pakaR rogahu kadd liaa ||
verses.translation: He grabs hold of the mortal's arm, and pulls him up and out of the disease.

verses.original: ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tooTe ba(n)dhan saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: Reaching the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mortal's bonds are broken.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur rog miTaiaa ||4||7||20||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru cures him of the disease. ||4||7||20||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) mahaa ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, then I am in supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sabh dhukh bha(n)j ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, then all my pains are shattered.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) saradhaa pooree ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, my hopes are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਝੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) kabeh na jhooree ||1||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I never feel sadness. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar raam rai pragaTe aai ||
verses.translation: Deep within my being, my Sovereign Lord King has revealed Himself to me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai dheeo ra(n)g lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has inspired me to love Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sarab ko raajaa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am the king of all.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) poore kaajaa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, all my affairs are completed.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) ra(n)g gulaal ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am dyed in the deep crimson of His Love.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sadhaa nihaal ||2||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am ecstatic forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sadh dhanava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am wealthy forever.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦ ਨਿਭਰੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sadh nibhara(n)taa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am free of doubt forever.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sabh ra(n)g maane ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, then I enjoy all pleasures.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) chookee kaane ||3||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am rid of fear. ||3||

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) sahaj ghar paiaa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I find the home of peace and poise.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai taa(n) su(n)n samaiaa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I am absorbed in the Primal Void of God.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aavai sadh keeratan karataa ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, I continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: man maaniaa naanak bhagava(n)taa ||4||8||21||
verses.translation: Nanak's mind is pleased and satisfied with the Lord God. ||4||8||21||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਪੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਦ ਚਰੰਜੀਵੀ ॥
verses.translit: baap hamaaraa sadh chara(n)jeevee ||
verses.translation: My Father is Eternal, forever alive.

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee hamaare sadh hee jeevee ||
verses.translation: My brothers live forever as well.

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: meet hamaare sadhaa abinaasee ||
verses.translation: My friends are permanent and imperishable.

verses.original: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kuTa(n)b hamaaraa nij ghar vaasee ||1||
verses.translation: My family abides in the home of the self within. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham sukh paiaa taa(n) sabheh suhele ||
verses.translation: I have found peace, and so all are at peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pitaa sa(n)g mele ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with my Father. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੰਦਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhar mere sabh te uooche ||
verses.translation: My mansions are the highest of all.

verses.original: ਦੇਸ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪੂਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhes mere bea(n)t apoochhe ||
verses.translation: My countries are infinite and uncountable.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: raaj hamaaraa sadh hee nihachal ||
verses.translation: My kingdom is eternally stable.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅਖੂਟੁ ਅਬੇਚਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maal hamaaraa akhooT abechal ||2||
verses.translation: My wealth is inexhaustible and permanent. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sobhaa meree sabh jug a(n)tar ||
verses.translation: My glorious reputation resounds throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਬਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: baaj hamaaree thaan thana(n)tar ||
verses.translation: My fame has spread in all places and interspaces.

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: keerat hamaree ghar ghar hoiee ||
verses.translation: My praises echo in each and every house.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat hamaaree sabhanee loiee ||3||
verses.translation: My devotional worship is known to all people. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮਾਝ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa hamaare pragaTe maajh ||
verses.translation: My Father has revealed Himself within me.

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਰਲਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਂਝ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa poot ral keenee saa(n)jh ||
verses.translation: The Father and son have joined together in partnership.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jau pitaa pateene ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when my Father is pleased,

verses.translit: pitaa poot ekai ra(n)g leene ||4||9||22||
verses.translation: then the Father and son are joined together in love, and become one. ||4||9||22||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: niravair purakh satigur prabh dhaate ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is free of revenge and hate; He is God, the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham aparaadhee tum(h) bakhasaate ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner; You are my Forgiver.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis paapee kau milai na ddoiee ||
verses.translation: That sinner, who finds no protection anywhere

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saran aavai taa(n) niramal hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: - if he comes seeking Your Sanctuary, then he becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh paiaa satiguroo manai ||
verses.translation: Pleasing the True Guru, I have found peace.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh fal paae guroo dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Guru, I have obtained all fruits and rewards. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham satigur aadhes ||
verses.translation: I humbly bow to the Supreme Lord God, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan teraa sabh teraa dhes ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are Yours; all the world is Yours.

verses.original: ਚੂਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਤਾਂ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chookaa paRadhaa taa(n) nadharee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: When the veil of illusion is removed, then I come to see You.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khasam toohai sabhanaa ke raiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You are my Lord and Master; You are the King of all. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhaanaa sooke kaasaT hariaa ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, even dry wood becomes green.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhaanaa taa(n) thal sir sariaa ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, rivers flow across the desert sands.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhaanaa taa(n) sabh fal paae ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, all fruits and rewards are obtained.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤ ਗਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chi(n)t giee lag satigur paae ||3||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, my anxiety is dispelled. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਤੂਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: haraamakhor niragun kau tooThaa ||
verses.translation: I am unworthy and ungrateful, but He has been merciful to me.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal man a(n)mrit vooThaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; the Ambrosial Nectar rains down in my mind.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham gur bhe dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Guru, has become kind and compassionate to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas dhekh bhe nihaalaa ||4||10||23||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak beholds the Lord, enraptured. ||4||10||23||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa bemuhataaj ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is totally independent.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mere sachaa saaj ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is adorned with Truth.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭਸ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa sabhas kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is the Giver of all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa purakh bidhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: My True Guru is the Primal Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਜੈਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: gur jaisaa naahee ko dhev ||
verses.translation: There is no deity equal to the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis masatak bhaagu su laagaa sev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever has good destiny inscribed on his forehead, applies himself to seva - selfless service. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa sarab pratipaalai ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is the Sustainer and Cherisher of all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa maar jeevaalai ||
verses.translation: My True Guru kills and revives.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur mere kee vaddiaaiee || pragaT bhiee hai sabhanee thaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of my True Guru has become manifest everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਿਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa taan nitaan ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is the power of the powerless.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa ghar dheebaan ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is my home and court.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai hau sadh bal jaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pragaT maarag jin kar dhikhalaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: He has shown me the path. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur seviaa tis bhau na biaapai ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Guru is not afflicted with fear.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur seviaa tis dhukh na sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Guru does not suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sodhe si(n)mirat bedh ||
verses.translation: Nanak has studied the Simritees and the Vedas.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੇਦ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: paarabraham gur naahee bhedh ||4||11||24||
verses.translation: There is no difference between the Supreme Lord God and the Guru. ||4||11||24||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait man paragaT bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal is exalted and glorified.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪਾਪੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait paap tan te giaa ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, sin is banished from the body.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਸਗਲ ਪੁਰਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait sagal purabaiaa ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, all festivals are celebrated.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam lait aThasaTh majanaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, one is cleansed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: teerath hamaraa har ko naam ||
verses.translation: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhesiaa tat giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has instructed me in the true essence of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait dhukh dhoor paraanaa ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the mortal's pains are taken away.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਤਿ ਮੂੜ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait at mooR sugiaanaa ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the most ignorant people become spiritual teachers.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪਰਗਟਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait paragaT ujeeaaraa ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the Divine Light blazes forth.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਛੁਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam lait chhuTe ja(n)jaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, one's bonds are broken. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait jam neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the Messenger of Death does not draw near.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait dharageh sukh paavai ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, one finds peace in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait prabh kahai saabaas ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, God gives His Approval.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam hamaaree saachee raas ||3||
verses.translation: The Naam is my true wealth. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes kahio ih saar ||
verses.translation: The Guru has instructed me in these sublime teachings.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat man naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and the Naam are the Support of the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਨਹਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak udhare naam punahachaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak is saved through the atonement of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਲੋਕਹ ਪਤੀਆਰ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: avar karam lokeh pateeaar ||4||12||25||
verses.translation: Other actions are just to please and appease the people. ||4||12||25||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਖ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: namasakaar taa kau lakh baar ||
verses.translation: I bow in humble worship, tens of thousands of times.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih man dheejai taa kau vaar ||
verses.translation: I offer this mind as a sacrifice.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: simaran taa kai miTeh sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, sufferings are erased.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਹਿ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi ana(n)dh na viaapeh taap ||1||
verses.translation: Bliss wells up, and no disease is contracted. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso heeraa niramal naam ||
verses.translation: Such is the diamond, the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaas japat pooran sabh kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting it, all works are perfectly completed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee dhirasaT dhukh dderaa ddahai ||
verses.translation: Beholding Him, the house of pain is demolished.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਗਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam seetal man gahai ||
verses.translation: The mind seizes the cooling, soothing, Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhagat jaa ke charan poojaaree ||
verses.translation: Millions of devotees worship His Feet.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pooranahaaree ||2||
verses.translation: He is the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires. ||2||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh uoone subhar bhariaa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He fills the empty to over-flowing.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh sooke keene hariaa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He transforms the dry into green.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh nithaave kau dheeno thaan ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He gives the homeless a home.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khin meh nimaane kau dheeno maan ||3||
verses.translation: In an instant, He bestows honor on the dishonored. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh ek rahiaa bharapooraa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is totally pervading and permeating all.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: so jaapai jis satigur pooraa ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Lord, whose True Guru is Perfect.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har keeratan taa ko aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Such a person has the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises for his Support.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jis aap dhiaar ||4||13||26||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is merciful to him. ||4||13||26||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: moh dhuhaagan aap seegaaree ||
verses.translation: I was discarded and abandoned, but He has embellished me.

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਦੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: roop ra(n)g dhe naam savaaree ||
verses.translation: He has blessed me with beauty and His Love; through His Name, I am exalted.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: miTio dhukh ar sagal sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: All my pains and sorrows have been eradicated.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur hoe mere maiee baap ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru has become my Mother and Father. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਗ੍ਰਸਤਿ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee saheree merai grasat ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: O my friends and companions, my household is in bliss.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa bheTe moh ka(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, my Husband Lord has met me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tapat bujhee pooran sabh aasaa ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire has been extinguished, and all my desires have been fulfilled.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਭਏ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: miTe a(n)dher bhe paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: The darkness has been dispelled, and the Divine Light blazes forth.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh acharaj bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, is wondrous and amazing!

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਸਾਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa pooraa parasaadh ||2||
verses.translation: Perfect is the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau pragaT bhe gopaal ||
verses.translation: That person, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai dharasan sadhaa nihaal ||
verses.translation: by the Blessed Vision of his Darshan, I am forever enraptured.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sarab gunaa taa kai bahut nidhaan ||
verses.translation: He obtains all virtues and so many treasures.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau satigur dheeo naam ||3||
verses.translation: The True Guru blesses him with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bheTio Thaakur apanaa ||
verses.translation: That person who meets with his Lord and Master

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal har har japanaa ||
verses.translation: his mind and body are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaae ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, such a humble being is pleasing to God;

verses.translit: taa kee ren biralaa ko paae ||4||14||27||
verses.translation: only a rare few are blessed with the dust of his feet. ||4||14||27||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਆਲਕੁ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: chitavat paap na aalak aavai ||
verses.translation: The mortal does not hesitate to think about sin.

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਭਜਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹ ਸਰਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: besuaa bhajat kichh neh saramaavai ||
verses.translation: He is not ashamed to spend time with prostitutes.

verses.original: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saaro dhinas majooree karai ||
verses.translation: He works all day long,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਜਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har simaran kee velaa bajar sir parai ||1||
verses.translation: but when it is time to remember the Lord, then a heavy stone falls on his head. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa lag bhoolo sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Attached to Maya, the world is deluded and confused.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhulaiaa bhulaavanahaarai raach rahiaa birathaa biauhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Deluder Himself has deluded the mortal, and now he is engrossed in worthless worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pekhat maiaa ra(n)g bihai ||
verses.translation: Gazing on Maya's illusion, its pleasures pass away.

verses.original: ਗੜਬੜ ਕਰੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gaRabaR karai kauddee ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: He loves the shell, and ruins his life.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬੰਧ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh biauhaar ba(n)dh man dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Bound to blind worldly affairs, his mind wavers and wanders.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karanaihaar na jeea meh aavai ||2||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord does not come into his mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: karat karat iv hee dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Working and working like this, he only obtains pain,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਰਜ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hot na kaaraj maiaa ||
verses.translation: and his affairs of Maya are never completed.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh man leenaa ||
verses.translation: His mind is saturated with sexual desire, anger and greed.

verses.original: ਤੜਫਿ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taRaf mooaa jiau jal bin meenaa ||3||
verses.translation: Wiggling like a fish out of water, he dies. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke raakhe hoi har aap ||
verses.translation: One who has the Lord Himself as his Protector,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam sadhaa jap jaap ||
verses.translation: chants and meditates forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har ke gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur pooraa paiaa ||4||15||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he has found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||28||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: apanee dhiaa kare so paae ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh hiradhe man maeh ||
verses.translation: With the True Word of the Shabad in his heart and mind,

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: the sins of countless incarnations vanish. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jeea ko aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the Support of the soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਾਰਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh japahu nit bhaiee taar le saagar sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, chant the Name continually, O Siblings of Destiny; It shall carry you across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau likhiaa har eh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Those who have this treasure of the Lord's Name written in their destiny,

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: se jan dharageh paaveh maan ||
verses.translation: those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises with peace, poise and bliss,

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aagai milai nithaave thaau ||2||
verses.translation: even the homeless obtain a home hereafter. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jugeh juga(n)tar ih tat saar ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, this has been the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har simaran saachaa beechaar ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and contemplate the Truth.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis laR lai le so laagai ||
verses.translation: He alone is attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa soiaa jaagai ||3||
verses.translation: Asleep for countless incarnations, he now awakens. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: tere bhagat bhagatan kaa aap ||
verses.translation: Your devotees belong to You, and You belong to Your devotees.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: apanee mahimaa aape jaap ||
verses.translation: You Yourself inspire them to chant Your Praises.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh terai haath ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are in Your Hands.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak ke prabh sadh hee saath ||4||16||29||
verses.translation: Nanak's God is always with him. ||4||16||29||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Inner-knower of my heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai aavai kaamee ||
verses.translation: The Naam is so useful to me.

verses.original: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: rom rom raviaa har naam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name permeates each and every hair of mine.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur poorai keeno dhaan ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan merai bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The Jewel of the Naam is my treasure.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agam amolaa apar apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is inaccessible, priceless, infinite and incomparable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai nihachal dhanee ||
verses.translation: The Naam is my unmoving, unchanging Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam kee mahimaa sabh meh banee ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Naam spreads over the whole world.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai pooraa saahu ||
verses.translation: The Naam is my perfect master of wealth.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai beparavaahu ||2||
verses.translation: The Naam is my independence. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai bhojan bhaau ||
verses.translation: The Naam is my food and love.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam hamaarai man kaa suaau ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the objective of my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam na visarai sa(n)t prasaadh ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I never forget the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਦ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam lait anahadh poore naadh ||3||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the Unstruck Sound-current of the Naad resounds. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te naam nau nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te naam siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I am tuned in to the Naam.

verses.original: ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: dhanava(n)te seiee paradhaan ||
verses.translation: They alone are wealthy and supreme,

verses.translit: naanak jaa kai naam nidhaan ||4||17||30||
verses.translation: O Nanak, who have the treasure of the Naam. ||4||17||30||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too meraa pitaa toohai meraa maataa ||
verses.translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too mere jeea praan sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: You are my Soul, my Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too meraa Thaakur hau dhaas teraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Lord and Master; I am Your slave.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar nahee ko meraa ||1||
verses.translation: Without You, I have no one at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa karahu prabh dhaat ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and give me this gift,

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree usatat karau dhin raat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that I may sing Your Praises, day and night. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham tere ja(n)t too bajaavanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am Your musical instrument, and You are the Musician.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham tere bhikhaaree dhaan dheh dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: I am Your beggar; please bless me with Your charity, O Great Giver.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: tau parasaadh ra(n)g ras maane ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I enjoy love and pleasures.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar tumeh samaane ||2||
verses.translation: You are deep within each and every heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te japeeaai naau ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I chant the Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g tumare gun gaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree dhiaa te hoi dharadh binaas ||
verses.translation: In Your Mercy, You take away our pains.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਤੇ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tumaree miaa te kamal bigaas ||3||
verses.translation: By Your Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaar jaau gurdhev ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan jaa kee niramal sev ||
verses.translation: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His service is immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu Thaakur prabh mere ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful to me, O my Lord God and Master,

verses.translit: gun gaavai naanak nit tere ||4||18||31||
verses.translation: that Nanak may continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||18||31||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch jaa kaa dharabaar ||
verses.translation: His Regal Court is the highest of all.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa taa kau johaar ||
verses.translation: I humbly bow to Him, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: uooche te uoochaa jaa kaa thaan ||
verses.translation: His place is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT aghaa miTeh har naam ||1||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are erased by the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis saranaiee sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: In His Sanctuary, we find eternal peace.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jaa kau melai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He Mercifully unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke karatab lakhe na jaeh ||
verses.translation: His wondrous actions cannot even be described.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa bharavaasaa sabh ghaT maeh ||
verses.translation: All hearts rest their faith and hope in Him.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhiaa saadhoo kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: He is manifest in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat araadheh anadhin ra(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: The devotees lovingly worship and adore Him night and day. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhedhe toT nahee bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: He gives, but His treasures are never exhausted.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaar ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa hukam na meTai koi ||
verses.translation: No one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sir paatisaahaa saachaa soi ||3||
verses.translation: The True Lord is above the heads of kings. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee oT tisai kee aasaa ||
verses.translation: He is my Anchor and Support; I place my hopes in Him.
